Job Description – Program Manager

Company: Bijliride

Location: Madhapur, Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 2–6 Years

Qualification: MBA / PGDM Preferred

About Bijliride

Bijliride is a fast\-growing electric mobility company focused on building sustainable, affordable, and convenient mobility solutions through electric two\-wheeler rentals, B2B fleet solutions, 3PL services, battery swapping, and EV mobility solutions.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Program Manager who will be responsible for building and managing structured programs across business operations, franchise expansion, and cross\-functional teams.

The role will focus on team alignment, organizational matrices, SOPs and documentation, reporting systems, franchise reporting, and execution of franchise/business expansion projects.

The ideal candidate should be highly organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of working across multiple teams to ensure programs are executed effectively and business objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Program \& Project Management

* Plan, execute, and monitor strategic business and operational programs.
* Manage end\-to\-end franchise projects, from planning and setup to execution and performance monitoring.
* Define project objectives, timelines, milestones, KPIs, and ownership.
* Track project progress and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Identify operational challenges and drive timely resolution.
* Coordinate multiple teams to ensure smooth project execution

2\. Franchise Management \& Expansion

* Support the development and execution of franchise expansion projects.
* Build structured processes for franchise onboarding, launch, operations, and performance tracking.
* Develop and maintain franchise reporting systems and dashboards.
* Track franchise\-wise KPIs, revenue, fleet performance, utilization, operational performance, and other business metrics.
* Coordinate with franchise partners and internal teams to ensure alignment.
* Identify gaps in franchise operations and drive corrective actions.
* Support new franchise launches and ensure readiness across operations, people, assets, and processes.

3\. Team Alignment \& Team Matrix

* Build and maintain team structures and responsibility matrices.
* Define roles, responsibilities, ownership, and reporting relationships across teams.
* Create RACI / team responsibility matrices wherever required.
* Ensure clear ownership of tasks and deliverables.
* Improve communication and alignment between Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Technology, and other functions.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups to ensure teams remain aligned with program objectives.

4\. Reporting \& MIS

* Build and maintain team reporting systems and performance dashboards.
* Establish standardized reporting formats across departments.

* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.

description:
**Description**
 ou are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a complex cross\-functional program with considerable impact. Your program may focus on a single process path in a critical business area or you may work more broadly, managing larger initiatives that span organizations or geographies in support of a significant business objective. You may also be responsible for the delivery of large and complex projects that are not tied to any program. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives, and/or ownership of one or more organizational goals. You are accountable for overall program strategy as well as tactically driving teams in and outside your organization to deliver. You are able to define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the significant business problems in your program space, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind leadership decisions (Q: Why did we deliver X? What business goal does it solve? Do we need to deliver something else\-\- if so why, and what? ).
   

  

 To ensure stakeholder needs are aligned, you drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions. You provide a long\-term perspective, context (past, current, and future) for business and technology (at a high level) choices. You partner with customers, internal/external teams, and/or engineering teams to determine what projects move forward and in what priority order. You use your judgment to question proposals and test assumptions (Q. Do we need to deliver this at all?). You enlist senior individual contributors and leaders to ensure solutions scale (or will scale). You make smart trade\-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. deliverables). You create plans that have clear, measurable success criteria. You clearly communicate progress and outcomes. You oversee the gap between teams, processes, and systems. You help teams and/or your organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood or documented, ineffective cross\-team collaboration, long\-term impact(s) from third\-party solutions, security not considered, insufficient stakeholder review, etc.). You are able to solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships). You are data\-driven. You regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility. You ensure your program stays aligned with organizational objectives.
   

  

 You understand and share program\-management best practices. You may be asked to use your knowledge to assess processes, program plans, and operational requirements. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery. You streamline and/or eliminate excess process. You influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate problems that stifle innovation or cause user dissatisfaction. You are an excellent communicator. You write effective narratives (e.g., Amazon 6\-pager, PR/FAQ, reporting, etc.) and present them effectively to directors and VPs. You routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. When confronted with discordant views, you are able to find the best way forward and influence others to follow that path (build consensus). You actively recruit and develop others by mentoring in your organization and/or at your location. You provide constructive peer feedback and promotion assessments for lower level PMs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Generally works within a VP org. Influences large customer segments, technology decisions, external entity interaction, etc. Actively mentors and develops others.
   

  

 Work is tactical and strategic. Owns a large program. Manages the lifecycle of complex initiatives. Unblocks teams and increases the speed of delivery. Negotiates resources and priorities. Learning to force multiply . Escalates effectively. Able to find a path forward in difficult situations. Makes trade\-offs between short\-term needs vs. long\-term needs.
   

  

 High impact on. Org goals, and program\-related metrics. May have cross\- region impact
   

  

 Improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess process. Drives efficiencies. Creates predictable process paths.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

 WSP India is seeking to onboard dynamic and versatile Project management Expert with comprehensive experience across Document Control, Project Control, Scheduling, and Procurement to support our growing portfolio of complex engineering projects in Earth and Environment team.

**Document Control:**

* Conduct regular audits, check document quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and project procedures.
* Be in continuous touch with the PM to be on top of any internal or external documentation.


**Project Cost Control:**
* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines while coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice\-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.

* Able to create Opportunity in Oracle based Horizon during proposal/ pre\-proposal and update status based on directions from PM.

* Collaborate with design teams to collect engineering progress data for Earned Value (EV) analysis and maintain accurate tracking of planned value, actual cost, and schedule.
* Act as liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the E\&E PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation including lessons\-learned databases and meeting records.
* Should have extensive knowledge of working with ERP for project creation and maintenance.
* Should be able to create and track change order and identify, quantify and mitigate risk acting as a buddy to the PM.


**Project Scheduling:**
* Create, update, and maintain resource\- and cost\-loaded project schedules using Microsoft Project (MSP) or Primavera P6, based on stakeholder input, proposals, and scope documents.
* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.

* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems to analyze and report project performance and KPIs.
* Maintain accurate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and integrate project schedules under an Enterprise Project Structure (EPS).

**Role: Operations Consultant** 




  





**Who We Are:** 




 Streamliners is a management consulting firm specialized in rapid efficiency improvements, operational excellence, and fast turnaround. We help manufacturers and private equity owned portfolio companies in North America and Europe solve complex operational challenges to maximize profit margins and gain competitive advantage. At our core, we are doers. We work closely with clients in various industries to execute the steps required to achieve performance improvements.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 




 A experienced and self\-directed problem solver. A change management champion. You not only work well with others, but also can operate autonomously with little direction. You go the extra mile, and your entrepreneurial drive and intellectual curiosity have helped you garner a track\-record of achievement.

**Purpose:** 




 The Assistant Vice President – Projects will support the Head – Project Planning \& Execution in providing strategic leadership for the planning, execution, delivery, and handover of luxury hospitality and mixed\-use developments across DLF Hospitality. The role is responsible for ensuring timely, cost\-effective, and quality execution of projects while maintaining the highest standards of design, engineering excellence, sustainability, guest experience, and operational readiness.
 



 The incumbent will lead the end\-to\-end project lifecycle, including project planning, design coordination, procurement, budgeting, construction, commissioning, and operational handover, ensuring alignment with business objectives, luxury hospitality brand standards, and organizational governance.
 



  





**Key Organizational Relationships:** 




**Reports to** 
 : Head – Project Planning \& Execution

 Project Managers, Planning Team, Costing \& Budgeting Team, Contracts and Procurement teams, Site Execution teams
 



**Interacts with**

* External – Architects \& Design Consultants, International Hospitality Operators, PMC Consultants, Contractors \& Vendors, Government \& Statutory Authorities, Brand Representatives

**Drive Operational Excellence** 



* Support the Head – Project Planning \& Execution in developing and executing project strategies, governance frameworks, and delivery plans for luxury hospitality, branded residences, clubs, and mixed\-use developments in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of luxury hospitality projects from concept to operational handover.
* Ensure adherence to approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and brand expectations.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams and ensure seamless coordination among all stakeholders.



**Strategic Planning \& Execution** 



* Drive integrated master planning, project scheduling, and execution strategies.
* Ensure alignment of design, procurement, and construction activities.
* Monitor project milestones and implement corrective actions where required.
* Optimize engineering and design solutions while maintaining luxury standards.



**ODC (Owner\-Driven Contracting) Management** 



* Manage projects executed under ODC procurement models.
* Drive contracting strategies, bid processes, and vendor selection.
* Oversee contract administration, claims management, and performance monitoring.
* Ensure commercial optimization without compromising quality or timelines.



**Design \& Quality Management** 



* Ensure compliance with luxury hospitality brand standards.
* Coordinate architectural, structural, MEP, and interior design deliverables.
* Review and approve design stages in coordination with consultants and operators.
* Ensure world\-class quality in execution and finishes.



**Commercial \& Financial Management** 



* Develop and monitor project budgets and cost plans.
* Drive value engineering and cost optimization initiatives.
* Track cash flows, commitments, and financial performance.

**Stakeholder Management** 



* Engage effectively with internal leadership, consultants, contractors, and operators.
* Present project updates in steering committee and leadership reviews.
* Resolve cross\-functional issues impacting project delivery.

* Identify and mitigate project execution, commercial, and operational risks.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and regulatory obligations.
* Maintain project governance and escalation mechanisms.

* Lead commissioning, testing, snag closure, and final handover processes.

* Lead and mentor project teams across functions.

* Drive implementation of safety requirements at project sites by monitoring contractor compliance, mitigating risks, and ensuring timely closure of observations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to embed health and safety considerations in planning, execution, commissioning, and handover.
* Review performance through audits, inspections, and governance meetings, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented effectively.

* B.E. / B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Architecture (Mandatory)

* PMP Certification (Preferred)

* 20\+ years of experience in Project Management

 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

 The Identity Solution team is looking for a Lead Technical Program Manager to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset
   

  

 As part of an exciting, fast paced environment developing payment authentication and security solutions at Mastercard , this position will provide projects and initiatives delivery management within the development lifecycle for Mastercard ecommerce payment authentication platform.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Using SAFE Agile process, facilitate agile ceremonies / meetings to ensure SCRUM teams remain on track for their committed deliverable for sprints / PI / quarter.
* Facilitate status presentations and reporting to program leadership.
* Coordinates with other teams and participates in the scrum of scrum / Release meetings with Program/Release Train Engineer (RTE).
* This coordinator will work with a cross functional team of technical and business owners to deliver world class solutions to business problems.
* This role is responsible for communication and coordination support to facilitate a self\-organizing and self\-managing teams who can deliver via effective Agile Practices. Help to complete any tasks required to remove impediments for the team and provide coaching and leadership support that make development deliverable possible.
* Agile experience is mandatory. SAFE agile exposure is further preferred.
* Helps highlight and manage risk and dependencies at the initiative / service / portfolio / program level.
* Helps the team achieve in areas including quality, predictability, flow, and velocity.
* Builds a high\-performing team by helping the team manage intrapersonal conflicts, challenges, and opportunities for growth. Escalates people problems to management where necessary, but only after internal processes have failed to achieve the objective.
* Guides the team on the utilization of Agile/Scrum practices.
* Proactively monitoring project health and quality, provides input to RTE and Management.
* Ensure timely and accurate communication with program leadership throughout the life cycle of the project.
* Act as liaison between various stake holders and ensure dependencies to other shared technical teams in Mastercard are prioritized and delivered on time.
* Coordinate and assist in the implementation and monitoring of existing and/or revised management directions and policies. Effectively and constructively deals with challenges.


**All About You**
* 7\-10 years of experience in Project Management / Scrum Master.
* Advance Understanding of Agile methodology and situations in which each can be successfully utilized
* High\-energy, detail\-oriented, and proactive with the ability to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Strong communication, both verbal and written, with strong relationship, collaborative, and organization.
* Experience in project management is required.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Description**
 ROW (Rest of World) Network Operations Centre (NOC) sits at the core of the order\-to\-delivery Supply Chain. Under the broader NOC org sites ROW Inbound (ROW IB) which aims to improve reliability, cost\-to\-serve and operator/vendor experience in First Mile operations through standardization, programmatic interventions, exception management and automations. We achieve this through our centralized workstreams on (i) vendor/seller/carrier appointment scheduling (ii) rescue interventions (iii) research workflows and (iv) network monitoring.
   

  

 Responsibilities: We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. This role will lead the centralized MFI (Missing From Inbound) across the network, driving end\-to\-end ticket lifecycle management, SLA adherence, and loss reduction through process standardization and automation. The program manager will partner cross\-functionally with FC operations, MFI PMs, vendor facing teams and tech teams to identify systemic defect patterns, implement scalable resolution workflows, and deliver measurable improvement across multiple countries.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on and motivated self\-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision\-making. They will work with stakeholders from multiple partner team to manage last mile support function \& improve program performance.
   

  

 The manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance \- 4 PM to 2 AM or 1 PM to 10 PM) to cater to multiple ROW geos.

**About The Job**
 The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Technical Project Manager to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will manage complex projects from initiation through to delivery and completion. You'll coordinate with cross\-functional teams to complete distinct projects on time and within budget. As a Technical Project Manager, you’ll need to be organized and detail\-­oriented with substantial experience managing IT and software consulting projects, relying on traditional systems and software development methodologies. This is a position with regular travel(20\-30%) to customer sites in India.
   

  

**What Will You Do**

* Manage project risks, actions, issues, and dependencies (RAID)
* Manage project budget and time frame
* Build content for project activities like project kickoff, project status, and project closeout
* Lead project meetings involving both customer and Red Hat’s consulting team members
* Coordinate with territory services managers and the Resource Management Office (RMO) to manage project staffing requirements
* Work with the territory services managers to ensure that financial forecast is up\-to\-date for their respective projects Support accounting activities as required, including obtaining copies of receipts for finance invoicing queries from customers
* Develop basic knowledge of Red Hat’s technologies to guide successful project management, including Red Hat OpenStack Platform, Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Red Hat Ansible Automation, Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (JBoss EAP), Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and Red Hat Satellite Maintain professionalism when solving problems and resolving issues


**What Will You Bring**
* Knowledge of specific project management and software delivery methodologies like Waterfall and Project Management Institute (PMI)
* Experience managing consulting projects under Time \& Material (T\&M) engagement models.
* Practical experience using various agile development tools like Trello, Rally, Atlassian Jira, or project management tools like Microsoft Project
* 3\+ years of experience working as a project manager or scrum master on IT or application development projects
* Ability to affect, inspect, and adapt to culture
* Demonstrated ability to motivate project team and individual contributors and to mediate conflicts
* Excellent customer­\-facing and internal communication skills
* Great written and verbal communication skills
* Solid organizational skills; attention to detail and ability to work on multiple tasks at the same time
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
* Willingness to travel up to 30% per year to be on\-site at customer locations for project related activities
* Project management or scrum certifications are a plus
* Experience with managing Government, and banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI) customers is a plus


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

The tooling landscape underpinning this transformation — Planisware, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, and the ELITEA, OpellaGPT AI platforms — has been designed and initially built by our implementation partner EPAM.
   

  

 We are now internalizing this capability. The PMO \& CMO Tools and Enablement Lead will act as the Product Owner and Project Manager of the full tooling ecosystem. You will not build the tools yourself — dedicated tech teams handle Planisware, Jira/Confluence, PowerBI, and OpellaGPT implementation. Your job is to gather requirements from all stakeholders across the Digital organization, translate them into actionable specifications, prioritize them, and project\-manage their implementation by the right tech teams.
   

  

 You are the bridge between business needs (what PMO, programme streams, OCM, and project teams need to see and do) and the technical teams that make it happen. You need a strong understanding of the underlying technology — not to code, but to know what’s possible, what’s feasible, and how systems connect. You think in data flows, integration patterns, and user requirements — then you drive delivery.
   

  

 A defining requirement of this role is to be an AI champion. Beyond running the tooling ecosystem, you are expected to actively drive the conversion of manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool ways of working toward AI\-assisted and automated workflows — using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected platforms — and to make AI and automation the default way the PMO and OCM operate. This expectation is weighted heavily in the recruitment process: candidates without a demonstrable AI\-automation track record are not a fit.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Requirements Gathering \& Product Ownership
* Act as the single Product Owner for the PMO \& CMO tooling ecosystem — own the backlog, prioritize features, and define what gets built and in what order
* Gather and consolidate requirements from multiple stakeholder layers: PMO dashboards, Butterfly stream dashboards, OCM/change management needs, project\-level dashboards, programme\-level reporting, DLT/SteerCo views
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and user stories that tech teams can implement
* Manage the requirements lifecycle: elicitation, documentation, validation, prioritization, change control
* Facilitate workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders across PMO, OCM, programme streams, and leadership to understand their reporting, tracking, and tooling needs
* Maintain a prioritized product backlog for the tooling ecosystem — balancing competing demands from PMO, OCM, and programme stakeholders
* Define acceptance criteria and validate delivered solutions against requirements before release
* AI Enablement \& Automation (Core Mandate)
* Champion AI and automation across the PMO and OCM — set the ambition, build momentum, demonstrate quick wins, and convert sceptics into adopters.
* Audit current ways of working and identify manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool processes that are candidates for automation.
* Drive the conversion of those processes to AI\-assisted and automated workflows using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected tooling — automated reporting and status roll\-ups, AI\-enabled change analytics, document and template generation.
* Embed AI into standard operating practice rather than leaving it as an optional add\-on; make automation the default, not the exception.
* Define and track AI\-adoption and conversion metrics (e.g. share of manual reports automated, hours saved, adoption rates) and report progress to the Head of PM Practice.
* Stay ahead of emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, ELITEA, PowerBI AI features) and translate them into practical improvements for the delivery and change teams.
* Project Management of Tooling Implementations
* Project\-manage the implementation of requirements across multiple tech teams: Planisware team, Jira/Confluence team, PowerBI team, OpellaGPT/ELITEA team, and any future platform teams
* Coordinate delivery across tech teams — manage dependencies, timelines, and integration points between platforms
* Track delivery progress, manage risks and issues, escalate blockers, and ensure on\-time delivery of tooling features
* Own the release management process — coordinate deployments across platforms, ensure regression testing, and manage rollout communication
* Manage the phased evolution of the reporting pipeline: from Phase 1 (manual) to Phase 2 (MCP/OpenAPI connectors) to Phase 3 (Planisware\-Jira synchronization)
* Coordinate with the Solution Architect on technical feasibility, platform evolution roadmap, and integration architecture
* Data Architecture Understanding \& Integration Design
* Understand where every datapoint lives across the ecosystem — Planisware (portfolio, schedules, budgets), Jira (project tracking, status), Confluence (governance), Snowflake (analytics), LMS (training completion), Veeva (content), knowledge platforms
* Design integration requirements: specify what data needs to flow between systems, in what direction, at what frequency, and in what format — then hand off to tech teams for implementation
* Understand the three\-layer reporting architecture: Data Layer → Orchestration Layer (ELITEA/OpellaGPT) → Presentation Layer (dashboards, PowerBI, Confluence) — and ensure requirements are correctly placed in the right layer
* Define data quality requirements and validation rules for the tooling ecosystem — ensure a consistent data baseline across the global portfolio
* Evaluate and recommend integration patterns (MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL) based on technical feasibility and business priority
* Ensure portability of data pipelines and workflows to future platforms (OpellaGPT) as those platforms mature
* CMO Tooling — Requirements \& Delivery
* Gather requirements from the OCM/Change team for the CMO tooling layer — understand what they need for change readiness tracking, adoption measurement, training management, and stakeholder engagement
* Understand enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms at a functional level — know what data they produce and how to specify integrations with the reporting ecosystem
* Translate CMO requirements into specifications for the relevant tech teams (PowerBI for dashboards, Confluence for templates, OpellaGPT for AI\-enabled change analytics)
* Project\-manage the build of CMO tools: change saturation heatmaps, adoption dashboards, training completion tracking, readiness assessments — as specified by the Central Change Manager
* Ensure CMO data feeds into the existing PMO dashboards — change readiness metrics, training completion, and adoption data visible alongside delivery data
* Unlock the benefits of AI solutions for OCM (OpellaGPT) — gather requirements for AI\-enabled change enablement, reporting, and analytics
* Stakeholder Management \& Training
* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders (PMO, OCM, programme streams, PMs) and the tech teams that implement tooling solutions
* Manage expectations across stakeholders — communicate priorities, timelines, trade\-offs, and delivery status
* Train project teams on how to use PMO and CMO tools — where to find them, how to use them, how to submit data at stage gates (the OCM team owns the content; this role owns the tooling how\-to)
* Develop self\-service training materials: guides, video walkthroughs, quick\-reference cards for both PMO and CMO tools
* Lead Communities of Practice sessions focused on tooling best practices and adoption
* Support new PM onboarding with tooling setup and orientation (coordinated with the Delivery Facilitation Lead)
* Continuous Improvement
* Continuously improve the tooling landscape based on user feedback, emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, PowerBI, ELITEA), and evolving programme needs
* Monitor tool adoption rates and flag under\-utilization to the Head of PM Practice
* Conduct periodic reviews of the tooling ecosystem with key stakeholders to identify gaps, redundancies, and improvement opportunities


**Technical Environment**
**This Role Requires Understanding Of The Following Platforms**
**Portfolio Management**
 Planisware (schedules, budgets, dependencies, milestones) — dedicated Planisware team implements
   

  

**Project Tracking**
 Jira Cloud Enterprise (epics, stories, status, RAG) — dedicated Jira/Confluence team implements
   

  

**Collaboration \& Docs**
 Confluence Cloud (governance pages, templates, documentation)
   

  

**Data Warehouse**
 Snowflake (analytical data, portfolio ingestion)
   

  

**AI / Orchestration**
 ELITEA Platform, OpellaGPT — dedicated AI team implements
   

  

**Reporting / BI**
 PowerBI, self\-contained HTML dashboards, Confluence publishing — dedicated BI team implements
   

  

**CMO / Change Platforms**
 LMS (Learning Management Systems), Veeva, knowledge platforms — data integration, not content creation
   

  

**Integration Patterns**
 MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL — understand and specify, tech teams implement
   

  

**About You**
* 6\+ years of experience in business analysis, project management, or product ownership in an enterprise IT/Digital environment
* Demonstrable track record of driving AI and automation adoption — converting manual, template\-based, or legacy\-tool processes into AI\-assisted or automated workflows, with evidence of results. This is an essential, defining requirement of the role.
* Proven ability to gather, translate, and prioritize requirements from multiple business stakeholders with competing needs
* Experience project\-managing implementations across multiple technical teams working on different platforms simultaneously
* Strong understanding of enterprise project/portfolio management tools (Planisware, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) — not as a developer, but as someone who understands their capabilities, data models, and integration possibilities
* Ability to think in data flows and system integration — understand where datapoints live, how systems connect, and what’s technically feasible without being the one who codes it
* Good understanding of enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms — at a functional level, not as a content creator
* Experience with reporting and BI tools (PowerBI, HTML dashboards, or similar) — understand what’s possible and specify requirements for BI teams
* Experience writing functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills — ability to facilitate workshops, manage expectations, and communicate trade\-offs across business and technical audiences
* Ability to train non\-technical users on enterprise tools — create training materials, deliver sessions, provide ongoing support
* Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams (India, Paris, Barcelona, global)
* Fluent English (written and spoken) — all documentation and training materials are in English


**Preferred**
* Experience working as Product Owner for an enterprise tooling or platform team
* Understanding of AI/ML platforms or agentic AI frameworks (OpellaGPT, LangChain, ELITEA, or equivalent) — at a functional level
* Experience specifying data integration requirements (MCP, OpenAPI, ETL, webhooks) for technical teams to implement
* Experience with Planisware\-Jira integration or cross\-platform synchronization projects
* Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or similar life sciences platforms


**Transition \& Onboarding**
 This role internalizes capability currently delivered by EPAM. The onboarding plan includes:
   

  

* Weeks 1\-4: Shadow period with EPAM team — understand the current tooling landscape, data flows, platform capabilities, and stakeholder requirements
* Weeks 3\-6: Begin gathering requirements independently; start building the product backlog; establish relationships with all tech teams
* Weeks 5\-8: Take over project management of ongoing tooling implementations; begin CMO tooling requirements gathering with Brent (OCM Lead)
* Month 3\+: Full autonomous ownership of the tooling backlog and delivery roadmap. EPAM engagement ends for tooling scope.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Butterfly program is one of the largest digital transformations in the FMCH industry — 56 programs, 205\+ projects. Every Program Manager, every SteerCo, and every leadership review depends on the dashboards and reporting this role delivers. On the change side, the tools you specify and drive to implementation will determine whether OCM is embedded in how projects are actually run, or stays as a theoretical framework.
   

  

 You will own the infrastructure that makes delivery visible and change trackable — with direct impact on global decision\-making.
   

  

 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

description:
**Description**
 We are building Amazon's first horizontal self\-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule\-based systems into outcome\-learning, context\-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross\-org coordination, and production launch governance.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end\-to\-end — from first contact through production launch and steady\-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi\-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Tenant Onboarding Execution
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
* Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
* Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross\-org dependencies.


 Cross\-Org Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate multi\-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
* Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant\-side engineering.
* Serve as the single\-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.


 Process Design \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
* Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self\-serve at scale.


 Data Readiness \& Pre\-flight
   

  

* Drive data readiness (the \#1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
* Coordinate pre\-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
* Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.


 Governance \& Launch Readiness
   

  

* Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail\-safes, RACI sign\-off), and transition to steady\-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.


 Pipeline \& Reporting
   

  

* Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time\-to\-production, blocker resolution.
* Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding\-ready tenants.


**About The Team**
 We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan\-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.
   

  

 You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant\-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
* Experience managing multi\-party programs with cross\-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
* Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
* Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5\+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
* Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Experience in platform onboarding, developer ecosystem programs, or internal tooling adoption at large\-scale technology organizations
* Familiarity with data platform or ML/AI product ecosystems — comfortable navigating conversations about data readiness, model validation, and production governance
* Background in building scalable onboarding processes that reduce per\-tenant effort over time (self\-serve model design)
* Experience with change management in multi\-org environments — driving adoption where commitment requires budget, headcount, and cross\-functional alignment


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **Job Title**
 Planning Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role is responsible for supporting end\-to\-end project management through effective planning, scheduling, procurement coordination, and reporting within Cushman \& Wakefield’s PDS delivery framework. The Planning / MIS / Project Coordinator will prepare and monitor project schedules, cost forecasts, and resource plans to ensure seamless execution of investor\-led base\-build projects. The position involves progress tracking, deviation analysis, and coordination with clients, consultants, and contractors to maintain program alignment. It also oversees MIS reporting, procurement monitoring, and change control processes, providing accurate and data\-driven insights to support timely and successful project delivery within scope, budget, and schedule.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Monitors progress against baseline schedules, updates weekly and monthly reports, and identifies potential risks or delays to mitigate proactively.
* Coordinates with the project team, contractors, and consultants to ensure the timely availability of drawings, approvals, and materials in line with the project plan.
* Tracks procurement schedules, monitors lead times for critical materials, and ensures timely delivery to prevent execution delays.
* Prepares and circulates weekly and monthly MIS reports including progress dashboards, schedule variance, manpower, and procurement status.
* Ensures smooth communication and coordination between client, consultants, and site teams to maintain project governance and reporting accuracy.
* Supports change control processes by evaluating time and cost implications of variations and ensuring schedule updates reflect approved changes.
* Analyses resource utilization, productivity trends, and performance metrics to support decision\-making for project efficiency.
* Coordinates with design, procurement, and execution teams to ensure seamless alignment between planning data and site progress.
* Assists in preparing presentations, project trackers, and dashboards for Senior management reviews.
* Develops and maintains detailed project schedules in Microsoft office aligned with project objectives and contractual milestones.
* Monitors progress against baseline schedules, updates weekly and monthly reports, and identifies potential risks or delays to mitigate proactively.
* About You:
* B.E. Civil
* 6 \- 8 Years \& above of relevant experience
* Similar experience or role in the construction industry.
* Proficiency with planning and scheduling software like MS Project / Primavera software..
* Excellent organizational and motivational skills.
* Outstanding attention to detail and observation ability.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
   

  

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
 That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.
   

  

 We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community \- it means we go way beyond than just talking about it \- we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.

**Job Title**
 Assistant Project Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 The role will require close coordination with the Client, PMC, consultants, contractors, design teams, procurement teams and site execution teams to ensure that project milestones are achieved within the approved project schedule. Having strong hands\-on expertise in Primavera P6, construction sequencing, progress measurement, critical path analysis, delay analysis and schedule reporting.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About The Role:**
* We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer with around 10 years of experience in construction planning and project controls to be based in Bangalore.
* The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and controlling project schedules, monitoring contractor performance, identifying schedule risks and delays, and providing timely recommendations for corrective and recovery measures.
* Develop and maintain the Project Master Schedule in Primavera P6\.
* Establish appropriate WBS, activity coding, calendars, relationships, milestones and critical path.
* Develop baseline, detailed execution, procurement, design and commissioning schedules.
* Integrate design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
* Review contractor baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, resources and achievability.
* Ensure alignment of contractor schedules with overall project milestones.
* Develop detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules as required by the project.
* Prepare and maintain 2\-week, 4\-week and monthly look\-ahead schedules.
* Identify interface activities and constraints affecting project progress.
* Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline schedule.
* Collect and validate progress information from site teams and contractors.
* Carry out weekly and monthly schedule updates.
* Analyse planned vs. actual progress and identify slippages.
* Track critical and near\-critical activities.
* Monitor key project milestones and sectional completion dates.
* Identify potential delays at an early stage and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Ensure that reported progress is supported by actual site achievement.
* Prepare and monitor manpower histograms and resource loading.
* Review contractor manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Monitor productivity against planned norms.
* Identify resource shortages affecting critical activities.
* Prepare resource\-based recovery plans where required.
* Monitor material and equipment requirements against project milestones.
* Coordinate with design consultants to track drawing and document deliverables.
* Monitor design approvals against construction requirements.
* Integrate procurement schedules with the construction programme.
* Track long\-lead items and ensure delivery dates are aligned with site requirements.
* Highlight delays in design approvals, material procurement and statutory approvals that may impact the programme.
* Review and comment on contractor schedules and programmes.
* Conduct regular planning meetings with contractors and site teams.
* Challenge unrealistic activity durations, sequencing and progress claims.
* Ensure contractors submit updated schedules and recovery programmes on time.
* Monitor contractor commitments against agreed action plans.
* Provide planning inputs during commercial and contractual discussions.
* Maintain a clear record of delay events, instructions, approvals and their schedule impact.
* Maintain a schedule risk and constraint register.
* Identify activities with potential impact on project completion.
* Carry out schedule risk assessments and mitigation planning.
* Support cost and commercial teams by providing schedule information for forecasting and change management.
* Analyse the schedule impact of variations and change orders.
* Support project forecasting and expected completion\-date assessments.
* Ensure schedule changes are properly documented and traceable.


**About You**
* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
* Post Graduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management will be an advantage.
* Primavera P6 certification will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in construction planning/project controls.
* Should have substantial experience in preparing and managing construction programmes rather than only updating schedules.
* Experience with a PMC/Client/Consultant organisation will be preferred.
* Experience in reviewing contractor programmes and delay claims will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on construction planning professional, not merely a Primavera operator. He/she should be capable of independently analysing a project programme, identifying why the project is slipping, determining the impact on the critical path, developing recovery options and presenting clear recommendations to the Project Manager/Client.
* Experience with major contractors such as L\&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons, Brigade, Prestige or similar organisations, or experience with a reputed PMC/consultancy, will be preferred.


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
   

  

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
*That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*
*We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community \- it means we go way beyond than just talking about it \- we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.*

**Job Summary**
 The Project Associate will drive and support overall project management activities to ensure successful execution of clinical trials, which may range from single service studies to full scope or multiple protocol and/or global projects. This role requires coordination of project tasks, maintaining documentation, communicating with stakeholders, and maintenance of timelines and budgets. A Project Associate may be allocated to function at the Sr. Project Associate (Sr. PA) level within a large project team or on a small project.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Drives the planning and execution of elements of clinical trials in partnership with the Project Lead.
* Ensures projects adhere to strict timelines and are delivered within budget.
* Coordinates internal resources and third parties/vendors for the efficient execution of projects.
* Conducts ongoing analysis of project performance to drive the successful completion of short and long\-term goals.
* May maintain and distribute study\-specific financial reports and contribute to study’s financial health using financial processes and systems.
* Documents project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders.
* Leads communication between project team members, ensuring all parties are informed of project status and changes.
* Documents and escalates project risks and issues and drives timely follow\-through and completion.
* Maintenance of systems and project management tools and methodologies.
* Drives quality assurance activities, including preparation for audits and internal review, prepare documentation and follow through to resolution on actionable issues.


**Additional Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Ability to manage time and work independently.
* High proficiency with full MS Office Applications and/or project management software tools.
* Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade.

You demonstrate a high degree of product ownership and are passionate about innovation. No idea is too big for you to consider, and no task is too small for you to deliver on.

description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
   

  

 You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in\-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Project Leadership: Spearhead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, expansions, and special projects.
   

  

 Financial Management: Direct multi\-million\-dollar security project lifecycles including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budgeting, change orders, and documentation.
   

  

 Technology Innovation: Apply knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to enhance the AWS physical security program.
   

  

 Strategic Advisory: Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) guidance to leadership for technology and procedural decisions.
   

  

 Operational Excellence: Prioritize tasks effectively and operate seamlessly across organizational boundaries
   

  

 Maintenance Oversight: Execute and coordinate preventative maintenance and repairs for security system equipment
   

  

 Compliance Assurance: Ensure adherence to physical security standards, project scopes, budgets, and timelines
   

  

 Solution Development: Design and implement solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs, and change management
   

  

 Quality Control: Support security system commissioning, testing, acceptance, and project handoff
   

  

 Knowledge Transfer: Develop and deploy comprehensive training programs for all physical security system users.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
   

  

 Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
* 10\+ years of construction or project management, or 4\+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
* 10\-12 years' experience managing projects, operations, installation, and maintenance of regional/global physical security systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems

Our Company
   

  

 We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary\*\*
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IT Project Manager with a strong background in governance to join our team at Hitachi Digital Global India Private Limited. This role will be responsible for leading and managing IT projects with a focus on establishing and maintaining robust governance frameworks, ensuring compliance, and driving efficient project execution within a global context.
   

  

 Responsibilities\*\*
   

  

* Lead and manage the full lifecycle of IT projects, from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, control, and closure, with a particular emphasis on governance aspects.
* Develop, implement, and maintain project governance frameworks, policies, and procedures to ensure project alignment with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Define and establish clear project roles, responsibilities, and decision\-making processes.
* Facilitate and lead governance meetings, including preparing agendas, documenting minutes, and tracking action items.
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, developing mitigation strategies and escalation paths within the governance framework.
* Monitor project progress, budget, and resource utilization, and report regularly to stakeholders on performance against established governance metrics.
* Ensure adherence to internal and external compliance standards, including data privacy, security, and quality assurance.
* Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders, including business units, IT teams, vendors, and auditors, to ensure effective project delivery and governance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives for project management and governance processes.
* Manage project documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to governance requirements.


 Qualifications\*\*
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. PMP, PRINCE2, or other relevant project management certification is highly desirable.
* Minimum of 5\-8 years of experience in IT project management
* Proven track record of successfully managing complex IT projects from conception to completion within a structured governance framework.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and best practices.
* In\-depth knowledge of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ITIL) and regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001\).
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail and process improvement.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Jira, Asana, Microsoft Project) and governance tools.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a global team in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Us**
 We're a global, 1000\-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real\-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you're not just another employee; you're part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
   

  

 Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives
   

  

 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

 How we look after you
   

  

 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

 Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full\-stack customer engagement platform and business\-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud\-based product suite powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels.
 



 Trusted by 6,000\+ companies across 60\+ countries—including India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our offerings include communication APIs, a modern omnichannel contact centre, and a conversational AI platform hosted on the cloud. We are a Series D company valued at $100 million with $60 million in ARR.
 



  





**About the Pod**




 This role sits directly within our product pod, managing the end\-to\-end technical delivery of Conversational Quality Assurance (CQA) products. Unlike broader corporate delivery tracks, this position has direct ownership of enterprise implementations from initiation to completion, serving as the bridge between cutting\-edge AI product performance and enterprise execution.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are seeking an Technical Project Manager to fully own the end\-to\-end execution, delivery processes, and client communication for our CQA product line. In this role, you will step into a key leadership position within the pod, managing all technical communication with incoming enterprise customers, translating their expectations into functional workflows, and driving internal execution.
 



 As the delivery lead, you will have direct ownership of the project lifecycle. You will balance high\-stakes stakeholder management with a deep technical understanding of cloud telecom ecosystems and frontier AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Delivery Ownership \& Team Leadership** 



* Take absolute end\-to\-end ownership of the CQA product delivery process, relieving leadership from daily execution tasks.
* Establish, optimize, and enforce robust project management processes tailored for large, complex enterprise clients.



**2\. Client \& Technical Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the primary, front\-facing technical interface for onboarding enterprise clients.
* Lead client discover sessions to extract, understand, and document technical requirements from a product standpoint.
* Drive alignment and manage timelines across multiple external and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects move forward without bottlenecks.



**3\. Technical Project Execution** 



* Oversee the complex integration of CQA products into Exotel’s existing telecom/API ecosystem.
* Ensure smooth deployment and operational validation of frontier GenAI and LLM applications within the clients' environments.
* Coordinate daily with engineering, pre\-sales, and delivery teams, facilitating a seamless post\-delivery handover to Support Engineers.



  





**What We’re Looking For**




**Experience \& Core Competencies** 



* 5 to 8 years of solid project management experience, explicitly within software, SaaS, or deep technical product delivery.
* Proven track record of managing and delivery implementations for large enterprise customers.



**Technical Skillset** 



* AI \& Frontier Tech: Strong familiarity with AI/ML, NLP, conversational AI concepts, and hands\-on exposure to GenAI (prompt engineering, LLM applications).
* Integrations \& Infrastructure: Deep understanding of integration methods for CRMs, APIs, cloud systems, architecture, and deployment methodologies.
* Systems Knowledge: Comfortable understanding what works and what doesn't across Linux, networking, databases, message queues, and caching.



**Soft Skills \& Process Drive** 



* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills—capable of driving technical discussions with enterprise executives and internal engineers alike.
* High level of accountability, organizational rigor, and time management.
* A proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving and risk mitigation.

 We're looking for a
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to drive global marketing execution with absolute precision, speed, and total clarity.

You thrive on structure, sweat every minor detail, and hold Directly Responsible Individuals (DRIs) relentlessly accountable across global functions and time zones.
 



 Crucially, you don't just rely on legacy project management habits. You actively leverage AI tools and automation to eliminate friction, optimize workflows, predict bottlenecks, and keep our marketing machine running at full velocity. You own the timelines, the tools, and the operating rhythm, constantly refining them to set a new standard of operational excellence.

 Operational Rigor \& Accountability
 


* **Set the Tempo \& Own DRIs:** 
 Establish a clear, high\-velocity operational rhythm. Track every action item to its owner and hold DRIs accountable for milestones and deliverables across global marketing functions, including Creative, Social, PR, Retail, Influencer, Digital, and Regional teams.

 Global Alignment \& Continuous Improvement
 


* **Global\-Local Coordination:** 
 Partner closely with regional teams to ensure launch readiness, local market adaptation, and seamless execution across multiple geographies and time zones.

 Lead launch retrospectives, document key learnings, refine operational playbooks, and continuously improve future execution standards.

 **AI tools and prompt engineering**
