description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**About QAD Redzone**
 Redzone helps manufacturers make more stuff for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4\.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected worker.” We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 22% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.
   

  

 With over 1000 customers, 1200 plants and 325,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 with a bold vision to transform manufacturing performance, while bringing dignity back to the frontline worker. Redzone provides the tools that enable the self\-organizing adaptive behavior of the front\-line manufacturing team to win the productivity game, avoiding downtime, or quality losses.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Under the leadership of Coaching Director, the Project Manager is responsible for management and oversight of Redzone’s project implementation.
   

  

 This position is Full Time, Remote and required to travel 40% of the time.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate and lead the customer journey for 6\-12 weeks after each new customer is added until we go onsite to coach.
* Participate in onsite Success Plan to focus the customer on the priority activities that need completion.
* Ensure signals are connected and tested prior to onsite coaching.
* Support the infrastructure and installation for Visual Factory.
* Guide the customer and provide support configuration to map Redzone to the customer’s site.
* Highlight any risks and address them with the customer team, Coaching Director, and Platform Leadership.
* Responsible for overseeing the deployment of Redzone software for multiple concurrent clients\- manage the process from the handover from the sales team through providing onsite coaching services.
* Configure and setup Redzone software that matches the production process at the client’s manufacturing plant. This process must include manufacturing data such as product and equipment information and product run rates.
* Ensure automation signals from the plant (such as photo eyes or machine cycles) come back to the software and provide accurate and real time data to Redzone for the shop floor team.
* Ensure the contractor work with the hardware and automation happens quickly and efficiently while maintaining the project schedule and cost plan.
* Perform regular weekly status calls with active project teams across multiple clients in order to ensure project stays on track and all milestones are achieved.
* Responsible for the success of the software and coaching a “Green Go Live” based on project management leading up to that point.
* Manage client relationships and satisfaction, including but not limited to serving as the point of contact for projects, responding to client requests, and critical events in a professional and timely manner.
* Understand the escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could result in delays or unsatisfactory project result(s).
* Document and maintain the project templates, training decks, and communication tools that are used with clients.
* Support on\-site Continuous Improvement Coaches and customers with configuration, expansion, and automation requests.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**
* Understand the shop floor environment, workflow, and processes in Food \& Beverage and Consumer Packaged Goods’ for a variety of industries with the necessary depth to foster confidence and to support the client during the project.
* Sound judgement and excellent assessment skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Understand escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could cause a delay or unsatisfactory project result.
* Experience working with project management, ideally in software or systems deployments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing or supporting software projects of different sizes, complexity and contractual types.
* Proven ability to cut through barriers to accomplish tasks.
* Confident with MS Office Suite, Windows operating systems and Apple hardware/operating systems.
* Ability to plan, organize, and function effectively in a dynamic environment, addressing multiple demands of internal teams and clients. Manage multiple deadlines and tasks.
* Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with clients as well as internal teams.
* Ability to self\-manage and prioritize tasks across active projects to meet critical path deadlines.
* Able to work in a high paced, high growth environment.
* Tech friendly \& comfortable communicating technical requirements regarding networking, wireless, and software information.
* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) experience and familiarity is a plus, but not required


**Education/Experience**
* BA or BS – Relevant fields of study can include and are not limited to: Engineering, Manufacturing, Organizational Leadership/Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Management.
* 4\+ years in a similar position\-providing direct coaching to business clients.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or Hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD And QAD Redzone**
 QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.
   

  

 QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD’s vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

description:
**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of Program Manager I for its Amazon Shipping / Ship with Amazon (SWA) Program team. The goal is to develop easy\-to\-use, reliable and transparent transportation services that beat all existing shipping alternatives for our customers. In doing this, Amazon Shipping is deeply studying customer shipping needs and building innovative, market\-leading solutions that will organically attract customers towards our services. To help us succeed in this large endeavor, we are looking for dynamic, self\-starting and entrepreneurial individual who will organize, execute and deliver key features to the Amazon Shipping portfolio.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define, design, launch and manage new products and programs for improving experience and reducing reimbursements within the Amazon Shipping program and thereby enabling scale.
* Gather requirements and conceptualize solutions to solve a business and shipper problems and work with key stake holders across various functions to define and launch the product/program.
* Monitor key metrics on the program and work with all involved stakeholder teams to drive necessary action with field teams, business ops, finance, sales and leadership teams, to achieve goals. Manage Daily/weekly performance, build mechanisms to detect and drive down defects and work on continuous improvements for all processes.
* Launch and expand the program as per the business requirements and build/own all the long term planning, program and product roadmap for Amazon Shipping. Work extensively on industry bench marking, do shipper studies and work with Commercial team to understand the requirements of our prospective Shippers and work on building these capabilities.
* Use customer and market feedback, competitive analysis and bench marking, and business metrics to make informed decisions.
* Setup and manage end\-to\-end operational, performance measurement and customer satisfaction related processes for all shippers with whom Ship with amazon is tied up.


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role will require exceptional communication and influencing skills, and will work to influence stakeholders across shippers, Business, Operations, Sales and Tech teams. This role will require the ability to work effectively in a fast paced, startup environment, partnering with others as needed, and the ability to exercise sound judgment solving novel problems without clear direction from leadership. The successful candidate has demonstrated the ability to solve complex logistics challenges and possesses bias for action and deliver results in the role.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Shipping is the externalization arm for generating revenue by serving external shippers. We are leveraging our existing transportation network which serves a.in customers and use its infrastructure and capacity to serve external shippers who don't use a.in platform in anyway.
   

  

**Internal Job Description**
 Basic qualifications

description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 1–4 years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

 Be part of the Program Management Office (PMO) that is integral to our Honeywell Connected Enterprise (HCE) portfolio with responsibility over Engineering Operations across all our global sites determining Management Operating Systems (MOS) and implementing best practices for elements such as: Strategic Planning (STRAP), Annual Operating Plans (AOP), life cycle management, metrics, scrum, and agile techniques that supports the development and integration of highly complex software functions within HCE. You will partner with world class engineering and leaders to implement product strategies, develop program schedules and milestones, and define technology. You will also generate innovative solutions in work situations; trying different and novel ways to deal with problems and opportunities.
   

  

 The Senior Advanced Project Engineer will assist in creating and executing on Connected Enterprise engineering management operating system, manage projects as required, and contribute to strategy deployment of Connected Enterprise business. This position will provide support for a variety of products, processes, and system development programs across customer platforms. You will be responsible for programs including technical, financial, and organizational elements.
   

  

 You will work in close coordination with the PMO, technical managers, software engineers as well as support functions. You will be responsible for close interaction and support of strategic business initiatives including proposal development, strategic planning and customer support and product development. You will achieve breakthrough improvements in program performance through development and deployment of cost effective and proactive processes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Essential Responsibilities:
   

  

* Generate and implement MOS, programs and other requirements using SAFe and CCMI techniques;
* Understand and support both the Support strategic planning (STRAP) and annual operation plan (AOP) and are comfortable assisting in formally establishing these processes
* Understands the SW development life cycle, both waterfall and agile.
* Oversee various portfolios and/or programs focusing on PI iterations and sprints stages.
* Employ PM tools and development processes, including statement\-of\-work (SOW), work\-breakdown\- structure (WBS), basis\-of\-estimate (BOE) management, scope / requirements management, scheduling, and cost management
* In an agile fashion \- Execute on scope, schedule, cost, delivery, and quality while demonstrating program management skills in the following areas:
+ Portfolio Backlog management; PI Requirements Management and Fulfillment; Planning / Estimation, including resource, material, capital, and other needs
+ Scheduling, including resource\-loading and critical path analysis for any assigned projects
+ Financials (ex. RDE, spend, forecast, variance); Risk Management (Identification \& Mitigation);
+ Reporting / Reviews, and Communications;

* Collaboration … capability to work across and influence multiple groups;
* Facilitate forecasting and capacity analysis related to delivery requirements
* Establish and maintain the channels of communication necessary to assure timely management awareness of program progress and issues, including external communications
* Consistently present programmatic details, requirements, actions, and status to (senior) leadership, technical, and functional audiences
* Vendor interface


**Qualifications**
 YOU MUST HAVE
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering
* 5\-6 years of software program management experience; managing complex projects or multiple projects combined into a program with demonstrated success.
* 5\-6 years technical product development.
* 4 years of experience managing the development of one or more enterprise class software development projects.
* 4 years of experience in leading programs utilizing the Agile product development process.


 WE VALUE
   

  

* Minimum 5\-6 years of relevant engineering and program management experience with a track record of delivering successful results on significant, well tracked software, mechanical, electronics and/or services programs.
* Experience in all aspects of the engineering development life cycle, and program management including key Agile tools and techniques such as scrum, Kanban, sprints, epics, and story point estimating.
* Advanced Degree (MBA, Engr).
* Scaled Agile Framework – SAFe Certification.
* PMP, Agile Certification (scrum master PSM, CSM) or equivalent certification preferred.
* Tools: Jira, Confluence, Other Portfolio/ Program Management Tools (Jira Align, MSFT Project, etc.)
* Prior experience with SaaS based cloud products.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

description:
**Description**
 Amazon Operations Infrastructure Solutions (OIS) is seeking an experienced Sr Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for our team. Amazon teams and systems create a complex ecosystem with coordination challenges for large initiatives. As the Sr TIPM of Engineering, you will need to coordinate across this network of teams and own delivery of cross organization initiatives. Using your technical background, you will need to understand implementation challenges of each organization and team, and find solutions while also earning trust with senior management to drive adoption from the top down.
   

  

**A Successful Candidate Will Also Demonstrate**
* High attention to detail
* Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
* Demonstrated ability to influence management
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment where continuous innovation is desired
* Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
* Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
* Ability to clearly communicate data insights to others
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; owner mentality
* Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the market landscape


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**In This Role**
* You manage complex infrastructure builds, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating processes that are no longer needed. These efforts require you to work with multiple teams in and/or across organizations.
* You are accountable for the overall strategy of a large program. You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery). Your program meets business goals and/or shows measurable improvements in your customer’s experience, business or employee efficiency or execution, compliance adherence, financial or other metrics, etc.
* You understand the interdependencies and functionality of the technologies you work with (e.g. customer requirements, deployment constraints, design limitations, operational support requirements). You influence team priorities and business strategy through data\-supported contributions. You are able to make a case for project priorities, resource allocation, and/or appropriate program adoption, to achieve a desired business outcome, resolve a technical deficiency, or unblock delivery.
* You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
* Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
* You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.
* You actively participate in the hiring process as well as mentor others \- improving their skills and ability to get things done.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 Our team puts a high value on work\-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.
   

  

 If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!
   

  

 At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is specifically to manage cross cutting program for the Amazon Robotics/AFT/OpsTechIT organizations. It is a large multi\-year initiative, involving 30\+ teams, and with significant technical complexity and visibility.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
* Experience in project/program management
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience managing large\-scale projects from end to end


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: data center or network capacity planning, data center or network infrastructure program/project management, or related technical fields

 No other single team in Amazon provide exposure to end to end life cycle of e\-commerce: Welcome to World Wide Returns, and Re\-commerce (WWR\&R). We redefines e\-commerce and start where the typical e\-commerce supply chain stops. We innovate to support net\-zero carbon, Amazon climate pledge and works backwards from there. In most cases, our work starts even before customer purchases: in providing information about return policies on detail page/search \& during check\-out. and developing products to support end to end post purchase support needs. We support all post purchase customer needs starting from product usage troubleshooting support to return experience, transportation, reverse\-fulfillment, reverse supply chain and reselling. We provide returns as a service to for WW Amazon business across all channels (Retail, FBA, Merchant Fulfillment) and subsidiaries (Zappos, Woot), Customer Service applications and Amazon physical stores.
   

  

 Amazon Returns policies \& experience are foundational to Amazon’s e\-Commerce and one of the primary reasons why customers love shopping on Amazon. Returns policy communication on the detail page is among the top detail\-page features that increases Customer confidence and the Customer Trust Perception Index (CTPI) for purchase decision. This team has revolutionized the returns for customers through simplest possible experience with no need to print label \& do packaging and quickest refund time. Providing Great Returns Experience is complex due to negative customer sentiments while returning the product. Our team has been very successful in ensuring the lowest return rates and best in class return experience for Amazon as against other E\-commerce competitors.
   

  

 Below are some of the videos explaining the journey and CX of our team :
   

  

* Main Video (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415554\) (6m 40s): Overview of R\&R Business
* Introduction to Seller options (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415558\) (1m 44s): Overview of Seller Return \& Recovery options
* Introduction to LFBF (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/416088\) (1m 46s): Introduction to Label\-Free/Box\-Free returns


 The team is expanding its charter and is going to hire 50\+ employees in 2022 across all tech roles to define returns \& recovery options as a service for its merchant, FBA, bulk and Amazon business customers and to solve hard technical problems related to optimization of reverse supply chain channel. As a member of this team, your mission will be to evolve returns \& re\-commerce systems as highly modular \& customizable multi\-tenet platform to enable growth of e\-commerce business \& volumes and not only reduce cost of reverse supply chain but to even make it profitable business. You will be using wide range of AWS services, Java, object\-oriented design patterns, and latest storage, workflow, orchestration and UI technologies to build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving re\-commerce business requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for software engineers with 3\+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns, \& ReCommerce team!
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and evaluating system\-level technical design


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
   

  

 For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering IBMS and security system projects in Mumbai. This role requires a balance of project management discipline and practical execution experience across installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead project execution for IBMS, CCTV, ACS, and related security systems from kickoff through handover.
* Plan project schedules, monitor progress, and ensure milestones are achieved on time.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams to support smooth delivery.
* Oversee installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and final acceptance activities at site.
* Track project quality, safety, documentation, and compliance with agreed specifications and standards.
* Prepare and review project reports, commissioning records, handover documents, and site progress updates.
* Identify project risks and support timely issue resolution to keep execution on track.
* Support customer communication throughout the project lifecycle and ensure a professional handover experience.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* Own your projects with accountability, a strong safety mindset, and attention to detail from planning through handover.
* Stay close to the site work and customer expectations so issues are identified early and resolved quickly.
* Work transparently with customers, vendors, and internal teams to remove obstacles and keep delivery moving.
* Use clear reporting, practical problem\-solving, and regular follow\-up to improve execution every day.
* Build trust through collaboration, dependable communication, and a shared focus on successful outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience in project execution or project management within IBMS, ELV, or security systems.
* Hands\-on experience with CCTV, Access Control Systems (ACS), IBMS, and related security products.
* Experience in installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project handover activities.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and site activities independently.
* Good understanding of project documentation, progress tracking, and site execution practices.
* Strong communication skills and a customer\-focused approach.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with ELV system integration and building automation environments.
* Exposure to larger commercial, industrial, or infrastructure project sites.
* Knowledge of BMS protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.
* Experience in preparing detailed commissioning and handover documentation.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a team focused on delivering meaningful outcomes for customers through building technology and security solutions. You will work in an environment that values teamwork, practical problem\-solving, and continuous learning while contributing to projects that make spaces safer and more effective.
   

  

 If you have the project execution experience and technical background we are looking for, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and share your resume to explore this opportunity in Mumbai.

**Main Responsibilities**
*The main responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to, the following:*
**RIM Delivery Ownership**
* Lead and coordinate daily RIM execution for the assigned region, ensuring timely and accurate new product creation and product updates/enrichment in PIM.
* Plan and assign daily work, balance workloads, and ensure smooth operational flow across workstreams, including new product setup, enrichment requests, document updates, quality checks, and stakeholder queries.
* Work closely with the Team Lead to manage day\-to\-day operations seamlessly, maintain delivery discipline, and ensure prioritization, continuity, and escalation are handled effectively.
* Ensure consistent adherence to approved work instructions, checklists, approval steps, and escalation pathways to maintain stable and repeatable delivery.


**Data Quality, Documentation \& Compliance Controls**
* Maintain high data integrity across product records, ensuring completeness, traceability, and audit readiness in PIM and connected systems.
* Ensure product records are enriched with current regulatory and technical documentation (e.g., regulatory, compliance statements, specifications, technical data sheets, declarations/attestations as applicable) with disciplined version control.
* Enforce quality review controls (peer review/sampling checks/validation steps), drive correction of deviations, and strengthen “first‑time‑right” outcomes.


**Regulatory Change Adoption \& Process Control**
* Ensure process steps are applied in line with relevant regulatory expectations, including GHS, CLP, transport regulations, and applicable regional requirements across EMEA, APAC, and AMER.
* Aligning with PSRA Specialists to confirm regulatory and compliance checks are correctly reflected in RIM/PIM workflows, product records, and supporting documentation.
* Drive adoption of regulatory and process changes impacting product records, ensuring updates are implemented in systems, work steps, checklists, and supporting documentation.


**Request Management, Backlog Control \& Stakeholder Support**
* Manage request intake and assignment discipline, ensuring clear ownership, prioritization, and timely progression against agreed turnaround expectations.
* Monitor backlog health and proactively address bottlenecks, ageing items, and priority requests; escalate risks early with clear context and recommended actions.
* Resolve stakeholder queries within scope and ensure structured handling of ad‑hoc requests through clear prioritization and escalation.


**Performance Management, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Track throughput, backlog, SLA/TAT, and quality trends; provide concise reporting and insights to the Team Lead/Manager with actions and closure tracking.
* Support end‑to‑end delivery for integration/regulatory projects (planning \+ execution), including defining weekly targets, removing bottlenecks, and managing risks and scope changes.
* Drive continuous improvement across RIM execution (cycle time, standardization, rework reduction, data quality uplift) and support system improvements in coordination with digital projects teams.

We bring together the transformative technologies that power and connect account opening, digital banking and branch solutions for banks and credit unions of all sizes on any core. Our Candescent solutions power the top three U.S. mobile banking apps and are trusted by banks and credit unions of all sizes.

In addition, our API\-first architecture and developer tools enable financial institutions to optimize and expand upon their existing capabilities by seamlessly integrating custom\-built or third\-party solutions. **Job Summary**
 As a Technical Program Manager at Candescent, you will lead cross\-functional technical initiatives, manage program execution, and ensure alignment between engineering deliverables and business objectives. You’ll be responsible for planning, tracking, and delivering high\-impact programs that span multiple teams and technologies.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the planning and execution of complex technical programs across engineering, and product teams.
* Define program scope, goals, success metrics, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain detailed program schedules, risk assessments, and mitigation plans.
* Drive alignment across teams by identifying dependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring timely delivery.
* Communicate program status, risks, and decisions to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Foster continuous improvement by introducing scalable processes, tools, and best practices.

* Support technical decision\-making and provide guidance on architecture, integration, and deployment strategies.

* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Confluence).

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices architecture, and modern development frameworks.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.
* Technical background in software engineering or systems architecture.
* Experience working in a startup or high\-growth environment.


**Benefits**

**Regional Program Manager – Project Management**
**Position Summary**
**Flowserve** 
 is seeking an experienced Regional Program Manager – Project Management to oversee project\-management execution, performance improvement, and capability development across regional manufacturing sites.
   

  

 The role is responsible for high\-value, complex, engineered\-to\-order customer projects for flow\-control equipment. Working with factory project managers, site leadership, and cross\-functional teams, the Regional Program Manager will improve delivery performance, profitability, risk management, customer experience, and compliance with contractual obligations.
   

  

 The position reports to the Global Director of Project Management and operates through strong matrix leadership, stakeholder influence, and direct intervention in critical project situations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee the regional portfolio of complex customer projects from initiation through delivery, customer acceptance, and closeout.
* Monitor and report project health, safety, schedule, profitability, revenue, gross margin, percentage of completion, cash flow, customer experience, project risks, and key milestones.

* Drive alignment with Flowserve global project\-management policies, procedures, work processes, reporting standards, and maturity expectations.
* Support contract reviews, change management, risk registers, risk\-mitigation plans, and escalation of commercial, technical, or execution risks.
* Support strategic customer engagements, project escalations, and site\-level issue resolution when local capability or remote support is insufficient.

* Coach and train project managers on contractual conditions, technical specifications, risk management, lessons learned, closeout practices, and standardized execution processes.
* Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, standardized processes, lean and flow practices, and scalable solutions across multiple manufacturing locations.

* Strong analytical, commercial, organizational, communication, presentation, prioritization, and cross\-cultural collaboration skills.

description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

description:
Avance Clinical is a Contract Research Organisation which offers specialised services supporting drug development for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
   

  

 The Project Manager \- EPMO will be responsible for managing the planning and execution of internal projects assigned within Avance Clinical's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Operating within the EPMO's tiered governance model, the Project Manager will be allocated projects from Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build), or Tier 3 (Transform) relative to their experience, certifications and demonstrated delivery capability — scaling responsibility as they grow within the function. The role applies established project management principles to ensure consistent, disciplined delivery across the portfolio, and contributes to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework to help measure and report the return on investment of internal initiatives.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO's flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO's ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.
* Support continuous improvement of the EPMO's tools, templates, processes and benefits\-tracking methods through feedback, adoption discipline and lessons learned.
* Other duties as directed by Line Management or delegate in line with skills, experience and/or qualifications. Qualifications, Skills and Experience
+ Ordinary degree or equivalent in an appropriate discipline and appropriate industry experience.
+ Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Computer Science or other relevant discipline, and/or recognised project management certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum). Higher tier projects will typically require more advanced qualifications and demonstrated delivery track record.
+ Demonstrated project management experience scaled to the tier of project to be managed:
+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.
+ Tier 3 (Transform): a minimum of 5 years managing strategic, multi\-stream or transformation projects with executive\-level reporting and accountability for benefits delivery.
+ Experience contributing to benefits realisation, ROI measurement or outcomes reporting frameworks is highly desirable.
+ Experience managing technology, systems integration, ERP, CRM or business process transformation projects will be highly regarded given Avance's current strategic roadmap.
+ Strong working knowledge of established project management methodologies (waterfall, agile and hybrid) and the judgment to apply them proportionate to project size and complexity.

Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. Educational Qualification Mandatory B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution. Preferred M.Tech / MBA / Post Graduate qualification in Construction or Project Management. PMP / PMI / RICS or equivalent professional certification is an advantage. 19. Experience Requirements 15+ years of total experience in construction/project management. Minimum 810 years in Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Construction Manager / PMC leadership roles preferred. Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale building projects. Strong Client/PMC-side experience preferred. Experience managing multiple contractors and consultants. Experience in large and complex projects with significant civil, architectural, MEP and specialist interfaces. Preferred Project Experience Experience in one or more of the following: High-rise residential developments Commercial developments Super-speciality hospitals Hotels and hospitality Mixed-use developments Institutional projects Large corporate campuses 20. Technical & Professional Competencies Strong working knowledge of: Construction Management Project Management Primavera P6 / MS Project Project Controls Contract Administration FIDIC / EPC / Design & Build / Item Rate Contracts Cost Management Quantity Surveying fundamentals Variations & Change Management Claims & EOT Delay Analysis Quality Management HSE Management Procurement Management Risk Management Design Management MEP Coordination Testing & Commissioning Advanced MS Excel and MS Office BIM coordination awareness Project dashboards/MIS 21. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies The candidate should demonstrate: Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent Client and stakeholder-management capability. Strong technical understanding of building construction. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Ability to challenge contractors objectively and professionally. Excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Ability to make decisions under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong presentation skills. High degree of ownership and accountability. Ability to manage multiple priorities and interfaces. Proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation. 22. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Project Delivery Achievement of project milestones. Overall programme performance. Effectiveness of recovery strategies. Cost Project cost within approved budget. Control of variations and claims. Accuracy of cost forecasting. Contractor Performance Contractor productivity. Resource deployment. Schedule adherence. Quality and HSE performance. Timely closure of safety observations. Client Satisfaction Quality and transparency of reporting. Timely resolution of issues. Quality of recommendations. Effective stakeholder coordination. 23. The Technical Program Manager will also establish and improve program management processes that scale with organizational growth, and drive continuous improvement through post\-launch metrics tracking and retrospectives.
