title: Principal Project Manager
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description Sprinklr is a leading enterprise software company for all customer-facing functions. With advanced AI, Sprinklrs unified customer experience management (Unified-CXM) platform helps companies deliver human experiences to every customer, every time, across any modern channel. Headquartered in New York City with employees around the world, Sprinklr works with more than 1,000 of the world s most valuable enterprises - global brands like Microsoft, P&G, Samsung and more than 50% of the Fortune 100. Learn more about our culture and how we make our employees happier through The Sprinklr Way. Meet our Professional Services Team! Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We re looking for an experienced Global Program Manager to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen. About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Global Program Manager to lead the large-scale, complex global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing global programs, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to drive cross-functional teams towards successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities: Program Leadership: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of the global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives. Stakeholder Management: Engage with key stakeholders, including senior management, clients, and cross-functional teams, to ensure clear communication and alignment on program goals and progress. Resource Management: Allocate, coordinate and manage resources across different regions and functions effectively to ensure timely delivery of program milestones. Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with the program to ensure smooth execution. Performance Tracking: Monitor program performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques; report on progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness. Compliance: Ensure all program activities comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies. Financial Management: Manage program budgets, monitor expenditures, and ensure financial targets are met. Mentorship : Supervise and mentor program teams, providing guidance and support to ensure project success. Experience and Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in business administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in program management, with at least 5 years managing large-scale, global programs. Certifications: PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent program management certification is highly desirable. Technical Skills: Strong understanding of SaaS and CCaaS products & technology. (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Avaya, Cisco, Genysis etc.) Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to various audiences. Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Negotiation & Conflict Management: Experience in negotiation and conflict resolution to manage stakeholder expectations and drive consensus. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-Time Delivery: Percentage of program milestones delivered on or before the scheduled date. Budget Adherence: Percentage of program budget adherence, ensuring costs do not exceed allocated budget. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Stakeholder satisfaction scores based on feedback from clients, senior management, and team members. Risk Mitigation: Number of identified risks successfully mitigated or managed without impacting program delivery. Resource Utilization: Efficiency of resource allocation and utilization, ensuring optimal use of available resources. Quality of Deliverables: Quality assessment scores of program deliverables, ensuring they meet or exceed defined standards. Team Performance: Performance metrics for cross-functional teams, including productivity and collaboration effectiveness. Continuous Improvement: Implementation of process improvements and best practices, measured by the number of initiatives successfully adopted. Desired Soft Skills: Emotional Intelligence: Ability to understand and manage your own emotions, and those of others, to foster a positive work environment. Collaboration: Strong team player with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams across different geographies. Conflict Resolution: Skilled in resolving conflicts and negotiating win-win solutions. Time Management: Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines. Critical Thinking: Ability to think critically and creatively to solve complex problems. Resilience: Ability to remain calm and focused under pressure, and to bounce back from setbacks. Cultural Sensitivity: Awareness and respect for cultural differences, with the ability to work effectively in a global context. Why Join Us Opportunity to lead a high-impact global program. Collaborative and inclusive work environment. Competitive salary and benefits package. Professional development and growth opportunities. We focus on our mission : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things: Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM. Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience. Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability. We believe in our product : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything - and everyone - can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world s leading enterprise brands. We invest in our people : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off - it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus. To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here . To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here . Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter. Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. And it's admired, but not required, if:

title: Program Manager
description:
**Position:** 
 Program Manager – Urban Initiative
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation** 




  





**About URBAN Project** 




 India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well\-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services\-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under\-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under\-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest\-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.
 



  





 The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on\-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:
 



  




* **Regional economic and spatial planning:** 
 Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth\-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:** 
 Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:** 
 Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:** 
 Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.



  





 Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better\-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high\-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem\-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral \& written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.
 



  





**Areas of Work:** 




 The Program Manager will:
 


* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence\-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise



  





**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities** 



* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small\-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued



  





**Compensation** 




 Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience
 



  





**Location** 




 New Delhi, India

Job Description:
 



 We seek an experienced and motivated construction project manager to join our dynamic team at Nestcon. As a construction project manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating and managing construction projects for our firm.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include developing and managing project budgets, creating detailed schedules and overseeing resource allocation to ensure optimal execution. You will conduct regular site inspections, review construction plans and specifications, identify potential risks, implement proactive measures to mitigate them and verify that all the work is performed to the highest quality standards.
 



  





 If you’re passionate about this field, we invite you to apply. You will have the opportunity to work with a talented team, leverage advanced construction technologies and contribute to the successful execution of diverse and challenging construction projects in India. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package as well.
 



  





 Objectives of this role
 


* Planning, coordinating and managing all phases of construction projects, including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and closeout.
* Establishing project objectives, scope and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders and ensuring alignment with client requirements.
* Developing and managing project schedules, budgets and resource allocations to ensure cost efficiency and timely delivery.
* Liaising with architects, engineers, contractors and subcontractors to monitor construction progress, resolve issues and ensure compliance with specifications and quality standards.
* Managing procurement processes, including bid evaluations, contract negotiations and vendor selection.
* Oversee project budgeting and cost control and manage change orders to ensure adherence to budgetary constraints.
* Conducting regular site inspections to assess project progress, identify risks, and ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain effective communication with project team members and stakeholders to provide project updates, address concerns and foster strong working relationships.



 Your tasks
 


* Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocations and procurement strategies.
* Coordinate and oversee construction activities, ensuring adherence to project schedules and specifications.
* Evaluate and select contractors and subcontractors based on qualifications, experience and cost\-effectiveness.
* Monitor project progress, track key performance indicators (KPIs) and report on project status to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and legal requirements, prioritising a safe working environment for all involved.
* Manage construction project documentation, including contracts, permits, drawings and change orders.
* Conduct regular meetings to facilitate communication, address challenges and to meet project objectives.
* Provide regular updates and reports on project status, including milestones, budget updates, and any significant developments or risks.
* Implement and enforce safety protocols and ensure compliance with local building codes and regulations.
* Carry out thorough project evaluations and assessments to identify areas for improvement and implement necessary corrective measures.
* Provide leadership and guidance to the project team, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance work environment.



 Required skills and qualifications
 


* A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, (MS Project etc.) or a related field.
* 3\+ years of relevant experience in construction project management, with a track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes and safety regulations in the Indian context.
* Excellent project management skills, including effective planning, organising and prioritising tasks.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical documents, including project blueprints and construction schematics.
* Strong leadership and communication skills to manage project teams and stakeholders.
* Proficiency in construction management software, project scheduling tools and cost estimation software.
* Familiarity with sustainable construction practices and green building certifications.



 Preferred skills and qualifications
 


* Relevant professional certification in project management or construction management, like Project Management Professional (PMP) or LEED certification.
* Knowledge of risk management and budget management principles.
* Experience in managing large\-scale construction projects in India.
* Knowledge of local construction regulations, permits and approval processes.
* Proficiency in using Building Information Modelling (BIM) software.
* Experience with construction contract negotiations and claims management.
* Familiarity with lean construction principles and methodologies.
* Strong financial understanding and experience in project budgeting and cost control.

title: Technology & Security Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 This is a site\-embedded SME role focused on the specific ELV, BMS, and security infrastructure of a designated data centre campus or facility. Unlike the portfolio\-level SME role, this position requires deep, facility\-specific technical knowledge — the as\-built configuration, site\-specific control logic, vendor systems in use, and local operational constraints of the assigned site — to provide hands\-on technical support to site operations, construction, and commissioning teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the on\-site/site\-dedicated technical point of contact for all ELV, BMS, and security system matters at the assigned facility.
* Maintain detailed, current knowledge of the site's as\-built ELV and BMS architecture, including device inventory, network topology, controller configurations, and integration points with EPMS and fire/life\-safety systems.
* Support live\-site troubleshooting of ELV, BMS, and security system faults, coordinating with OEM vendors and facility operations/NOC teams for rapid resolution.
* Review and validate site\-specific change requests (MOPs/EOPs) affecting ELV, BMS, or security systems before implementation.
* Provide technical walkdown support during audits, client inspections, and compliance reviews specific to the site.
* Support site commissioning and re\-commissioning activities for ELV, BMS, and security systems during capacity expansions, retrofits, or system upgrades.
* Maintain and update site\-specific documentation — as\-built drawings, points lists, network diagrams, and system configuration baselines — reflecting all field changes.
* Coordinate with the portfolio\-level ELV \& Security SME on design standard alignment, escalations, and lessons learned across sites.
* Support incident response and root\-cause investigations for site\-specific ELV/BMS/security events, including data gathering, log review, and vendor coordination.
* Train and guide site facility/operations personnel on ELV and BMS system operation, alarm handling, and basic troubleshooting.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8–12 years of experience in ELV and BMS systems, with demonstrated experience providing hands\-on, site\-level technical support in a live/operational data centre environment.
* Working knowledge of the specific BMS/EPMS platform(s) deployed at the assigned site (e.g., Niagara/Tridium, Schneider EcoStruxure, Siemens Desigo, Honeywell, Johnson Controls Metasys).
* Practical experience with CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, and PA systems as deployed and configured on an operational site.
* Familiarity with MOP/EOP (Method of Procedure / Emergency Operating Procedure) development and change control processes in a live critical facility.
* Ability to interpret as\-built drawings, control narratives, and network diagrams specific to the site, and to identify discrepancies against current field conditions.
* Comfort working in a 24x7 critical facility environment, including responding to on\-call escalations as required.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to work directly with OEM technical support and field service engineers.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on field experience.
* Site\-specific OEM training/certification on the BMS or security platforms deployed at the facility.
* Prior experience in a site operations, facility engineering, or critical environment support role.



  





**Soft Skills** 




  




* Strong ownership mindset and responsiveness in live\-site, time\-sensitive situations.
* Clear, concise communication with site operations, NOC, and vendor teams during incidents.
* Ability to work independently on site while staying aligned with portfolio\-level design standards and reporting lines.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring initiatives move from concept and approval to implementation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior MoRD officials and coordinate across ministries, state governments, public institutions, financial institutions and implementation partners.
* Prepare senior\-level engagements and translate discussions into clear decisions and follow\-up actions.
* Manage and mentor the MoRD PMU team, maintaining a high bar for rigour, ownership and execution.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* 8–10 years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, strategy, transformation, public policy, economic development or a similar problem\-solving environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex programs end\-to\-end, from problem definition and solution design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the maturity to work with senior government officials, business leaders, financial institutions and experts.
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort working across policy, strategy and implementation.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an early\-stage organisation, with a strong interest in rural economic development and government\-led transformation.
* MBA or postgraduate degree from a leading institution is preferred, but not mandatory.

* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced environments, make decisions under ambiguity, and drive outcomes.

* PMP (Project Management Professional)

* Agile / Scrum Certifications

**Project Manager – Product \& Operations** 
**About the Job!!** 
**About Revin** 


 Revin is an award\-winning, IIT Palakkad\-incubated AgTech company building data\-driven, climate\-resilient agriculture solutions to help farms, institutions and agricultural stakeholders improve productivity, resource efficiency and decision\-making. 
 





 We combine AI, IoT, intelligent sensors, drones, computer vision and digital platforms to turn farms into data\-driven, climate\-resilient and commercially stronger enterprises.
 





 We are looking for a highly driven Project Manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, align multidisciplinary teams, and turn ambitious ideas into reliable, scalable outcomes.
 



**The Role** 


 As Project Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end execution of Revin’s digital product and hardware product initiatives.
 





 You will coordinate across software, hardware, product, agronomy, field operations, customers, and leadership to ensure that every project moves from planning to deployment with clarity, speed, and accountability.
 





 This is not a traditional coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think like an owner, anticipate problems, make informed decisions, and build the execution systems required for a growing startup.
 



**What You’ll Own** 
**Project Planning and Delivery (Agile)** 
* Plan and manage projects from start to completion.
* Set clear responsibilities, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and to the required quality.
* Keep teams focused on priorities and follow up until tasks are completed.


**Team Coordination** 
* Coordinate effectively across product, technology, field, and business teams.
* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be done, by whom, and by when.
* Conduct regular project meetings and maintain clear action points.
* Build accountability without unnecessary micromanagement.


**Day\-to\-Day Execution** 
* Lead sprint planning, team reviews, and regular progress discussions.
* Track deliverables, pending actions, risks, and dependencies.
* Identify delays early and take corrective action.
* Bring structure and clarity when priorities or requirements change.


**Stakeholder Communication** 
* Act as the primary point of contact for project\-related communication.
* Provide clear and timely updates to leadership, customers, and partners.
* Understand stakeholder expectations and convert them into actionable plans.
* Communicate challenges honestly, along with practical solutions.


**Deployment and Customer Success** 
* Coordinate product testing, customer deployment, training, and follow\-up.
* Ensure teams are prepared before every customer delivery or field implementation.
* Collect customer feedback and work with internal teams to address concerns.
* Ensure successful completion instead of treating deployment as the final step.


**Process Improvement** 
* Create simple systems for planning, documentation, reporting, and follow\-ups.
* Identify gaps and improve the way projects are executed.
* Reduce last\-minute confusion through better preparation and communication.
* Build processes that can support Revin as the company grows.


**Who We’re Looking For** 
* **A Startup\-Minded Executor**
* **An Outcome\-Driven Project Leader**
* **A Clear and Confident Communicator**
* **A Strong Team Coordinator**
* **An Organised and Accountable Professional**
* **An Adaptable and Fast Learner**


**Qualifications** 
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, Management, or a related discipline.
* **1–2 years of experience** 

 in project management, product operations, technical programme management, or startup execution.
* Practical experience working in a startup, product company, or fast\-moving technology environment is strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Agile and Scrum practices, sprint planning, backlog management, and iterative product delivery.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Linear, Notion, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with software engineers, hardware teams, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders.

description:

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Associate Director Project Management
description:

 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

 As an
 ***Associate Director, Project Management at Worley***
 , you play a pivotal role within our global organization. Your expertise will be crucial in determining methods and solutions for complex engineering challenges, ensuring the most efficient and economical approaches are employed to meet objectives. You will be recognized both within and outside the organization, operating at a regional to global level.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Expertise and Thought Leadership:**
* To plan, co\-ordinate and manage the design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of medium/large projects by directing a project manager or team of project managers/area managers depending upon scope and competency.
* To ensure clear agreement of client objectives and that these are met or exceeded.
* To achieve or better the budgeted gross margin.


**Specific Accountability**
 Direct the Integration of a Medium/Large Project
   

  

* Direct the implementation of all functions of project management.
* Direct the internal company environment to meet the needs of a Medium/large project.
* Direct the project through its development stages.


**Client Relationships**
* Identify, document, and communicate the client requirements.
* Effective management of multiple stakeholders.
* Maintain and build healthy client relationships throughout the project and post completion.
* Proactively resolve performance, scope, cost, and schedule issues with the Client as they arise, in conjunction with the Project Manager(s).


**Commercial Management**
* Effective management of Worley/Client contract, including delivery of the budget gross margin.


**Scope Management**
* Effective handover from Business Development Group.
* Clear definition of scope.
* Compliance with requirements of the contract.
* Effective change control process application.
* Manage and monitor project performance on an ongoing basis to identify issues and opportunities early and take pre\-emptive action.
* Effectively manages project interfaces, in conjunction with the Project Manager(s), including the use of High Value Engineering centres.


**Time Management**
* Direct the planning of all scope elements of the project, with the support of the Project Manager(s).
* Develop resource \& financial requirements from the project plan.
* Direct the management of the design, procurement, and construction activities to meet the project schedule.
* Ownership of the project schedule.
* Routine monitoring of the key reports and development of corrective action plans.
* Timely and effective documentation turnover and project close\-out.


**Cost Control**
* Direct the planning and preparation of accurate project estimates.
* Establish cost report for control of projects.
* Monitoring and control of all cost aspects of the project to forecast costs, obtain approvals, identify trends, and take action to avoid cost overruns and take advantage of opportunities
* Assess performance of cost control system \& personnel.


**Team Collaboration And Supervision**
* Provide clear and focussed leadership for the project team to create a vision for project success and a strategy to fit that vision.
* Define roles and responsibilities, in particular the respective roles of the Project Director vis a vis the Project Manager(s).
* Focus team on achievement of milestones and other key project objectives.
* Listen to the team, discuss the issues, resolve problems, and direct activities to remove roadblocks and achieve objectives.
* Participate in staff performance evaluations.
* Identify and implement training requirements.


**Project Execution And Quality Assurance**
* Define the project quality requirements.
* Ensure the right systems are in place and that these are applied on the project.
* Development of a project schedule which allows work to be executed in a logical sequence.
* Compliance with Worley policies and procedures.
* Implement lessons learned system.


**Documentation And Communication**
* Effective communications with the project team.
* Documented communication requirements.
* Accurate, timely \& effective progress reporting to the Client and internally to Worley management.
* Ongoing monitoring of the communication network between project staff, the client and third parties and introduction of changes where required.


**Specifications And Bid Activities**
* Ensure that clear objectives set for the design team.
* Assess the design activities and ensure a 'fit for purpose' design of the plant.
* Monitor design activities, interdisciplinary data flow and communications.


**Constructability, Operability, And Maintainability**
* Ensure that clear objectives set for the procurement and subcontracts team.
* Assess procurement process throughout the project to ensure goods meet specification, are delivered on time and are within budget.
* Set clear objectives for the Construction team.
* Monitor the Construction Management function to ensure safe delivery of the project within cost and schedule objectives.


**About You**
**Qualifications / Skill Set:**
* Relevant degree or equivalent qualification (Chartered Engineer preferable).
* Proven track record of working as a in the capacity of senior project manager for medium/large scale project (TIC 25 Min US$ and above)


**Professional Experience**
* Minimum 25 years of experience in the EPCM/EPC/Oil \& Gas industry, with strong onshore project exposure.
* Ability to direct a project, with the direct supervision and coordination provided by the Project Manager(s).
* Demonstrable commitment to HSE Management in a project environment.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* High level of customer focus.
* Previous experience as a Senior project manager / project manager on medium/large projects more than US$25m total value.


**Leadership And Project Management**
* Possesses leadership experience, having worked in project leadership roles, emphasizing the ability to drive successful project outcomes.
* Skilled in estimating project costs and writing proposal content, contributing to Worley's goals to be a leader in sustainability solutions.


**Health, Safety, And Environmental (HSE) Commitment**
* Work with project manager(s) to ensure that HSE requirements are documented and understood by all project participants.
* Compliance with HSE procedures.
* Maintain HSE focus for project duration.


**Results\-Oriented And Accountability**
* Achieves results set by self and others, meeting timelines, and pushing for stretch goals, reflecting Worley's commitment to delivering value over the life of assets.
* Demonstrates accountability for work produced, ensuring it is "right the first time," in line with Worley's promise to be the industry's straight\-talking partner.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**

**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 This role provides the project management and delivery\-tracking backbone for the Value \& Delivery \& Measurement team, reporting to the Manager (Value \& Delivery) – Enterprise AI. It runs the recurring cadence \- licence utilisation, return on investment and benefits tracking, and adoption reporting \- to a dependable rhythm rather than depending on one person, and provides hands\-on delivery coordination across the opportunity pipeline: tracking, scheduling, follow\-through and status reporting. This is a coordination and tracking role, distinct from the Medallion delivery team's project managers, who run the build and deployment of agentic solutions themselves; here, the focus is on keeping the value and delivery reporting cadence moving and the opportunity pipeline visible and on schedule.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Run the recurring reporting cycles \- weekly and monthly adoption, utilisation and value packs \- to a fixed calendar and a consistent standard, so measurement keeps running independent of any one person.
* Track licence utilisation across all seven tenants: assigned against available, active against assigned, and dormant licences identified for reclaim and recycling.
* Maintain return on investment and benefits tracking against agreed business cases \- baseline, actuals, variance \- and the evidence trail behind every claim.
* Provide hands\-on delivery coordination across the opportunity pipeline: tracking, scheduling, follow\-through and status reporting, keeping a live view of what's in flight and what's at risk.
* Administer use\-case intake and first\-pass scoring, flagging items that trip a governance guardrail, and keep the intake pipeline moving rather than stalling in the queue.
* Support the Manager on Viva Insights configuration and customisation: custom dashboards, group definitions, benchmark selection, and the retention and consistency views.
* Maintain a project\-level RAID log (risks, actions, issues, decisions) and status reporting for the Value \& Delivery team's own workstreams, escalating what needs the Manager's attention.


**What you'll need:** 
  

  

* Skills / Experience Requirements (Subject to change as per role title)
+ Four to six years in project or programme delivery, business analysis, or performance and benefits reporting, ideally coordinating multiple concurrent workstreams.
+ Comfortable working with usage and adoption data \- able to build, check and explain a set of numbers, not simply present them.
+ Strong data\-handling discipline; working Viva insight and Power BI capability or the aptitude to reach it quickly.
+ Analytical curiosity that goes past the surface: asks why this method, this platform, this formula, and can justify the answer.
+ Fast learner with a track record of absorbing new tooling and turning it into working output within weeks.
+ Problem framing from the stakeholder's perspective \- able to sit with a pain point and return options rather than obstacles.
+ Organised and structured: comfortable owning a calendar of recurring deliverables, a RAID log, and a status report, and keeping them current without being chased.
+ Excellent written English; self\-directed operating style with reliable overlap into London hours.
+ Comfortable moving between granular tracking work and a high\-level status conversation, and increasingly able to judge which the moment needs.

* Qualification Requirements (Desirable) (Subject to change as per role title)
+ Microsoft AZ\-900 and DP\-900 or equivalent cloud and data fundamentals; PMP, Prince2 or equivalent project/programme management certification is an advantage; prior involvement in a Copilot or Microsoft 365 rollout is an advantage.

 we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 As a Project Manager at Holmes AI, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving projects from initiation to completion. You will work closely with the leadership, technology, product, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the expected quality standards. The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, takes their work seriously, values the opportunity, and is comfortable working with flexibility in a fast\-paced startup environment. You should be highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of keeping multiple stakeholders aligned. A basic understanding of website development and technology projects is preferred. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding requirements, coordinating with technical teams, tracking progress, and identifying and escalating issues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and manage projects from planning and execution through completion.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate closely with the Tech/ Engineering team to ensure timely execution of development\-related projects.
* Manage website development projects at a superficial/project\-management level, including requirements, timelines, content, design, development, testing, and launch coordination.
* Translate business requirements into clear tasks and actionable deliverables for the relevant teams.
* Track project progress, identify delays or dependencies, and proactively drive resolution.
* Coordinate between leadership, technology, product, design, marketing, and other teams as required.
* Conduct regular project follow\-ups and ensure owners are accountable for their deliverables.
* Maintain project plans, trackers, documentation, meeting notes, and status updates.
* Identify project risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Coordinate testing and bug\-fixing activities with the Tech team before project releases.
* Track bugs and ensure they are assigned, prioritised, followed up on, and closed within agreed timelines.
* Ensure projects are delivered with the expected quality and attention to detail.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on project status, risks, timelines, and key decisions.
* Help establish and improve project management processes and ways of working as the company scales.
* Be flexible in handling changing priorities and take ownership of urgent or high\-priority requirements when needed. Required Skills \& Qualifications
* 3\+ years of experience in Project Management, Program Management, Operations, Product Operations, or a similar role.
* Strong project planning, coordination, execution, and follow\-up skills.
* Experience working with technology or software development teams.
* Basic understanding of website development and the overall software development lifecycle. ● Ability to understand requirements and convert them into clear tasks and timelines.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving blockers.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong working knowledge of project management and collaboration tools.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working in a B2B SaaS, AI, technology, or startup environment.
* Experience managing website development or software implementation projects.
* Basic understanding of APIs, frontend/backend development, QA/testing, and product releases.
* Experience coordinating with external vendors, developers, designers, or agencies.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and a bias toward action.



  





  





**What We Value** 




  





 At Holmes AI, we are looking for someone who sees this as more than just a job.
 



  





 We value someone who:
 



  




* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Takes the job seriously and is committed to delivering high\-quality work.
* Values the opportunity to work in an early\-stage, high\-growth company.
* Is dependable and follows through on commitments.
* Is comfortable working with flexibility when business priorities require it.
* Is proactive, resourceful, and willing to go beyond their defined responsibilities when required.
* Communicates openly and takes accountability for outcomes.
* Is comfortable working in an environment where things are being built, changed, and improved continuously.



  





  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
 


* Projects delivered on time and within agreed scope
* Project milestone and deadline adherence
* Timely coordination and follow\-up across teams
* Bug resolution and release readiness
* Project execution quality
* Stakeholder satisfaction and communication
* Timely identification and resolution of project blockers
* Documentation and project tracking accuracy
* Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and changing priorities
* Overall contribution to improving project execution and operational efficiency

title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**Brief Team/department Description**
 Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R\&D project management team, which coordinates cross\-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change\-inspired leader, to lead R\&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This role will report to the R\&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R\&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R\&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R\&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
   

  

 The role holder will lead cross\-functional initiatives to enhance R\&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology\-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R\&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement \& simplification opportunities.
   

  

 The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross\-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
   

  

**Principle Responsibilities**
* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO\-R\&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month\-on\-month project forecasts and manage CSO\-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R\&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R\&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co\-own the Long\-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R\&D opex, capex, and product\-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage\-wise Probability of Technical \& Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems \& processes:
* Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R\&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R\&D operational planning \- Lab space management, capex \& support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R\&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R\&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off\-the\-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in\-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting\-edge data tools and data\-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R\&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end\-to\-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in\-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R\&D / laboratory systems such as E\-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R\&D workflows
* Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on\-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R\&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R\&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems


**Qualifications/Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Master's degree preferred:
* MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
* MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
* Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
* PMP
* PgMP
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt


**Preferred Experience**
 15\-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:
   

  

**Project and Portfolio Management**
* At least 7\-10 years managing cross\-functional development programs.
* Experience with R\&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
* Experience leading governance meetings and stage\-gate reviews.


**Budget Management**
* Ownership or co\-ownership of departmental budgets.
* Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
* Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.


**Process and Organizational Change**
* Designing new departmental processes.
* Simplifying complex workflows.
* Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Creating governance models and decision\-making frameworks.
* Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Project Manager – RJIL Core Network Migration & Deployment Program
description:

**Role Summary**

* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between Cisco, RJIL, engineering teams, operations teams, and delivery partners.

* MOP Governance: Ensure all deployment and migration activities are supported by validated Methods of Procedure (MOPs), implementation plans, rollback procedures, and change approvals.
* Resource \& Vendor Coordination: Manage engineering teams, partner resources, shift schedules, and deployment readiness.
* Project Reporting: Track milestones, migration progress, issue logs, dependencies, and action items, delivering executive\-level status updates.
* Service Assurance: Ensure deployments are executed with minimal customer impact while maintaining network stability and operational excellence.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive lessons learned, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) governance, process optimization, and deployment automation initiatives.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 8 to 12 years of experience managing large\-scale Telecom or Service Provider network deployment and migration programs.
* Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of MPLS, BGP, OSPF/ISIS, Segment Routing, Core Network Architecture, and Service Provider Operations.
* Operational Expertise: Proven track record of managing critical maintenance windows, network cutovers, and high\-impact migration projects.
* Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams comprising Network Operations, Engineering, Vendors, and Customer stakeholders.
* Methodologies: Strong knowledge of Change Management, Risk Management, and Service Delivery Governance.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive reporting capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications including PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile.
* Direct experience working with RJIL or large telecom service providers.
* Familiarity with Cisco IOS\-XR environments and large\-scale core network migration programs.


**Core Expectations**
* Guarantee successful program execution within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Drive minimal customer impact during maintenance windows and cutovers.
* Maintain rigorous governance over MOP approvals, deployment readiness, and rollback planning.
* Provide decisive leadership during critical deployment events and major service\-impact incidents.
* Foster strong collaboration across planning, execution, operations, and customer stakeholder teams.

-------------


The Artwork Planning Lead is a leadership role responsible for overseeing and coordinating multiple packaging artwork projects, from design through to print production, for a leading Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) client. With minimum 7 years of experience and a strong background in project management, this individual will lead cross\-functional meetings to align priorities, allocate resources effectively, and enhance artwork management efficiency.

* Lead and oversee the multiple packaging artwork projects from design through to print package.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal teams (marketing, design, R\&D, regulatory, supply chain) and external stakeholders (agencies, printers, suppliers).
* Sets agenda, and clearly defines cross\-functional responsibilities from project start to completion.
* Facilitate regular communication to ensure alignment on project objectives and deliverables.
* Maintain up\-to\-date records of project progress using project management tools and spreadsheets. This includes tracking milestones, deliverables, and any deviations from the original plan.
* Identify risks, bottlenecks, or delays in the artwork development process and implement solutions to mitigate them.
* Compile regular artwork project reports that highlight progress, challenges, and solutions. Communicate these findings to seniors and cross\-functional teams to keep everyone informed and engaged.
* Manage feedback loops, consolidating inputs to minimize iterations and maintain efficiency.
* Act as a mentor/coach for associate artwork planning leads and planning coordinators.

----------------


* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, , project management, or a related field.

* 7\+ years of experience in artwork management, packaging, or project management within a CPG or FMCG environment.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment across multiple functions (marketing, R\&D, sourcing, design external agencies and operations)
* Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, Trello, Monday.com, or Jira is crucial for tracking tasks, deadlines, and progress.
* Familiarity in artwork and design software is beneficial; while direct design involvement is not required, a basic understanding of platforms like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) can enhance communication with creative teams.
* Possess strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Highly collaborative, with strong experience working with Global \& Local stakeholders

* Excellent interpersonal, written \& verbal communication skills

* We’re committed to ensure that people of all backgrounds feel encouraged and have a sense of belonging at Capgemini. You are valued for who you are, and you can bring your original self to work.
* Every Monday, kick off the week with a musical performance by our in\-house band \- The Rubber Band. Also get to participate in internal sports events, yoga challenges, or marathons.

 The RFP Delivery Manager owns execution of AART’s RFP portfolio while serving as a strategic and writing partner to the Vice President. This role is accountable for end\-to\-end delivery, content quality, and day\-to\-day decision\-making across all pursuits.
 



 The role combines delivery leadership, healthcare and business acumen, writing ownership, and effective use of AI in the proposal process. It is not a coordination\-only role.
