title: Program Manager
description:
You can become a part of …
 



 Founded in 2018, BharatPe is one of India's fastest\-growing fintech companies, offering a comprehensive suite of financial products and services. What began as a single interoperable QR code has grown into a platform used by over 1 crore merchants across the country.
 



 At our core, we exist to drive financial inclusion and accessibility for the real Bharat, which is underserved by traditional finance and held back by complexity, paperwork, and products never designed for it. We are changing that, by building simple, accessible financial tools that meet people where they are, in the language they speak and at the scale they need.
 



 For our merchant partners, we provide an integrated ecosystem spanning QR and PoS payments, working capital credit, and deposit and investment products, enabling small businesses to accept payments, access finance, and grow. For consumers, we are building a fast\-growing set of offerings across UPI payments, Credit on UPI (BharatPe Flex), Personal Loans, and Invest (Digital Gold, Digital Silver, Fixed Deposits, and Mutual Funds), giving them a single place to pay, borrow, and grow their money.
 



 Together, these two sides of our business form a single mission: to bring the full power of digital finance to every merchant and every consumer across India, not just the few who have always had access. Alongside the business, we are equally committed to building an organization where people take genuine ownership, do their most meaningful work, and see their ideas realized at a national scale.
 



 We value diversity, and we encourage different points of view, ways of thinking, and new capabilities to strengthen and improve the lives of our customers. And that is not all. We have a lot of fun while we explore new ideas, solve real problems, collaborate, and connect, and we do it all together.
 



 Connect with us over social media, coffee, or a call. We would welcome the opportunity to tell you more.
 



 In this role, you have the opportunity to …
 



  Develop and implement strategies to ensure BharatPe’s merchant growth and TPV (GMV)
 



  Analyze market data and trends to drive data driven decisions
 



  Work closely with a team of dynamic and professional individuals
 



  





 Responsibilities will include …
 



 This role is part of the Central Merchant platform \& Growth vertical. The overall objective of this vertical is to identify and operationalize new products/ services/ initiatives that lead to growth in merchant platform and create new revenue streams.
 



  





 Functional Expertise
 



  





 DIY Merchant Network Growth
 



  End\-to\-End Lifecycle Management: Drive the acquisition, retention, and reactivation of merchants across the DIY (Do\-It\-Yourself) network.
 



  Performance Marketing: Design, execute, and optimize performance marketing campaigns to accelerate user acquisition and improve conversion funnels.
 



  Churn Reduction: Identify drop\-off points in the merchant journey and deploy data\-backed reactivation strategies to maximize merchant Lifetime Value (LTV).
 



  Launch in app \& call center campaigns to activate merchants \& grow Bharatpe network
 



  





 QR Initiatives \& Enterprise Partnerships
 



  QR Penetration: Spearhead offline initiatives to drastically increase BharatPe’s brand visibility and market share of QR placements across target geographies. Also plan launch of new QR form factors pan India.
 



  GTM \& Project Management: Own the Go\-To\-Market strategy and end\-to\-end project management for launching co\-branded QR products with enterprise partners.
 



  Partnership Scaling: Work closely with external enterprise partners to ensure smooth onboarding, compliance, and mutual business growth.
 



  QR migration: Work on QR migration exercise by replacing QRs of 1 acquiring bank with another.
 



 Ad Sales \& Monetization
 



  Digital Ad Execution: Launch and manage digital advertisements sourced from external partners directly on the BharatPe Merchant App.
 



  Creative Implementation: Oversee the operational pipeline of getting ad creatives from partners, ensuring quality checks, and seamlessly deploying them on the app in coordination with the tech and product teams.
 



  Performance Tracking: Monitor ad campaign performance, optimize for impressions/clicks, and report ROI to partners and internal stakeholders.
 



  





 Stakeholder Management \& Strategy
 



  Cross\-Functional Leadership: Serve as the strategic bridge between Marketing, Finance, Legal, Product, Tech, Sales, and executive leadership.
 



  Coordinate between and work closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Tech, Marketing, and Data Science team to implement the defined products \& services, and drive GTM and growth
 



  Work closely with Product team to implement new product features and use cases
 



  Collaborate with Marketing team to design \& run communications and campaigns targeting specific cohorts and objectives
 



  Executive Reporting: Distill complex operational metrics into clear, actionable CXO\-level summaries and highly polished presentation decks (slides).
 



  Data \& Dashboards: Build, automate, and maintain robust spreadsheets and dashboards to track KPIs across all your active charters.
 



  





 To succeed in the role
 



  





 Impact
 



  This role involves driving DIY active merchant growth, increase Network’s active QR per merchant and launching new QR form factors in the market. It also involves growing Bharatpe merchant TPV (GMV) \& active merchants with help of enterprise partnerships.
 



  Launch new initiatives to realize growth of DIY merchant network \& scale brand image of Bharatpe by launching more \& diverse QR form factors in market
 



  Enhance BharatPe’s market presence among target segments
 



  





 Qualification \& Experience
 



 (type \& industry)
 



  Graduate or Post\-Graduate degree; MBA from a Tier 1 College will be plus
 



  4 to 8 years of experience; with recent stints in a Growth/ Project management/Product role with a strong Business aspect
 



  Ideal profile would be a combination of prior Consulting/Strategy experience plus experience in a startup/growth setup
 



  Prior experience in a Fintech is a strong plus
 



  





 Skills \& know\-how
 



  Strong problem solving and analytical skills
 



  Strong stakeholder management \& project management skills
 



  Good communication, with ability to synthesize and present to leadership/ larger team
 



  Strong Excel and PowerPoint skill
 



  Data Science and SQL is a plus
 



  





 Behaviors
 



 Go getter attitude; self\-starter with strong inclination to take initiative
 



  Sharp learning curve, and leverage problem\-solving skills to question \& build
 



  Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, and handle ambiguity

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**About Toyota Connected:** 




 If you want to change the way the world works, transform the automotive industry and positively impact others on a global scale, then Toyota Connected is the right place for you! Within our collaborative, fast\-paced environment we focus on continual improvement and work in a highly iterative way to deliver exceptional value in the form of connected products and services that wow and delight our customers and the world around us. Come help us re\-imagine what mobility can be today and for years to come!
 



**Job Description:** 




**SDV Strategy \& Roadmap** 



* Define TKM's SDV vision, roadmap, and execution plan in alignment with TMC and global Toyota strategy
* Translate business goals into prioritised SDV initiatives and milestones
* Drive phased execution across platform, applications, and lifecycle capabilities, benchmarking OEM strategies to keep the roadmap competitive



**Cross\-Functional Program Planning** 



* Identify priority SDV use cases (infotainment, OTA, digital key, VUI, connected services) with business, product, and engineering teams
* Define KPIs and success metrics, and ensure alignment across vehicle engineering, IT, and digital teams
* Establish program governance, milestones, and reporting mechanisms



**SDV Architecture \& Platform Planning** 



* Partner with engineering on SDV architecture (central compute, zonal, cloud integration) and the vehicle OS, middleware, API, and OTA stack
* Ensure alignment with global SDV platforms (Arene, QNX, Android, cloud ecosystems)
* Facilitate decoupling of hardware and software layers



**Ecosystem \& Partner Alignment** 



* Coordinate with global stakeholders (TMC, Woven, TMNA, TRI), Tier\-1 suppliers (Denso, Panasonic, AISIN), and technology partners
* Drive joint roadmap planning and integration alignment across the partner ecosystem



**Connected Operations \& Lifecycle Management** 



* Define lifecycle capabilities: OTA updates, feature enablement/disablement, subscription models, and feature monetisation
* Establish frameworks for release management, feature rollout, and post\-launch performance monitoring
* Use data\-driven insights to drive continuous improvement



**Business Case \& Value Realization** 



* Build ROI models covering cost reduction (ECU consolidation, software reuse) and new revenue (subscriptions, feature unlocks)
* Align the SDV roadmap with vehicle volumes, pricing strategy, and customer lifetime value



**Capability Building** 



* Identify gaps and drive capability development in SDV engineering (embedded, cloud, DevOps), tools, and testing frameworks
* Support creation of SDV labs, prototyping, and simulation environments



**You are a successful candidate if you:** 



* 10\+ years in automotive product planning, program management, or strategy — preferably with OEM or Tier\-1 experience in connected/SDV domains
* Bachelor’s in engineering (Computer Science, Electronics, or Automotive); MBA or equivalent business exposure preferred
* Understanding of SDV architecture — central compute, zonal ECUs, OTA, vehicle OS, and cloud integration concepts
* Experience driving cross\-functional programs spanning business, engineering, IT, and digital teams across multiple stakeholders
* Proven ability to build and execute technology roadmaps aligned with global platforms and localised for regional markets
* Experience with connected\-vehicle lifecycle management — OTA release planning, feature enablement, and post\-launch performance analytics
* Business acumen to build ROI models — ECU consolidation savings, subscription revenue, feature monetisation, and lifecycle value
* Excellent stakeholder management and program governance — experience with Japanese OEM culture, global affiliates, and cross\-region structures; able to define KPIs and report to senior leadership (familiarity with platform partnerships such as QNX, Android Automotive a plus)



**What is in it for you?** 



* Top of the line compensation!
* You'll be treated like the professional we know you are and left to manage your own time and workload.
* Yearly gym membership reimbursement \& Free catered lunches.
* No dress code! We trust you are responsible enough to choose what’s appropriate to wear for the day.
* Opportunity to build products that improves the safety and convenience of millions of customers
* Cool office space and other awesome benefits!



**Our Core Values: EPIC:** 




**Empathetic:** 
 We begin making decisions by looking at the world from the perspective of our customers, teammates, and partners.
 



**Passionate:** 
 We are here to build something great, not just for the money. We are always looking to improve the experience of our millions of customers
 



**Innovative:** 
 We experiment with ideas to get to the best solution. Any constraint is a challenge, and we love looking for creative ways to solve them.
 



**Collaborative:** 
 When it comes to people, we think the whole is greater than its parts and that everyone has a role to play in the success!
 



 To know more about us, check out our Glassdoor page\-https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Reviews/TOYOTA\-Connected\-Corporation\-Reviews\-E3305334\.htm

title: Program Manager
description:
**Full\-Time \| On\-site \|** Bengaluru


As the Program Manager for Digiicampus, you will drive end\-to\-end delivery across multiple modules, connecting customer insights with engineering execution and ensuring strong product adoption. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Product, Development, and Marketing to turn institutional requirements into impactful solutions for **Parents, Students, Teachers, and Administrators**.


This is a full\-time, high\-ownership role focused on delivery, stakeholder alignment, customer satisfaction, and high NPS.

  


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


**Requirements Gathering \& Discovery**
---------------------------------------


* Own the end\-to\-end requirements gathering process by working closely with the Customer Success SPOC to understand institution\-specific needs, workflows, and pain points across all four stakeholder groups.
* Translate customer conversations and feedback into structured, unambiguous Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) that the development team can act on immediately.

**Coordination \& Delivery Management**
---------------------------------------


* Serve as the primary bridge between the Customer Success team and the development team, ensuring requirements are communicated clearly, dependencies are tracked, and delivery timelines are met.

* Author detailed, customer\-friendly Release Notes for every feature or update shipped, ensuring accuracy and clarity for institutional stakeholders.

**Feature Adoption \& Product Health**
--------------------------------------


* Monitor which modules and features are actively being used by educational institutions, and proactively investigate gaps — understanding why certain features aren’t being adopted and bringing these insights back to the product and CS teams.
* Define and track success metrics including NPS, module adoption rates, and support ticket trends to continuously measure customer satisfaction and product health.

* 3–6 years of experience in a Program Manager, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role, preferably in a SaaS or technology product environment.

* Strong coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as JIRA, ClickUp, Asana, or equivalent.
* A structured, process\-oriented mindset with a strong bias for timely delivery and follow\-through.


**Good to Have**
----------------


* Prior experience in EdTech or working with educational institution customers.
* Exposure to Figma or ability to read and interpret design wireframes.
* Experience crafting release notes or customer\-facing product communications.
* Understanding of feature adoption tracking and basic product analytics concepts.
* Genuine interest in education and the impact technology can have on learning outcomes and institute operations.


**Digii's Commitment to You**
-----------------------------


* Make a real impact on how educational institutions across India operate.
* Competitive pay and an open, high\-trust culture built on passion and excellence.
* Learn and collaborate with top entrepreneurs, technologists, and education leaders.
* Grow with the organisation as projects scale across multiple customers.
* Performance is measured by impact, not hours.

title: Program Manager
description:
**Role Title:** 
**Program Manager / Sr. Program Manager**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India (Primary site leadership responsibility); relocation provided if need
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Executive Leadership \- Managing Director India Operations
   

  

**About This Role**
 Veradigm India has a lot of transformation underway. AI\-augmented capability hub building, integrated operations and operational excellence, talent development and culture building programs \- each with its own stakeholders, timelines, and interdependencies. What we need is someone who can hold all of that together.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue across Veradigm India's most important initiatives. You will partner with the key stakeholders, keep the assigned programs on track, surface risks before they become problems, and make sure the MD India has an accurate picture of where things stand.
   

  

 This role carries real strategic weight. You will be the person who ensures that Veradigm India's most important transformation programs do not just get started \- they get finished, on time, to the standard we set, with measurable outcomes. You will need to read situations accurately to inform and influence senior stakeholders. The right person for this role has key awareness of organizational culture, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, persistent, and politically aware \- someone who brings structure to complexity and credibility to every room they walk into.
   

  

 In essence, this role will drive execution of one or more major programs (strategic project or a group of strategically aligned projects), ensuring that commitments are delivered on time, within scope, to budget, and to the required quality standards. Operating at the most senior level with customers and/or internal stakeholders; managing business changes and implementing business strategies to meet the goals and objectives of the organization and our clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with HRBP and Culture leads to program\-manage Veradigm India’s associate culture building programs \- including culture and fun initiatives, sports and wellness, communication skill\-building, and other engagement initiatives \- owning the program plan, tracking milestones, coordinating across stakeholders, and reporting outcomes to MD India.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to program\-manage Veradigm India’s CSR and sustainability commitments \- ensuring initiatives are scoped, funded, tracked, and delivered with the same rigor as internal transformation programs, and that impact is documented and visible to leadership and the broader organization.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to program\-manage the campus hiring program \- maintaining the calendar, coordinating between TA and business leaders, monitoring execution quality, and flagging risks before they slip.
* Partner with the India Leadership Team to coordinate cross\-functional transformation workstreams \- capability building, operational improvement, and strategic initiatives \- take on program management of the execution\-heavy workstreams, bringing structure, tracking, and stakeholder coordination from kickoff through delivery \- ensuring each has a clear plan, an active owner, and is on track to deliver.
* Maintain a single, reliable view of all India transformation programs \- milestones, risks, decisions, and open items \- that executive leadership can trust at any point in time.
* Facilitate governance forums and working sessions that are purposeful: right people in the room, decisions made, actions assigned and followed through.
* Define and document program scope, objectives, and success metrics at program launch. Manage scope changes and escalate impact on timelines or deliverables as needed.
* Prepare crisp, decision\-ready program updates for executive leadership \- calibrated to what the audience needs to act, not just status summaries.
* Identify and escalate risks early, with context and a proposed path forward. Drive continuous improvement in how programs are planned and executed across India Operations.


**Success Metrics**
 Within 12 months, this Program Manager will be expected to demonstrate:
   

  

* Programs delivered on time and within scope \- with milestones tracked, risks surfaced early, and no surprises to leadership.
* All three workstreams (AI\-augmented capability hub building, integrated operations and operational excellence, talent development \& culture building programs) have active plans, clear owners, and status visible to MD India at any time.
* Governance cadence in place at a program level \- working sessions are purposeful, decisions are logged, and actions are followed through within agreed timelines.
* Stakeholder partners (HRBP, TA, ILT, Operations and Transformation) report that coordination is adding value \- reducing friction, not creating it.
* Executive updates and program communications are consistently clear, accurate, and decision\-ready \- not followed up for clarification.
* Risks and issues are raised proactively, with a recommended path forward \- not surfaced after they have already become problems.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
**Experience**
* 3\+ years of cross\-functional program management work experience
* Experience in healthcare, health tech, SaaS, IT services, or regulated industries strongly preferred
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2 or similar project management certification will be added advantage


**Key Skills And Leadership Traits**
* Can hold ten things at once and not drop any of them. Multi\-program coordination is the core of this role.
* Knows how to build a clean workplan, run a useful governance meeting, and write a crisp executive update \- without being asked twice for any of them.
* Metrics driven – drives measurable and outcomes driven processes
* Good at working with people, not around them. Your job is to help partners succeed, not to take their work over.
* Communicate at the right level for the right audience. Your executive update is sharp and to the point. Your working session with a team lead is detailed and collaborative.
* Can hold stakeholders accountable. You know how to follow up without making people feel managed.
* Well versed how to use LLM tools including Claude and is capability of augmenting work with AI .

**Education**

* Tier\-I institute will be preferred (results matter more than resumes)


**Our Values**
 We talk about values a lot at Veradigm. But we mean them as operating principles, not wall art. Here is what they look like in practice.
   

  

* Better Starts with Different: The best thinking at Veradigm has always come from people who see things differently. We are not looking for conformity. We are looking for perspective.
* Unreasonably High Standards: We set the bar high \- not because we enjoy pressure, but because the work we do affects real patients and real clinicians. That matters.
* Outcomes that Matter: We are not here to be busy. We are here to move things. If the work is not making a real difference, we ask why and we change it.
* Make Decisions and Own Them: We do not hide behind process or wait for permission. We make the call, we own what happens next, and we correct course when we need to.
* No Silos, No Handoffs: When something needs to get done at Veradigm, the right answer is never 'that is not my team.' We stay in the conversation until it is resolved.


**Benefits**
 Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.
   

  

* Quarterly Company\-Wide Recharge Days

Reporting \& Analytics: Executive dashboards, KPIs, and datadriven insights

Help track project financials, monitor expenses, and ensure resources are used efficiently.


Communication: Effective communication skills. Establish/conduct regular cadence with the PMO Process Lead and the Area Project Manager. Help raise issues needing attention around project hygiene, staffing, quality, risks, and issues.

Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 3\+ years' experience in project management.

OR equivalent experience.

Escalates issues to Area Project Manager. Adheres to quality assurance standards. Leverages standard tools as directed to align with engagement hygiene standards. Active PMP/CAPM certification Familiarity with Azure Dev Ops Exposure to LLM and agentic AI

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Program Manager - Settlement Operations, Settlement Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is a fast paced, dynamic company with an ambition to be the world's most customer centric company in the world. Within Amazon India, Amazon's Payments team supports hundreds of millions of customers and millions of merchants in their payment needs by providing the most trusted, convenient and rewarding payment experience. We aspire to make Digital Payments accessible to every Indian. The Transaction Settlement Unit (TSU), part of the Payments team, Manages payment reconciliation for Amazon India’s Escrow and nodal accounts. This role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and finance. The responsibilities include:  

  

* Ensuring transactions in the PPI Escrow and Nodal accounts are compliant with regulatory guidelines
* Managing end\-to\-end reconciliation to identify discrepancies, establish root causes, and drive resolution through cross\-functional stakeholder coordination
* Forecasting cash requirements, monitoring fund sufficiency in escrow accounts, and coordinating with Treasury, Finance, and business teams to ensure uninterrupted fund availability
* Front\-ending regulatory and statutory audits for escrow accounts and reporting to the regulator
* Preparing leadership updates and writing business requirement documents (BRDs) to define and drive automation and process improvement initiatives
* Conducting UAT and providing launch support to ensure business readiness for new system deployments

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Manage the planning, execution, and delivery of reconciliation programs, ensuring timely resolution of financial discrepancies and compliance with established processes of Nodal and Escrow accounts
* Conduct deep dives into transaction data and financial metrics to identify anomalies, root causes, and opportunities for process improvements


\-Monthly substantiation\- Daily identification, deep dive, escalation and closure of exceptions by partnering with various world\-wide teams  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including finance, operations, and technology teams to align on project goals, mitigate delivery risks, and drive consensus on solutions
* Lead internal and external and regulatory audits of these accounts
* Advise business teams in launch of new products and capabilities w.r.t potential impact on these accounts
* Closely work with accounting and finance to ensure accurate representation in entity accounts
* Drive continuous improvement and automation
* Ensure ongoing compliance with guidelines and become backup of processes to ensure business continuity.

  

A day in the life  

Each day brings new challenges in transaction settlement operations. You might start your morning analyzing settlement data to identify reconciliation gaps, then transition to facilitating a working session with accounting and technology partners to resolve a complex discrepancy. Your afternoons could involve updating stakeholders on program status, documenting process improvements, or diving into financial metrics to surface potential risks before they impact operations. You'll work closely with team members who value analytical rigor and collaborative problem\-solving.  

  

About the team  

The Transaction Settlement Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining the financial integrity of Amazon's transactions. We work at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, solving complex reconciliation challenges at scale.  

  

Our culture values precision, innovation, and collaboration. We're building the future of settlement operations by implementing automated solutions and refining processes that handle millions of transactions. Join a team where your analytical skills and program management expertise will directly contribute to operational excellence and financial accuracy.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams
* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification preferred.

description:
**Description**
 Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company? If so, come join us at Amazon.
   

  

 ShipTech is the connective tissue, which connects Transportation Service Providers, First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile to facilitate the shipping of billions of packages each year. Our mission is to be a partner and enabler to Amazon Operations by improving shipment tracking logic and capabilities for different legs of logistics, customer messaging, validation of transportation milestones, enable logic for automated shipment workflows and improve quality of shipment tracking within and outside Amazon partners. This role gives an opportunity to work closely with Business team, Operations stakeholders, Tech teams, recipient experience teams and Senior Leaders to manage and deliver for Amazon businesses.

* Drive improvement in worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones.

 A day in the life
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be detail\-oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple stakeholders at once, able to work independently, and maintain professionalism under pressure. This role will need to have knowledge in analytical skills and in excel. The Program Manager will be passionate about their work, detail\-oriented, and have good problem\-solving abilities. You will work closely with Program, M\&E, and Technology teams to ensure accurate, timely reporting aligned with organisational and donor requirements.
   

  

**Approximately**

**30% – M and E Systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
**30% – Data Analysis, Quality Checks \& Program Monitoring**
**20% – Data Collection and Management**

* Identify trends, gaps and areas requiring improvement or corrective action.
* Conduct field visits as and when required


**Data Management**

* Design and implement effective data collection protocols and processes for various programs, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and consistency.
* Ensure all data collection, storage and management follow data privacy and protection protocols.
* Coordinate with field/program teams on data requirements, data collection challenges, and gaps

**Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**

* Provide M and E data and platform related technical support.
* building program teams capacity to collect, manage, and use data effectively
* Participate in team meetings, sharing insights, providing recommendations, and keeping staff informed on documentation and data management practices.

**What Success Looks Like**
* Program documentation is current, complete, and audit\-ready at all times.
* Data collection systems are consistently used by field teams with high accuracy and minimal errors.
* Donor reports are submitted on time with clear evidence of impact and no discrepancies flagged.
* Leadership has timely, reliable data to make informed decisions about program strategy and resource allocation.

**What’s Hard About This Role**

* Travelling across rural and urban locations in India to support field teams and ensure data quality at source.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS**
* You will be the evidence backbone of programs that directly impact millions of children and adults with disabilities across four states.
* Your data systems and insights will determine how Sol’s ARC grows, adapts, and advocates for systemic change.
* You will build deep expertise in program M\&E, data management, and development sector reporting.
* You will grow within an organisation that values transparency, equity, and bold social impact.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Technical Project Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Head Office) \| Work from the office
 



  





**Experience:** 
 5 to 8 years
 



  





**Gynoveda** 
 is India's first Ayurveda fertility healthcare company. 50\+ clinics across India. 100\+ doctors—20,000\+ babies born through our treatment. We treat period health, PCOS, and infertility at the root cause, and we are expanding.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 The architecture is decided. The agency builds. You make sure what they build is right.
 



  





 You convert the blueprint into agency deliverables. You review the code and design that comes back. You catch what is wrong before it goes live. You run delivery sprint by sprint. You manage a team of two, a DevOps Engineer and a Website Specialist, and you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 This role needs range, not one deep specialty. ERP, integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, websites. You have worked hands\-on across most of these earlier in your career. Now you can review and question all of them without building any—one person, holding the entire stack accountable.
 



  





 We run on off\-the\-shelf tools, configured well. Custom development is the exception. If your first instinct is to build from scratch, this role is not for you. If your first instinct is to check whether the vendor configured the existing tool correctly, apply.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  




* Technical review of all agency deliverables: code, architecture, quality gates
* The integration layer connecting our systems: specification, build oversight, testing, go\-live
* Website platform evaluation, migration, and optimization
* Marketing technology integrations, validated with the marketing team
* Infrastructure decisions, executed through the DevOps Engineer
* Tool evaluation and recommendations across the stack
* Sprint tracking and delivery coordination with the agency



  





**What You Will Not Own:** 




  





 Product roadmap. ERP workflow design. BI strategy. Agency commercials. These sit with the founders and other leaders. You are the technical authority on delivery, not the strategist deciding what gets built.
 



  





**What You Must Bring:** 




  




* 5 to 8 years in technology roles, minimum 3 years managing outsourced development teams or agencies
* Vendor review experience with proof: you have found real problems in agency code or architecture and can walk us through specific examples
* ERP implementation or configuration on any major platform (ERPNext, Odoo, Zoho One, SAP Business One, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, or similar). ERP thinking matters more than the platform name.
* Database evaluation: schema design, query performance, MariaDB or Postgres familiarity
* Cloud infrastructure literacy, AWS preferred. Able to evaluate decisions even if not hands\-on daily.
* Integration patterns: APIs, webhooks, ETL, event\-based flows
* Experience where end users are non\-tech staff in physical locations: clinics, hospitals, retail, warehouses
* Configure first. Build only when configuration genuinely cannot solve it.



  





**This Role Is Not for You If:** 




  




* You manage timelines and status reports but have never personally reviewed vendor code or architecture
* You cannot recall a specific instance where you caught a vendor's technical mistake
* Your 90\-day plan centers on building a new product or app
* You have only managed in\-house engineering teams, never an agency or vendor
* You are a coder first. This role reviews and directs. It does not build.
* You have depth in one layer and no working knowledge of the rest



  





**Why Join:** 




  




* One person's technical judgment governs the entire stack. That person is you.
* Founders sit in daily operations. Decisions move in days, not quarters.
* The systems you keep honest serve real patients across 50\+ clinics.
* The network is expanding fast. The technology spine is being built now, under your watch.\|

title: Senior Program Manager, Global Quality Ops - Platform Integrity
description:
**About the Role**  

  

The PI Quality Operations team will own the end\-to\-end quality operating rhythm across the PI BPO footprint within the GSO network, including quality audits, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), calibrations, quality score governance, insight generation, and quality improvement interventions . The team's mandate is to ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, trusted, and actionable , while identifying the key drivers of performance and translating quality data into clear actions that improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
  

  

The Quality Operations Manager \- Platform Integrity (PI) will lead this team of approximately 5\-7 Quality S\-ladder team members and be accountable for the overall health and performance of PI Quality Operations. The manager will partner closely with BPO Operations, Vendor Management, Training, Program, Policy, Product, Analytics, and Global Quality stakeholders to strengthen quality governance, address systemic performance gaps, and ensure quality insights lead to measurable improvements in frontline execution.
  

  

**What You'll Do*** Own PI Quality performance across the BPO network , driving sustained improvement in Quality scores and building clear recovery plans for underperforming sites, queues, or agent populations.
* Ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, and trusted by owning audit governance, sampling effectiveness, evaluator accuracy, score integrity, and scoring consistency across the network.
* Lead audit, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), and calibration programs to improve evaluator accuracy, reduce scoring variance, and strengthen alignment across internal and BPO Quality teams.
* Turn Quality data into actionable insights by identifying key defect drivers, conducting root\-cause analysis, and translating findings into targeted actions that improve agent performance.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Operations, Training, Policy, Program, Product, and Analytics to address systemic Quality issues and improve processes, tooling, scorecards, and frontline execution.
* Drive continuous improvement and scalability by simplifying, standardizing, and improving Quality operating mechanisms across sites, markets, languages, and lines of business.

**Basic Qualifications*** 6\+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Operations within BPO, contact center, customer support, trust \& safety, risk operations, or a comparable high\-volume service environment.
* Experience managing Quality professionals and demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and performance\-manage a team.
* Demonstrated experience improving Quality scores through structured root\-cause analysis and operational interventions rather than solely monitoring or reporting performance.
* Strong understanding of Quality measurement integrity , including scoring consistency, inter\-rater reliability, evaluator variance, sampling methodology, and calibration.
* Proven ability to analyze Quality data, identify performance drivers, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into improvement plans.
* Strong understanding of BPO operating environments, including vendor governance, performance management, SLAs/KPIs, corrective action planning, and multi\-site operations.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and demonstrated ability to influence teams outside of direct reporting lines.
* Experience working with Quality monitoring platforms, CRM/customer\-service systems, and business intelligence or reporting tools such as NICE, Observe.AI, Tableau, Looker, Data Studio, or comparable platforms .

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience building or redesigning Quality scorecards, sampling strategies, calibration frameworks, or Quality governance models.
* Experience using statistical or analytical techniques to evaluate scoring reliability, performance variation, and Quality trends..
* Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or other Quality/process\-improvement certification is advantageous.
* Multilingual experience or experience supporting multilingual Quality operations is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**  

  

Success in this role means:
* PI Quality scores show sustained and measurable improvement.
* Quality scores are **trusted by Operations and BPO partners** as an accurate representation of frontline performance.
* Audit and ATA accuracy remain consistently high across the network.
* Evaluator variance decreases, and calibration alignment improves.
* Quality insights consistently identify the highest\-impact performance opportunities and lead to concrete operational action.
Quality interventions demonstrate measurable improvement in agent behavior and performance.  
* 

  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.

title: Program Manager II, ECR, NOC ECR
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.  

  

The individual in this role will own defined workstreams within the ECR program charter, collaborating with program, product, tech, BI, and Science partners to execute, validate, and deploy customer experience capabilities. This role will coordinate with teams across IN Ops to support the launch and adoption of bespoke product solutions within their assigned scope. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing moderate complexity and ambiguity. Successful candidates will have experience in Program Management, comfort working with cross\-organizational stakeholders, and the ability to manage competing priorities with appropriate escalation.  

  

As a Program Manager, you will own and deliver well\-defined workstreams and projects by coordinating with cross\-disciplinary teams to execute customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by understanding the broader vision, aligning your workstream to it, and driving execution — proactively identifying risks, flagging escalations, making day\-to\-day trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must decompose assigned projects into clear deliverables with functional specifications and execute them on time with minimal oversight. Good judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence peers and partner teams are essential. Working knowledge of data analysis and SQL is expected. The role will also be expected to support Generative AI adoption within ECR — including implementing automated case summarization, contributing to pattern recognition for thematic defects, and supporting predictive escalation routing — executing on identified Gen AI opportunities that augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.  

  

They will be responsible for driving VP inquiries to closure within SLA with clear articulation of issue and recommended initiatives to arrest the root cause of the defect. They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.  

  

They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.  

  

They will implement and iterate on Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines — executing on use cases identified and scoped by leadership

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Program Manager II (Cost To Serve), RBS : Cost To Serve
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Associate - Project Manager
description:
Job Description: EXL is seeking a hands\-on analytics implementation engineer to execute audit and QA work across web and app properties for a multi\-brand digital client. The role is responsible for running event validation, querying BigQuery for data quality issues, validating mobile tracking payloads, and maintaining tracking documentation throughout the engagement. This is an execution and delivery role for someone who is rigorous about accuracy, thorough in documentation, and comfortable working across GA4, GTM, AppsFlyer, and BigQuery.


  
Responsibilities: • Execute web audit checklist items: walk through each customer journey using GTM Preview and the browser DevTools network tab — product view, add to cart, checkout, purchase, sign\-in, and form submission. For each step, confirm the correct event fires with the right parameters.
  

• Validate GA4 events in DebugView: confirm event name, required parameters, correct data types, and absence of PII in parameter values.
  

• Run BigQuery data quality queries: surface (not set) volumes in source and medium, purchase events with missing values, duplicate events, and parameters that do not match the tracking spec.
  

• Support AppsFlyer event validation: cross\-reference AppsFlyer event logs against the tracking spec and document any discrepancies with evidence.
  

• Log all findings in the audit tracker: surface, category, root cause, evidence, and recommended fix. The tracker is the primary input to the gap report.
  

• Maintain tracking documentation: draft event tables, parameter definitions, and implementation code snippet templates from specifications provided by the engagement lead.
  

• Prepare status reporting: pull current metrics and format findings for governance meeting summaries, flagging any new anomalies since the previous update.
  

Required skills \& experience
  

• Google Analytics 4 — navigate reports, use DebugView in real time, build Exploration reports, and understand the purchase event structure.
  

• Google Tag Manager — use GTM Preview mode, read tag and trigger configurations, and identify firing issues.
  

• Browser DevTools (network tab) — filter for the GA4 collect endpoint, inspect request payloads, and identify missing or malformed parameters.
  

• BigQuery and SQL — write queries against GA4 event export tables to identify data quality issues and summarise results for reporting.
  

• Structured documentation — produce clear, consistent audit checklists, findings logs, event tables, and data dictionaries.


  
Qualifications: AppsFlyer — navigate the dashboard, read event logs, and cross\-reference attribution data against GA4\.
  

• Firebase DebugView — enable debug mode and validate in\-app events in real time.
  

• Experience producing audit deliverables or gap reports in a consulting or agency context.
  

• Familiarity with Android emulator or device\-based tag validation for app audit work.
  

Education \& experience
  

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  

• 2–5 years in digital analytics implementation or QA, with hands\-on use of GA4, GTM, and BigQuery.
  

• Experience in a consulting or agency delivery environment is preferred.

title: Creative Project Manager, GSS Creative Studio
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Prime Video brings world\-class storytelling to global audiences through high\-impact creative campaigns and experiences. GSS Creative Studio combines creative and brand expertise with operational excellence to deliver scalable, high\-quality creative solutions across Prime Video business lines, channels and marketplaces.
   

  

 Creative Studio is seeking a Creative Project Manager to plan, coordinate and deliver creative projects from validated intake and briefing through approved creative delivery and handoff. This role owns project plans, milestones, dependencies, communication and operational readiness, ensuring creative teams have the information, time and support required to deliver high\-quality work.
   

  

 The ideal candidate can manage multiple low\- to mid\-complexity projects in parallel, identify risks early and bring structure to ambiguous or changing requirements. They are an effective communicator who can build strong relationships with creative teams, business stakeholders and downstream partners while maintaining clear ownership and delivery expectations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Manage low\- to mid\-complexity creative projects from intake and brief validation through creative delivery and downstream handoff.
   

  

 Confirm project scope, deliverables, requirements, stakeholders, dependencies and approval paths before work begins.
   

  

 Build and maintain project plans, schedules and milestones based on agreed priorities and creative workflows.
   

  

 Coordinate creative reviews and track feedback, decisions, revision rounds and approvals.
   

  

 Ensure stakeholder feedback is consolidated, actionable and delivered within agreed timelines, escalating conflicting direction to the appropriate creative lead.
   

  

 Partner with Design Management and Operations leadership to support resource planning and identify capacity or workload risks.
   

  

 Track project health and communicate status, risks, dependencies and decisions to stakeholders and Creative Studio leadership.
   

  

 Resolve routine project roadblocks independently and escalate issues that require creative, business or leadership decisions.
   

  

 Maintain accurate project information in approved workflow and reporting systems.
   

  

 Coordinate complete and timely handoffs to Design Production, campaign teams or other downstream partners.
   

  

 Capture the project data required to evaluate delivery performance, revision patterns and workflow effectiveness.
   

  

 Contribute to SOPs, templates and process improvements that increase clarity, consistency and efficiency.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* 3\+ years of experience in creative project management, marketing operations, production coordination or a related field.
* Ability to communicate project status, expectations and dependencies clearly.
* Experience using project or workflow\-management tools.
* Ability to work through ambiguity and identify practical solutions.
* Fluent written and spoken English.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working for an entertainment agency, studio, or organization
* Experience in coordination, project management, asset operations or post delivery
* Understanding of creative development, key art, campaign design or digital production workflows.
* Experience managing projects across multiple regions, channels or marketplaces.
* Experience using operational data to identify workflow or delivery improvements.
* Knowledge of creative terminology, file requirements and production handoffs.

title: Advisor, Technical Project Management
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Advisor, Technical Project Management
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Sr. Project Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 We are a start\-up based out of Bengaluru \& Delhi NCR. We are engaged in development of next generation missions and technologies (NGM\&T) towards future warfare needs of the Indian defence forces. It is undertaking research towards enhancing persistence and autonomy for unmanned vehicles and robotic swarms. NRT’s product development portfolio includes a solar power stratospheric high altitude pseudo satellite (HAPS) unmanned platform and an air/ground launched stand\-off autonomous system.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Plan project communications – meetings, email etc. Facilitate key stakeholder updates. Create Minutes of Meetings.
* Create and maintain project management documents based on set templates according to ISO / AS9100 standards.
* Collaborate with the Systems Engineering(SE) Team to monitor and assess the technical progress of the project.
* Track project health and schedule as laid down in the WBS plans via task management / collaborative task management tools.
* Monitor KPIs / milestones laid down for the project. Generate a report for PM to review. Capture and share lessons learned through the execution of the project. Manage knowledge sharing between all stakeholders.
* Identify, report, and monitor project risks. Collaborate with Systems Engineering(SE) Team to assess technical risks.
* Work closely with the SCM and the finance teams to facilitate the procurement pertaining to the project. Monitor project expenditures and overall budget. Provide periodic updates via reports / dashboards.
* Conduct market surveys, gather information supporting submissions of EOI / RFP / RFQ and other bids and proposals.
* Creation of project status summary, project briefs, executive summaries etc. to facilitate management decisions.


**Must Have Skills**
* Prior experience of working in the UAV industry.
* 6\-7 years of experience in driving project planning and control roles.
* Has working knowledge of PM tools like Microsoft Project / Wrike / ClickUp / Jira / SAP etc along with resource loading and critical path analysis.
* Ability to work independently and productively with minimal supervision.
* Self driven and accountable for the delivery of work.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to assimilate information and create concise summaries and reports.


**Basic Requirement (education \& Relevant Experience)**
* Bachelor’s Degree (Aerospace/Aeronautics, Mechanical) in Engineering.


**Job Title: Senior Project Manager**
 Location: Bengaluru, India
   

  

 Department: Programme Management
   

  

 Reports To: Program Director
   

  

 Experience: 6–7 years (minimum one full project lifecycle in Aerospace/Defence domain)
   

  

 Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. (Mechanical / Aerospace / Avionics related streams preferred)
   

  

**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT)**
 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s fastest\-growing Aerospace \& Defence R\&D company, developing next\-generation intelligent, autonomous aerial systems and uncrewed platforms for national defence and allied sectors. At NewSpace, we combine deep systems engineering with rapid prototyping and agile program execution to deliver mission\-critical capabilities for the Indian Armed Forces and international partners.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Senior Project Manager – Defence Programs will be responsible for driving project tracking, documentation, compliance, and cross\-functional coordination across all internal teams (Engineering, Production, SCM, Quality, Legal, and Compliance). This role ensures on\-time and proactive coordination towards ensuring timely delivery of complex Unmanned Aerial Systems programs while maintaining aerospace standards, documentation rigour, and certification compliance.
   

  

 This position offers full lifecycle exposure to cutting\-edge defence programs — from development through certification and production — in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Tracking \& Coordination


 Own and maintain project trackers for deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and risk flags across multiple teams: Production, SCM, Quality, Engineering, and Support Functions.
   

  

 Drive schedule adherence, task allocation, and daily progress tracking through digital tools (ClickUp, MS Project, or equivalent).
   

  

 Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Engineering, Production, Finance, IT, Admin, etc) to resolve operational bottlenecks.
   

  

 Prepare weekly and monthly project dashboards, highlight critical path activities, and report delays or issues for leadership review.
   

  

* Documentation \& Governance


 Develop and maintain project documentation templates and stage\-gate deliverables.
   

  

 Ensure internal and external documentation compliance for design reviews, production milestones, and delivery audits.
   

  

 Maintain document version control and traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Support techno\-legal document reviews (NDAs, contracts, agreements) in coordination with paralegal/legal teams.
   

  

* Compliance \& Certification


 Support and track compliance to Aerospace Standards and Defence Quality Assurance (DGQA) requirements.
   

  

 Coordinate certification efforts for Type Certification of UAVs — including DGCA, EASA, and related regulatory bodies.
   

  

 Liaise with certification authorities and ensure documentation is audit\-ready and standards\-compliant.
   

  

* Legal, IP \& Licensing Coordination


 Interface with the legal and paralegal teams for techno\-legal reviews, NDAs, license agreements, and renewals.
   

  

 Support coordination of IP and patent filing activities related to project deliverables.
   

  

 Track industrial licenses – granted, pending, and renewal cycles – ensuring compliance and timely submission.
   

  

* PLM Implementation \& Process Digitization


 Participate in or lead the implementation of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools across the organization.
   

  

 Support tool evaluation, deployment, user training, and adoption for PLM systems such as ENOVIA, Teamcenter, or Duro.
   

  

 Work with cross\-functional teams to align PLM structures with ongoing project workflows and documentation needs.
   

  

**Project Management**
**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Proven experience managing multi\-stakeholder technical programs.
   

  

 Strong understanding of deliverable\-based tracking and cross\-functional coordination.
   

  

 Proficiency in project management software (ClickUp, MS Project, JIRA, or equivalent).
   

  

**Technical \& Compliance**
 Awareness of Aerospace standards, Defence compliance frameworks, and certification processes.
   

  

 Understanding of production, supply chain, and quality workflows in aerospace/defence environments.
   

  

**Documentation \& Legal Interface**
 Skilled in technical documentation, version control, and techno\-legal review processes.
   

  

 Familiarity with IP filing coordination, NDAs, and industrial licensing is preferred.
   

  

**PLM Systems**
 Exposure to PLM tools like ENOVIA, Teamcenter, or Duro is desirable.
   

  

**Soft Skills**
 Excellent organizational, analytical, and stakeholder management abilities.
   

  

 High attention to detail, with a “track\-to\-close” mindset.
   

  

 Ability to thrive in a dynamic, cross\-disciplinary, and fast\-evolving R\&D setup.
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 6–7 years of experience in Aerospace, Defence, or Industrial Manufacturing programs.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to handle multi\-stakeholder project execution with discipline and accountability.
   

  

 Has seen at least two complete project lifecycles (from initiation to delivery or certification).
   

  

 Balanced combination of energy, maturity, and long\-term ownership mindset.
   

  

**Growth \& Opportunity**
**This Role Offers Unparalleled Exposure To**
 Full\-cycle management of defence and UAV system projects.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with certification and compliance frameworks.
   

  

 Participation in strategic initiatives like PLM implementation and process standardization.
   

  

 Opportunities to grow into Program Management, Operations Excellence, or Certification Management roles within NRT.

title: Specialist, Technical Project Management
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Specialist, Technical Project Management
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
