title: Creative Operations Lead/Creative Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a self\-starter to lead creative operations across copy, design, and branding for our Pune team at DeltaX. You’ll manage client requirements, translate them into actionable briefs, oversee the design team’s bandwidth and workflows, and ensure high\-quality, on\-brand delivery across accounts. Working closely with clients, designers, creative strategists, and product teams, you’ll bring structure and consistency to creative execution while ensuring projects are delivered on time and aligned with campaign and brand objectives. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities shall encompass:
 



  





**Year of experience: 3 to 5 years \| Salary Range: INR 9 LPA to 12 LPA** 




  






 Key responsibilities:
 



* Creative Ownership: Ensure quality, consistency, and brand alignment across copy, design, and branding; review outputs before client delivery.
* Client Management: Own creative communication with clients, translate requirements into clear briefs, and manage feedback through closure.
* Team \& Resource Management: Manage design team bandwidth, priorities, allocation, and timelines while proactively identifying capacity gaps.
* Project Management: Oversee creative projects end\-to\-end, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies for timely delivery.
* Creative Operations: Build and maintain SOPs, templates, and workflows while identifying bottlenecks and improving execution.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work with designers, creative strategists, Product, Growth, and Strategy teams to deliver effective creative solutions and support pitches and presentations.



  






 Qualifications:
 



* 3–5 years of experience in creative project management, creative operations, or similar roles within an agency, brand, or digital marketing company.
* Strong client communication, project management, and resource management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Experience managing creative/design team workloads, timelines, and quality, with a strong eye for aesthetics, copy, and brand consistency.
* Understanding of digital advertising formats, creative best practices, and how creative impacts campaign performance.
* Experience developing or improving creative workflows, SOPs, processes, or playbooks, with a proactive problem\-solving approach.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment; event planning or brand activation experience is a plus.



  





**About DeltaX:** 




 DeltaX is a Data\-Driven Digital Advertising Platform built for Agencies and Advertisers to optimally plan, design, buy, track, attribute and report ad campaigns across search, social media, display RTB, Mobile, Video and other media channels. Founded in 2012, the platform serves as the pioneer in the Advertising Technology Industry. The cutting edge technology has empowered digital marketing teams across the globe with deep insights, automated ROI based spends optimization, activating award winning technology\- driven campaigns.

description:

 Associate Customer Program Manager (EG)
   

  

 Bengaluru, India Office
   

  

****About MISUMI Americas****
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

* Work Hours: 9:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)\*\*


**F** 
**ictiv exists to help product innovators create**
 Fictiv is a global manufacturing company that simplifies sourcing for custom manufacturing, from prototype to low\-volume production. Through its highly\-vetted manufacturing network, AI\-powered technology platform, and global operations centers across the USA, Mexico, India, and China, Fictiv delivers fast, high\-quality custom manufacturing services from quote to delivery. Fictiv’s capabilities span the full mechanical bill of materials, including Injection Molding, Compression Molding, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Die Casting, and Sheet Metal. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 30 million commercial and prototype parts for early\-stage companies and large enterprises alike, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.
   

  

**Impact in this Role**
 Are you ready to shake up the world of customer service? Do you thrive on making connections and finding creative solutions? If you’re passionate about putting customers first in a dynamic, non\-traditional environment, we want YOU on our team!
   

  

 In your role as
 **Associate Customer Program Manager** 
 , you will be working directly with our US\-based customers, and you’ll be using your agility, problem\-solving skills, and customer service advocacy to help our customers increase the velocity and quality of products delivered. You will collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to resolve customer pain points, address customer needs, and help manage customer projects end to end. You will support multiple customers across a variety of manufacturing orders to be fulfilled in different regions around the world.
   

  

**Work Hours:** 
 9
 **:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)**
 This role follow a hybrid work schedule \- 3 nights in office, 2 nights remote
   

  

****What You Will Be Doing****
* Customer Management: You will be our customers’ best ally at Fictiv. Work closely with our customers to ensure a seamless and high\-quality experience. Nurture relationships and resolve issues to help drive customer loyalty.
* Case management: Concurrently manage a variety of manufacturing orders with multiple customers and the internal operations teams. Prioritize and resolve top user requests to address their product development needs and meet customer expectations for timing and quality.
* Communication: Gather, interpret, and communicate engineering, design, manufacturing, and logistics requirements to ensure the orders will be delivered on time and in full
* Collaboration: Collaborate with sales and the manufacturing operations teams to ensure successful delivery to the customer and advocate on their behalf \- through the project lifecycle, including post\-delivery exceptions.
* Program Management: Manage projects with top\-down oversight throughout the entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify improvement areas and collaborate with the cross\-functional team to prioritize and define solutions to increase our efficiency.


**Desired Traits**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA required.
* 4\+ years of experience in program management, project management, supply chain or customer\-facing operations roles.
* Experience supporting NPI, low\-volume production, or rapid prototyping programs.
* PMP/project management certification and understanding of project management/operations knowledge preferred.
* The work is fast\-paced \- you will be working in an operations environment with tight deadlines and high standards. You will need to be organized with good time management, prioritization skills and great attention to detail.
* We obsess over our customers \- you will need to be personable and have outstanding communications skills (both written and verbal) and be able to adapt your communication style effectively. Must be fluent in written and spoken English. Proven experience working directly with US\-based customers and/or during US business hours is preferred
* This role requires a self\-starter mentality. We want you to be excited by a hands\-on, high\-performing, results\-oriented role and driven to exceed expectations for our clients. Accountability is everything; you say what you do and do what you say.
* Aligned with our culture centered around continuous learning \- bring passion to learn about the manufacturing ecosystem and the New Product Development process.


**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
**We’re Actively Seeking Teammates Who:**
* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Support new product development programs and ensure alignment with aerospace engineering and certification requirements.

* Middleware and reusable core software libraries.

description:
**Description**
 Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables millions of sellers worldwide to leverage Amazon's world\-class fulfillment network — from storage and pick\-pack\-ship to customer service and returns. FBA Support Operations (S\-Ops) is the team that ensures sellers receive best\-in\-class support throughout their FBA journey. We manage end\-to\-end seller support across multiple FBA programs, drive contact elimination through automation and process improvement, and continuously raise the bar on seller experience. Our mission is to make every seller interaction effortless — and where possible, eliminate the need for sellers to contact us at all.
   

  

 The FBA S\-Ops org is looking for a Program Manager who will launch and scale new seller engagement use cases, improve seller engagement ops efficiency, and drive Voice of Seller (VoS) solutions to close seller experience gaps. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end program lifecycle from intake to launch, surface seller pain points through data\-driven root\-cause analysis, and partner cross\-functionally to implement preventative fixes. You'll lead as a voice of the sellers for internal teams to ensure the right bar for seller experience, and systemic root cause fixes are in place to avoid recurring issues for our sellers.
   

  

 Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. We are looking for someone who is detail\-driven, can create processes from scratch, has good problem solving and deep dive abilities. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs while keeping a high bar on quality of outputs is a must.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end program lifecycle for new seller engagement use cases: intake, assessment, design, change management, launch, and BAU integration across multiple FBA programs
   

  

 Establish SOP's which promote the adoption of appropriate solutions and sustainability of desired results in complex operational environments and large scale launches
   

  

 Partner with WW FBA teams to prioritize and execute new use cases; coordinate across Capacity Planning, WFM, Training, SOP, and Seller Engagement Ops teams for seamless launches
   

  

 Work with product managers and leaders to ensure that strategies scale, and make smart trade\-offs (e.g., short\- vs. long\-term needs). Identify gaps between teams, processes and plans, and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate
   

  

 Own the VoS pipeline end\-to\-end: intake seller pain points, develop clear and concise root\-cause analysis (RCA) and write\-ups, implement solutions with cross\-functional owners, and measure impact
   

  

 Identify and close SX gaps through data\-driven insights and cross\-functional partnership with Product, Tech, and Policy teams
   

  

 Drive ops efficiency improvements — reducing waste, improving throughput, and optimizing seller engagement resource allocation
   

  

 Serve as escalation point for seller issues: own investigations to identify root\-causes, drive resolution, identify preventative solutions with cross\-functional business owners, and track progress through closure
   

  

 Deliver measurable improvements across key ops and SX metrics
   

  

 Collaborate and build relationships with cross functional teams to ensure seamless execution and process excellence
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:
   

  

 Bangalore, KA, IND

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

The role demands high ownership — you treat every program as your own, proactively remove blockers, escalate decisively when needed, and hold cross\-functional partners accountable to shared commitments without damaging relationships. Experience managing global stakeholder landscapes (L6–L8\), navigating matrixed organizations, and delivering results in fast\-paced, high\-volume IT support environments is essential.  Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end lifecycle of global SD programs — from scoping problems to driving execution and delivering measurable outcomes across AMER, APAC, EU, and LATAM. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**About Valeo Health** 




 Valeo Health is a preventive healthcare and wellness platform operating across Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), offering diagnostics, teleconsultation, AI\-driven health insights, supplements, and care programs. We are building AI\-first, compliant, and scalable healthcare platforms that handle sensitive health data while delivering reliable, high\-quality customer experiences across geographies.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the POD that builds and operates Valeo's compliance and finance platforms across KSA and the UAE. Your POD owns the integrations that keep Valeo legal and running — connecting to national health data exchanges (NABIDH, Malaffi, Riayati, NPHIES) and to Saudi Arabia's ZATCA e\-invoicing (Fatoora) — end\-to\-end, from design and build through certification, go\-live, and ongoing operation.
 



  





 This is a backend\- and integration\-heavy role where correctness is non\-negotiable — regulators, auditors, and patients depend on it. Driving AI adoption is a must: you will build AI into the platforms and roll out AI\-assisted engineering across the team, while holding an uncompromising bar on data privacy and security (HIPAA, ISO 27001, UAE PDPL, KSA PDPL).
 



  





**The Mindset We Hire For** 




 These three traits matter more than any specific technology on your CV. If they don't describe you, this is not the right role.
 



 •
 **Ownership:** 
 You don't escalate problems — you bring solutions. When a regulatory deadline or an
 



 integration is at risk, you own it end to end until it's resolved.
 



 •
 **Deliver Results:** 
 You measure your POD in systems shipped, integrations certified, and reliability
 



 improved — not stand\-ups attended.
 



 •
 **AI\-Forward \& Quick to Learn:** 
 You actively adopt AI tools, get productive fast in unfamiliar
 



 regulatory domains, and bring AI into your team's workflow without compromising compliance.
 



  





**What We Expect from Our Engineering Managers** 




**Own Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of compliance and finance integration platforms through a POD model.
 



 • Translate dense regulatory and tax requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans.
 



 • Balance speed, quality, reliability, and compliance — and know where there is zero tolerance for
 



 error.
 



**Build Reliable Regulatory \& Finance Integrations** 




 • Deliver and operate integrations with UAE health exchanges (NABIDH, Malaffi, Riayati) and KSA
 



 NPHIES, using HL7 / FHIR.
 



 • Build ZATCA e\-invoicing (Fatoora) Phase 2 — UBL / XML, cryptographic stamps, QR codes,
 



 clearance/reporting, and platform onboarding.
 



 • Engineer resilient, observable integrations — retries, idempotency, reconciliation, and monitoring
 



 against external platforms.
 



**Drive AI Adoption (a must)** 




 • Build AI into the platforms — document extraction, data mapping and validation, claims/coding
 



 assistance, invoice reconciliation, and anomaly detection.
 



 • Roll out AI\-assisted engineering (coding, review, test generation, agentic workflows) to raise team
 



 throughput and quality.
 



 • Establish safe patterns for AI on regulated data — no PHI/PII exposure to third\-party models, with
 



 evals and guardrails.
 



**Build Secure \& Compliant Systems** 




 • Ensure secure SDLC and data\-privacy requirements across services and AI systems.
 



 • Collaborate with Compliance, Security, and Legal on HIPAA, ISO 27001, UAE PDPL, and KSA
 



 PDPL.
 



 • Maintain audit readiness, certification, and documentation for regulator and government\-platform
 



 onboarding.
 



**Lead Teams Effectively** 




 • Manage and mentor a POD of 8–10 engineers.
 



 • Drive sprint planning, estimation, execution, and delivery predictability.
 



 • Upskill the team on applied AI and modern AI\-assisted engineering practices.
 



 • Make hiring decisions and grow the team in line with business priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own delivery and operation of compliance and finance integration platforms across KSA and UAE.
 



 • Own the roadmap for embedding AI into the platforms and adopting AI tooling across the team.
 



 • Manage certification, onboarding, and go\-live with regulators and government platforms.
 



 • Drive incident response, root\-cause analysis, and post\-mortems for integrations and AI systems.
 



 • Define and track reliability, data\-quality, and audit\-readiness metrics and SLAs.
 



 • Partner with Product, Compliance, Finance, and Legal on PDPL, HIPAA, and ISO 27001
 



 obligations.
 



 • Work with DevOps/SRE for uptime, scalability, and cost efficiency; hire and grow the team.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Experience** 




 • 5–10 years of software engineering experience, with a strong backend/integrations focus.
 



 • 2–4\+ years as an Engineering Manager or Senior Tech Lead managing 6 or more engineers.
 



 • Track record delivering compliance\-heavy or regulated integrations end\-to\-end.
 



 • Experience integrating with government or regulatory platforms is a strong plus.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong backend systems, APIs, and distributed / integration patterns — queues, retries,
 



 idempotency, reconciliation.
 



 • Healthcare data standards (HL7 / FHIR) and e\-invoicing/tax formats (UBL / XML), or ability to
 



 master them fast.
 



 • Applied AI: LLM integration, RAG, model serving and evaluation; plus AI\-assisted engineering
 



 tooling.
 



 • AWS or GCP, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and observability tools.
 



 • Data security, encryption, and PII/PHI handling; understanding of AI data governance.
 



**Leadership \& Mindset** 




 • Strong people\-management and stakeholder\-communication skills.
 



 • Proven ability to drive change and AI adoption across an engineering team.
 



 • Ability to operate in ambiguity while maintaining delivery discipline and a compliance\-first mindset.
 



 • High ownership, bias for action, and customer\-first mindset.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)** 




 • The required KSA and UAE health\-exchange and ZATCA integrations are live and compliant, on
 



 regulatory timelines.
 



 • AI is embedded in the platforms and in the team's workflow, with measurable gains in effort and
 



 quality.
 



 • Improved integration reliability and a reduction in production issues.
 



 • Clean audits, with audit\-ready documentation across owned systems.
 



 • Strong team growth — including at least one engineer ready for promotion within the year.
 



  





**Why Join Valeo Health** 




 • Build and scale mission\-critical compliance and finance platforms across international markets.
 



 • High\-impact role at the intersection of healthcare regulation, finance, and AI.
 



 • Clear growth path toward Senior Engineering Manager and leadership roles.

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Avaali Solutions is looking for an AI Business Consultant who will serve as the bridge between enterprise business challenges and AI\-powered solutions delivered through our proprietary Avagama platform. This role combines business consulting acumen with hands\-on platform delivery \- you will engage directly with customers to understand their processes, identify automation and intelligence opportunities, and own the end\-to\-end build of solutions including agentic AI workflows, intelligent document processing pipelines, and process orchestration layers.
 



 You will work within the Agentic AI \& Intelligent Automation Practice, collaborating with delivery teams, pre\-sales, and product engineering to position and deploy Avagama\-powered solutions across industries including BFSI, manufacturing, retail, energy, and facilities management.
 



  





**ABOUT AVAGAMA** 




 Avagama is Avaali's proprietary SAP\-aware enterprise process intelligence and agentic AI orchestration platform. It enables organizations to discover, analyze, and automate complex business processes by combining process mining, AI\-driven decision intelligence, and an agentic orchestration engine that can plan, reason, and execute multi\-step enterprise workflows autonomously. Avagama is designed for deep SAP integration while remaining vendor\-agnostic across ERP and enterprise landscapes.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Business Discovery \& Process Understanding** 



* Conduct structured discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to map current\-state business processes, pain points, and transformation goals.
* Translate business process narratives into structured process maps, value\-stream views, and opportunity catalogues.
* Identify areas where AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, or process orchestration can create measurable business value.



**Avagama Platform Consulting \& Solutioning** 



* Use Avagama's process intelligence capabilities to analyze process data, mine patterns, and surface automation and AI applicability.
* Map business requirements to Avagama's agentic orchestration, IDP, and decision\-intelligence modules to design fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Build solution architectures and present them to customer CxO / IT leadership with clear ROI articulation.
* Identify where agentic AI agents should be deployed versus rule\-based automation, and design hybrid orchestration strategies.



  





**Solution Build \& Delivery Ownership** 



* Own the hands\-on build of Avagama\-based solutions \- configure agents, define orchestration workflows, set up IDP pipelines, and integrate with enterprise systems (SAP, ERPs, CRMs, custom APIs).
* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents that perform multi\-step enterprise tasks: approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, document classification, and data extraction.
* Collaborate with data engineers and ML engineers for model tuning, prompt engineering, and performance optimization where custom AI components are required.
* Ensure solution quality through structured testing, UAT coordination, and go\-live support.



  





**Client Engagement \& Value Realization** 



* Serve as the primary consultant on customer engagements \- own the relationship from discovery through steady\-state handover.
* Build business cases, ROI models, and transformation roadmaps aligned with client KPIs.
* Conduct training and enablement sessions for client teams on deployed solutions.
* Produce engagement artifacts: process assessment reports, opportunity catalogues, solution design documents, and post\-deployment value reports.



  





**Pre\-Sales \& Practice Contribution** 



* Support pre\-sales with discovery\-driven scoping, effort estimation, and proposal inputs.
* Contribute to Avagama's positioning \- case studies, competitive intelligence, demo scenarios, and sales training content.
* Feed product insights back to the platform engineering team based on real\-world deployment learnings.



  





**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 4–8 years of experience in business consulting, process consulting, or technology consulting in an enterprise context.
* Demonstrate ability to independently run discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process mapping exercises.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of: process mining tools, RPA platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate), or intelligent automation platforms.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems \- SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP), or equivalent ERP/CRM landscapes.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts \- LLMs, prompt engineering, document AI, and agentic AI patterns (tool use, ReAct, multi\-agent orchestration).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into concrete solution designs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- comfort presenting to CxO audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Experience with SAP integration technologies \- BTP, SAP AI Core, Joule, ArchiveLink, VIM, or xECM.
* Familiarity with GCP Document AI, Azure Document Intelligence, or AWS Textract.
* Prior experience building or configuring AI agents or multi\-agent orchestration systems.
* Exposure to industry domains such as BFSI, manufacturing, energy, retail, or facilities management.
* Certifications in SAP, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or any cloud AI/ML specialization.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus.

description:

Cognite operates at the forefront of **industrial digitalization, building AI**, and data solutions that solve the world's hardest, highest\-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low\-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.



We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward \- not backwards \- you'll feel right at home here.



Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

  

**How you'll demonstrate** **Ownership**
========================================

  

**About the Role**
------------------



Cognite Academy is looking for a highly organized and execution\-focused **Senior Project Lead – Academy Content \& Operations** to drive the day\-to\-day execution of our training content development initiatives.



This role will be responsible for ensuring that content development projects move from planning to completion on time, with clear ownership, strong cross\-functional coordination, and minimal execution friction.



You will work closely with instructional designers, technical content developers, trainers, product experts, and subject matter experts (SMEs) across Cognite. You will establish project plans, maintain execution cadence, track deliverables and dependencies, proactively identify risks, and follow up with stakeholders to keep projects moving.



This is an **individual contributor role** with significant responsibility for driving accountability and execution across the Academy team.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Project Planning \& Execution**


* Own the end\-to\-end project management of Academy content development initiatives.
* Translate content development priorities into clear project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly execution rhythms across active projects.
* Ensure every project has clearly defined tasks, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and status.
* Track project progress against agreed timelines and proactively address schedule risks.
* Maintain a consolidated view of all active content development projects and their health.
* Drive projects through to completion rather than simply tracking and reporting progress.


**Team Coordination \& Accountability**


* Coordinate closely with Academy team members to ensure weekly commitments and project tasks are clearly defined and updated.
* Follow up proactively on overdue or at\-risk deliverables and help remove obstacles affecting execution.
* Facilitate regular project check\-ins, stand\-ups, and status reviews as required.
* Ensure project management systems remain accurate and reflect the latest status, ownership, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Create visibility into upcoming milestones, workload, risks, and potential bottlenecks.


**Cross\-Functional \& SME Coordination**


* Coordinate with Product, Professional Services, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams to secure SME participation required for Academy projects.
* Schedule and manage SME engagements, reviews, technical validation sessions, and content approvals.
* Follow up with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure dependencies are completed on time.
* Identify cross\-functional blockers early and proactively work with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Escalate unresolved risks and dependencies with clear context, impact, and recommended actions.


**Project Governance \& Reporting**


* Establish consistent project management practices across Academy content development.
* Maintain project dashboards, trackers, risk logs, action registers, and project documentation.
* Provide concise weekly status reporting covering progress, upcoming milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
* Identify recurring execution bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Help improve the predictability and scalability of Academy's content development operations.

**The** **Impact** **you bring to Cognite**
===========================================


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


* Academy content projects have clear plans, owners, milestones, and deadlines.
* Weekly commitments are visible and consistently followed through.
* Project risks and delays are identified before they become critical.
* SMEs and cross\-functional dependencies are engaged early enough to avoid project delays.
* Team members spend less time chasing dependencies and coordinating logistics.
* Leadership has clear visibility into project health, risks, capacity, and delivery timelines.
* Content development projects are completed predictably and on time.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, program operations, or a similar execution\-focused role.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with both team members and senior stakeholders.
* Strong ability to drive follow\-through and accountability across teams without having direct reporting authority.
* Advanced knowledge of modern project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management practices including milestone planning, dependency management, risk management, capacity planning, status reporting, and escalation.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to identify blockers, facilitate decisions, and proactively move projects forward.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience managing training, learning content, technical documentation, product education, or content development projects.
* Experience working with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, or other technical teams.
* Familiarity with instructional design or technical training development processes.
* Experience building dashboards and reporting mechanisms for portfolio/project visibility.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or similar project management certification is beneficial but not required.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------


* **Execution Discipline** – Creates structure, maintains momentum, and drives projects through completion.
* **Communication** – Communicates clearly, concisely, and confidently across functions and levels.
* **Ownership** – Takes responsibility for outcomes rather than simply documenting project status.
* **Influence Without Authority** – Builds relationships and drives accountability across stakeholders without relying on reporting structures.
* **Proactive Problem Solving** – Identifies risks and blockers early and works actively to resolve them.
* **Organization \& Attention to Detail** – Maintains accurate project plans and ensures commitments do not fall through the cracks.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** – Builds productive relationships with SMEs and stakeholders across the organization.

**Role Scope**
--------------



This is an individual contributor role and does not have direct people\-management responsibility. The role owns the execution and coordination of Academy projects, while functional leaders and content owners remain accountable for their respective subject\-matter and content decisions.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
**Job Title**


Assistant Project Manager**Job Description Summary**


The role will require close coordination with the Client, PMC, consultants, contractors, design teams, procurement teams and site execution teams to ensure that project milestones are achieved within the approved project schedule. Having strong hands\-on expertise in Primavera P6, construction sequencing, progress measurement, critical path analysis, delay analysis and schedule reporting.**Job Description**

**About The Role:**

* We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer with around 10 years of experience in construction planning and project controls to be based in Bangalore.
* The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and controlling project schedules, monitoring contractor performance, identifying schedule risks and delays, and providing timely recommendations for corrective and recovery measures.
* Develop and maintain the Project Master Schedule in Primavera P6\.
* Establish appropriate WBS, activity coding, calendars, relationships, milestones and critical path.
* Develop baseline, detailed execution, procurement, design and commissioning schedules.
* Integrate design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
* Review contractor baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, resources and achievability.
* Ensure alignment of contractor schedules with overall project milestones.
* Develop detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules as required by the project.
* Prepare and maintain 2\-week, 4\-week and monthly look\-ahead schedules.
* Identify interface activities and constraints affecting project progress.
* Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline schedule.
* Collect and validate progress information from site teams and contractors.
* Carry out weekly and monthly schedule updates.
* Analyse planned vs. actual progress and identify slippages.
* Track critical and near\-critical activities.
* Monitor key project milestones and sectional completion dates.
* Identify potential delays at an early stage and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Ensure that reported progress is supported by actual site achievement.
* Prepare and monitor manpower histograms and resource loading.
* Review contractor manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Monitor productivity against planned norms.
* Identify resource shortages affecting critical activities.
* Prepare resource\-based recovery plans where required.
* Monitor material and equipment requirements against project milestones.
* Coordinate with design consultants to track drawing and document deliverables.
* Monitor design approvals against construction requirements.
* Integrate procurement schedules with the construction programme.
* Track long\-lead items and ensure delivery dates are aligned with site requirements.
* Highlight delays in design approvals, material procurement and statutory approvals that may impact the programme.
* Review and comment on contractor schedules and programmes.
* Conduct regular planning meetings with contractors and site teams.
* Challenge unrealistic activity durations, sequencing and progress claims.
* Ensure contractors submit updated schedules and recovery programmes on time.
* Monitor contractor commitments against agreed action plans.
* Provide planning inputs during commercial and contractual discussions.
* Maintain a clear record of delay events, instructions, approvals and their schedule impact.
* Maintain a schedule risk and constraint register.
* Identify activities with potential impact on project completion.
* Carry out schedule risk assessments and mitigation planning.
* Support cost and commercial teams by providing schedule information for forecasting and change management.
* Analyse the schedule impact of variations and change orders.
* Support project forecasting and expected completion\-date assessments.
* Ensure schedule changes are properly documented and traceable.

**About You:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
* Post Graduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management will be an advantage.
* Primavera P6 certification will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in construction planning/project controls.
* Should have substantial experience in preparing and managing construction programmes rather than only updating schedules.
* Experience with a PMC/Client/Consultant organisation will be preferred.
* Experience in reviewing contractor programmes and delay claims will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on construction planning professional, not merely a Primavera operator. He/she should be capable of independently analysing a project programme, identifying why the project is slipping, determining the impact on the critical path, developing recovery options and presenting clear recommendations to the Project Manager/Client.
* Experience with major contractors such as L\&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons, Brigade, Prestige or similar organisations, or experience with a reputed PMC/consultancy, will be preferred.

* Being part of a growing global company;

Join OneAdvanced:

The PMO Business Partner acts as a centralized governance and resource coordination function, ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and accurate forecasting.
Core Responsibilities:* Governance Audits: Review project documentation for compliance with PMO frameworks and track corrective actions.
* Data Integrity: Ensure project owners are maintaining OpenAir data accuracy (go\-live dates, RAG status, resource bookings).
* RAG Reviews: Track actions and support the Customer solutions manager. Ensure action ownership and closure.
* New Project Intake: Review new orders, support the Customer solutions manager to allocate project owners, and support onboarding through weekly calls with PM managers.
* Forecasting Support: Provide accurate data and reports for business forecasting and work with the project owner to ensure projects are booked correctly or forecast.
* Partner Coordination: Monitor partner bookings, ensure backlog progress, and maintain weekly alignment calls.
* CSAT \& Escalation Monitoring: Provide administrative support for CSAT tracking and escalation processes (not responsible for managing escalations).
* Backlog Management: Track backlog status, ensure bookings, and close actions in collaboration with PM managers.
* Data Insights \& Reporting: Deliver weekly and monthly reports on utilisation, backlog, and governance compliance.


\#LI\-MP1
What You Will Do:
* Governance \& Compliance: Conduct monthly audits, RAG reviews, and ensure PMO process adherence.
* Forecast Accuracy: Deliver actionable utilisation and backlog data for forecast calls and budget alignment.
* Partner Delivery Enablement: Coordinate partner bookings and readiness across departments.
* Project Allocation Efficiency: Act as first point of contact for new projects; resolve resource conflicts proactively.
* Administrative Support: Reduce PM and consultant burden by managing bookings, tracking actions, and maintaining toolkits if appropriate.
* CSAT Monitoring: Analyse feedback trends and escalate issues to relevant teams.
* Internal Alignment: Run weekly readiness sessions and maintain PM frameworks and toolkits.


What You Will Have:
* Attention to detail for reviewing documentation and identifying gaps
* Data accuracy and integrity skills
* Reporting and analytics skills
* Comfortable with Excel or BI tools for data insights
* Strong communication and organisational skills
* Relationship management skills particularly with Partners
* Familiarity with PMO frameworks and audit processes
* Proactive, administrative rigour
* Familiarity with Openair is preferred but not essential
* Ability to work across multiple workstreams simultaneously with strong prioritisation


What We Do For You:
* **Wellbeing focused** – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* **Annual Leave** – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* **Employee Assistance Programme** – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7\.
* **Personal Growth** \- Regardless of where you are at in your career, we’re committed to enabling your growth personally and professionally
	+ **Development Programmes** – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
	+ **Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub!** \- Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* **Life Insurance** \- 3x annual salary
* **Personal Accident Insurance** \- providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* **Performance Bonus** – Our Group\-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success


Who We Are:

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.  

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.  

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.  

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.  

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.  

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.  

Learn more at **www.oneadvanced.com**

title: Creative Project Manager, GSS Creative Studio
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Prime Video brings world\-class storytelling to global audiences through high\-impact creative campaigns and experiences. GSS Creative Studio combines creative and brand expertise with operational excellence to deliver scalable, high\-quality creative solutions across Prime Video business lines, channels and marketplaces.
  

  

Creative Studio is seeking a Creative Project Manager to plan, coordinate and deliver creative projects from validated intake and briefing through approved creative delivery and handoff. This role owns project plans, milestones, dependencies, communication and operational readiness, ensuring creative teams have the information, time and support required to deliver high\-quality work.
  

  

The ideal candidate can manage multiple low\- to mid\-complexity projects in parallel, identify risks early and bring structure to ambiguous or changing requirements. They are an effective communicator who can build strong relationships with creative teams, business stakeholders and downstream partners while maintaining clear ownership and delivery expectations.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage low\- to mid\-complexity creative projects from intake and brief validation through creative delivery and downstream handoff.
  

  

Confirm project scope, deliverables, requirements, stakeholders, dependencies and approval paths before work begins.
  

  

Build and maintain project plans, schedules and milestones based on agreed priorities and creative workflows.
  

  

Coordinate creative reviews and track feedback, decisions, revision rounds and approvals.
  

  

Ensure stakeholder feedback is consolidated, actionable and delivered within agreed timelines, escalating conflicting direction to the appropriate creative lead.
  

  

Partner with Design Management and Operations leadership to support resource planning and identify capacity or workload risks.
  

  

Track project health and communicate status, risks, dependencies and decisions to stakeholders and Creative Studio leadership.
  

  

Resolve routine project roadblocks independently and escalate issues that require creative, business or leadership decisions.
  

  

Maintain accurate project information in approved workflow and reporting systems.
  

  

Coordinate complete and timely handoffs to Design Production, campaign teams or other downstream partners.
  

  

Capture the project data required to evaluate delivery performance, revision patterns and workflow effectiveness.
  

  

Contribute to SOPs, templates and process improvements that increase clarity, consistency and efficiency.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* 3\+ years of experience in creative project management, marketing operations, production coordination or a related field.
* Ability to communicate project status, expectations and dependencies clearly.
* Experience using project or workflow\-management tools.
* Ability to work through ambiguity and identify practical solutions.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working for an entertainment agency, studio, or organization
* Experience in coordination, project management, asset operations or post delivery
* Understanding of creative development, key art, campaign design or digital production workflows.
* Experience managing projects across multiple regions, channels or marketplaces.
* Experience using operational data to identify workflow or delivery improvements.
* Knowledge of creative terminology, file requirements and production handoffs.

title: Learning Content Producer – 3D & Video
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Learning Content Producer – 3D \& Video to own day\-to\-day planning and delivery across digital\-learning content production. The role turns approved scripts, storyboards and animatics into structured, trackable production plans and coordinates the complete content pipeline—from 3D assets, animation and lighting through video, voice\-over, subtitles, review and quality control—to ensure work is delivered on time, at the required quality, and ready for formal review and delivery.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Creative Director, Project Head, instructional designers, storyboard artists, 3D artists, animators, editors, QA teams, language and voice teams, vendors and relevant stakeholders. This is a hands\-on delivery leadership role: the focus is dependable execution, clear ownership, early risk visibility and disciplined follow\-through.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build and maintain master schedules for content units, segments, shots and deliverables.
* Break briefs and scripts into clear tasks, dependencies, owners, estimates, milestones and review gates.
* Track daily production across scripting, storyboarding, animatics, 3D, animation, lighting, rendering, video editing, audio, subtitles, translation and QA.
* Coordinate handoffs between creative, technical, production and quality teams so work does not stall between stages.
* Maintain a single source of truth for status, blockers, priorities, due dates, feedback, revisions and next actions.
* Monitor workload and capacity, identify bottlenecks early, and recommend practical reallocation or sequencing changes.
* Run concise production reviews and stand\-ups, document decisions and follow up until actions are closed.
* Establish and enforce internal quality gates; ensure only complete, checked and approved work moves to formal review or delivery.
* Review progress and output readiness across multiple teams without replacing specialist creative or technical ownership.
* Coordinate external vendors and contract teams, including briefs, handoffs, follow\-ups, review cycles, corrections and delivery commitments.
* Prepare clear status reports covering progress, risks, dependencies, resource constraints, decisions required and recovery actions.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders professionally, escalating risks with options and evidence.
* Support realistic planning during peak delivery periods while protecting quality, ownership and sustainable workload.
* Maintain organised production records, trackers, references, approvals and version history.
* Handle work materials with discretion and confidentiality.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5–10 years of experience in production, delivery, project coordination or program operations within digital learning, animation, media, gaming, VFX, interactive content or related industries.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and delivering multiple content streams or recurring deliverables.
* Strong understanding of digital learning and content production workflows, including scripts, storyboards, animatics, 3D and animation, video, audio, subtitles, review and QA.
* Proven ability to build schedules, manage dependencies, maintain trackers and drive closure of blockers.
* Practical experience with quality gates, review cycles, feedback management and delivery\-ready outputs.
* Strong workload planning, prioritisation, risk management and escalation skills.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contract teams or distributed production teams.
* Strong written and spoken communication in English is required. Ability to read and write Hindi fluently is mandatory.
* Comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets and project or task\-tracking tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, Trello, ShotGrid, fTrack or equivalent.
* Ability to work from the Chennai workspace on a full\-time, on\-site basis.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and ability to operate calmly under delivery pressure.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in e\-learning, educational video, animation, 3D production or game\-engine\-based workflows.
* Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing or voice\-over, language review and localisation workflows.
* Experience with production dashboards, reporting, SOPs, QC checklists or process improvement.
* Experience managing high\-volume, repetitive content delivery with consistent quality.
* Relevant education in project management, media, animation, digital learning, design, technology or an equivalent practical background.

title: Project Manager – STEP Consolidated Reporting Integration
description:
**Join us in building the future of Sandoz.**
 Through STEP (Sandoz Transformation Enterprise Program), we are creating a unified, integrated digital core and simplifying our end\-to\-end ways of working. From SAP S/4HANA to Veeva, Workday, LabVantage, and beyond, you’ll help design and deliver future\-ready systems that drive global impact — enabling us to deliver affordable medicines to more patients worldwide.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Project Manager \- STEP Consolidated Reporting Integration plays a pivotal role within STEP, with a specific focus on the coordination of the STEP new build landscape and the legacy SAP and non SAP reporting layer. Reporting to the STEP Integration Lead, this position ensures seamless cooperation between STEP and the BAU organization and the delivery of STEP related milestones for Data, Analytics and Reporting.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Coordinate activities between STEP and Data Analytics, Finance teams incl. BAU functions, facilitating effective communication, knowledge transfer, and alignment of objectives throughout the transformation lifecycle.
* Direct and oversee project teams (including external partners), maintaining strict control over progress, quality, and budget to ensure delivery against defined business objectives.
* Set up and lead all project\-related meetings, maintaining comprehensive records of actions, decisions, issues, and risks, and serving as the primary point of contact for all project\-related escalations.
* Ensure a smooth transition from project delivery to operational handover, planning and executing all activities associated with each release to minimize business disruption and maximize value realization.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholder success teams and internal departments to gather requirements, provide regular updates, and ensure solutions are fully aligned with business needs and expectations.
* Oversee the integration and optimization of legacy and new build applications, identifying opportunities to streamline business processes and enhance operational efficiency.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and external partners to ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality solutions and ongoing support.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, contributing to the organization's digital transformation and growth agenda.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators to measure project success.
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, standards, and best practices across all aspects of the project and operational coordination.


**Minimum Requirements**
 What you’ll bring to the role:
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in project delivery and/or application management or IT services within a multinational organization
* Proven experience managing complex IT projects within large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Previous experience in SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW, SAP IBP and PI is a must.
* Understanding of Data \& Analytics including Data Sphere and Data Bricks
* Experience of working or understanding of SAP MDG
* Strong understanding of Sandoz’ application landscapes and BAU operational environments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functional teams and manage external partners.
* Expertise in project planning, risk management, and change management.
* Track record of delivering projects on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related business field; (Master’s degree is preferred)
* Certification in project management methods (Agile, ITIL, Prince 2, PMI) is a plus.
* Experience with Agile/DevOps methodologies; Certification is a plus


**Languages**
 English
   

  

**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**
**\#Sandoz**

The team's mandate is to ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, trusted, and actionable , while identifying the key drivers of performance and translating quality data into clear actions that improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
   

  

 The Quality Operations Manager \- Platform Integrity (PI) will lead this team of approximately 5\-7 Quality S\-ladder team members and be accountable for the overall health and performance of PI Quality Operations. The manager will partner closely with BPO Operations, Vendor Management, Training, Program, Policy, Product, Analytics, and Global Quality stakeholders to strengthen quality governance, address systemic performance gaps, and ensure quality insights lead to measurable improvements in frontline execution.

* Own PI Quality performance across the BPO network , driving sustained improvement in Quality scores and building clear recovery plans for underperforming sites, queues, or agent populations.
* Ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, and trusted by owning audit governance, sampling effectiveness, evaluator accuracy, score integrity, and scoring consistency across the network.
* Lead audit, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), and calibration programs to improve evaluator accuracy, reduce scoring variance, and strengthen alignment across internal and BPO Quality teams.
* Turn Quality data into actionable insights by identifying key defect drivers, conducting root\-cause analysis, and translating findings into targeted actions that improve agent performance.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Operations, Training, Policy, Program, Product, and Analytics to address systemic Quality issues and improve processes, tooling, scorecards, and frontline execution.
* Drive continuous improvement and scalability by simplifying, standardizing, and improving Quality operating mechanisms across sites, markets, languages, and lines of business.

* Experience managing Quality professionals and demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and performance\-manage a team.
* Demonstrated experience improving Quality scores through structured root\-cause analysis and operational interventions rather than solely monitoring or reporting performance.
* Strong understanding of Quality measurement integrity , including scoring consistency, inter\-rater reliability, evaluator variance, sampling methodology, and calibration.
* Proven ability to analyze Quality data, identify performance drivers, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into improvement plans.
* Strong understanding of BPO operating environments, including vendor governance, performance management, SLAs/KPIs, corrective action planning, and multi\-site operations.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and demonstrated ability to influence teams outside of direct reporting lines.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience using statistical or analytical techniques to evaluate scoring reliability, performance variation, and Quality trends..
* Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or other Quality/process\-improvement certification is advantageous.
* Multilingual experience or experience supporting multilingual Quality operations is a plus.


****What Success Looks Like****
**Success In This Role Means**
* PI Quality scores show sustained and measurable improvement.
* Quality scores are trusted by Operations and BPO partners as an accurate representation of frontline performance.
* Audit and ATA accuracy remain consistently high across the network.
* Evaluator variance decreases, and calibration alignment improves.
* Quality insights consistently identify the highest\-impact performance opportunities and lead to concrete operational action.
* Quality interventions demonstrate measurable improvement in agent behavior and performance.

title: Sr. Program Manager, ECR, NOC ECR
description:
**Description**
 The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.
   

  

 The individual in this role will collaborate across a team of program, product, tech, BI and Science leaders to plan, execute, validate, and deploy complex customer experience capabilities. This role will partner will partner with teams across IN Ops to launch and drive impact through bespoke product solutions. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a proven track record of delivering results while managing high level of complexity. Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management, have experience working with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will identify, scope, and deliver large end\-to\-end programs by engaging cross\-disciplinary teams to design innovative customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by creating a vision, building consensus, and driving results — anticipating bottlenecks, managing escalations, making trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must break down complex projects into manageable deliverables with clear functional specifications and execute them on time. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to influence are essential. Self\-sufficiency in data analysis and working knowledge of SQL are critical. The role will also champion Generative AI adoption within ECR — including automated case summarization, pattern recognition for thematic defects, and predictive escalation routing — identifying opportunities where Gen AI can augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.
* They will be responsible for driving VP inquiries to closure within SLA with clear articulation of issue and recommended initiatives to arrest the root cause of the defect. They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.
* They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.
* They will identify, pilot, and scale Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines.
* They will help define the Gen AI product roadmap for ECR in partnership with Science and Tech teams — establishing success metrics, conducting A/B testing of AI\-assisted workflows, and ensuring responsible AI deployment with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop guardrails.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field

title: Project Manager
company: Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, Bakehouse and Fine Cacao
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Project Manager to drive the planning, coordination, and delivery of creative and marketing projects across the organization. The role will be responsible for translating briefs into clear project plans, aligning stakeholders and timelines, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and to the expected quality standards.
 



 The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple projects and teams in a fast\-paced environment. You will play a key role in bringing structure and efficiency to the creative and marketing workflow while ensuring smooth execution from brief to final delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 ﻿**




**1\. Project Planning \& Delivery** 



* Own projects end\-to\-end, from initial brief and planning through execution and final delivery.
* Develop clear project plans with defined timelines, milestones, deliverables, owners, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure projects remain on track and within scope.
* Identify potential bottlenecks and timeline risks early and proactively resolve them.
* Manage feedback and revision cycles to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and aligned with the original brief.



  





**2\. Brief Consolidation \& Calendar Alignment** 



* Consolidate creative and marketing briefs in alignment with the NPD calendar and always\-on content requirements.
* Ensure briefs are clear, complete, and actionable before being handed over to execution teams.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to clarify requirements, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Maintain visibility of upcoming projects and ensure timely handoffs to the respective teams.



  





**3\. Workflow, Process \& Template Optimization** 



* Build and maintain structured workflows, SOPs, templates, and project management systems for recurring work.
* Ensure all projects are tracked through a centralized system with clear ownership and real\-time status updates.
* Identify inefficiencies in existing processes and implement solutions to improve turnaround times.
* Develop repeatable frameworks and tools that enable teams to execute projects more efficiently.
* Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes based on team feedback and project outcomes.



  





**4\. Resource \& Bandwidth Management** 



* Work closely with creative and marketing teams to understand team bandwidth and allocate resources effectively.
* Assign projects based on priorities, skill sets, availability, and project requirements.
* Monitor workloads to identify potential bottlenecks, under\-utilization, or over\-allocation.
* Coordinate with freelancers, vendors, and external partners when additional resources are required.
* Ensure external resources are onboarded and briefed efficiently and have the necessary information to execute their deliverables.
* Proactively flag resource constraints and recommend solutions to stakeholders.



  





**5\. Marketing Channel Quality Checks** 



* Conduct regular quality checks across key marketing touchpoints, including social media, website, in\-store communication, and other relevant channels.
* Ensure creative and marketing assets are aligned with approved briefs, brand guidelines, and campaign requirements.
* Identify and communicate errors, inconsistencies, or execution gaps to the relevant teams.
* Track flagged issues through resolution and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain a high standard of consistency and execution quality across all live marketing channels.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in project management, creative operations, marketing operations, or a similar role.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously across creative, marketing, design, content, or brand teams.
* Strong project planning, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate ambiguous briefs into clear plans, timelines, and actionable deliverables.
* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem\-solving.
* Comfortable working with project management tools, calendars, trackers, and workflow systems.
* Ability to proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across cross\-functional and external teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining visibility and control across multiple projects.

title: Project Manager Construction, BOM
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
   

  

 As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
   

  

 Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
   

  

 At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team\-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**The Data Center CM Will Be Responsible For**
* Assist in project management and oversight of construction\-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct\-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct\-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.


 A day in the life
   

  

 At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
