title: Senior Manager — Technical Diligence and Programme Control
description:
Senior Manager \- Technical Due Diligence \& Project Monitoring \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



 We want a civil engineer who started on the developer or contractor side, carried a site, then moved into technical due diligence or independent engineer work. Depth first, structure second. A site tells you what it will cost long before a contractor does.
 




 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain \- first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



 The platform was founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built every platform he led as if it were his own \- three times over, on other people's capital. This is the fourth build, on his own. Across his career that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor, over 2,000 acres acquired and all of them litigation\-free, and more than 200 buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. The board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti. The platform runs on Vantrock Intelligence, its own AI\-native operating layer.
 




 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 Read a site badly at diligence and the error is baked into the underwriting for the life of the asset. Read it well and the deal either improves or dies early, the cheapest outcome available. The same skill, pointed at a contractor's programme, tells you whether the date on it is real.
 



 Vantrock currently buys both judgements from consultants, one assignment at a time, with nobody inside who can mark their work. The pipeline is 10 million sq ft and ground breaks on the first 2 million in January 2027\. From that point the platform is running acquisitions and construction at once, and whoever can walk a site in the morning and take apart a Primavera file in the afternoon becomes the most useful person in the room.
 




 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 \- Technical pre\-diligence on every site under consideration \- ground, levels, access, power, drainage, existing structures, and every physical constraint that changes what can be built there. Your output goes into the underwriting as a technical view with the assumptions stated.
 



 \- The buildability and cost\-shape read. Not a BOQ, a judgement: what makes this site expensive, and where the foundation cost goes.
 



 \- Drawing review at concept stage, against what actually builds, before it is a tender.
 



 \- Programme review and claims. Take apart the contractor's and the PMC's programmes and report what is real. Assess extension\-of\-time claims on merit.
 



 \- Technical validation on site: running bills, measurement, quality and progress against the drawings, with the record captured into Vantrock Intelligence.
 



 \- Command of technical partners: geotechnical agencies, surveyors, TDD firms, inspection agencies, PMCs. You never take a report on trust because it came on letterhead.
 




 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 




 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into technical due diligence, lender's independent engineer, technical audit or advisory work, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive, and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted can build a governance framework nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which sites, what your scope was, what the ground turned out to be and what it cost to deal with.
 




 QUALIFICATION
 




 \- A full\-time B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. This one is not negotiable and no other discipline substitutes.
 



 \- A postgraduate qualification is a strong plus rather than a requirement: NICMAR (ACM, APM or the QSCM diploma), RICS School of Built Environment, an IIT or NIT M.Tech in structural, geotechnical or construction engineering, and NMIMS MBA (Tech.) Civil Engineering with Operations Management. An MBA in Finance, a CFA or CA is an added advantage.
 




 TECHNICAL GROUNDING \- ESSENTIAL
 




 This is the part of the seat that cannot be learned on the job here, so we will test it directly, on a real drawing set.
 



 \- Ground and land form. Borelogs, SPT data, safe bearing capacity, settlement, water table, ground\-improvement options. Contours, cut and fill, approach gradients, and survey output read rather than taken on trust. You know what to specify to a geotechnical agency before they mobilise.
 



 \- Codes and authorities. IS 456, 800, 875 and 1893, the National Building Code, and the authority rules that bind a site \- MIDC, HSIIDC, KIADB.
 



 \- Warehousing and industrial specifics. Pre\-engineered buildings, portal frames, crane gantries, floor loading and flatness to the occupier's standard, and what an insurer's engineering requirements do to a design.
 



 \- Services and cost. HT power, sanctioned load, distance to substation, water, sewage treatment, storm water outfall. BOQ, rate analysis, running account bills, variations, escalation, retention, defect liability. You can look at a rate and say whether it is real.
 



 \- Programme and drawings. Primavera P6 or MS Project at critical\-path, float and resource\-loading level, and extension\-of\-time claims assessed on merit \- essential in this seat, because reading a programme against physical reality is the job. GFC review, structural and services coordination, BIM clash detection at a level where you know what the model hides.
 



 \- Writing. A TDD report a lender's or an investment committee can act on, plus advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 \- Platforms. MS Project at working level, plus SAP, Primavera P6 or Project Online.
 




 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
 




 \- 8 to 12 years, the majority of it on or around sites rather than in a design office.
 



 \- At least three years on technical due diligence, independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring work. Not delivery with a diligence assignment attached once.
 



 \- Sites assessed across greenfield land and built assets both. Assessing only completed buildings is half the seat.
 



 \- One constraint you found that nobody else had, and what it changed. This is the question the whole interview turns on.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 \- Not delivery or EPC, and not design. Execution is owned elsewhere and that seat is filled; you review what is proposed, you do not draw it.
 



 \- Not the deal, and not portfolio governance. Investments owns underwriting; the register sits with the EPMO Lead. You supply the technical view into both, even when it kills the deal.
 




 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 Deliberately small, no departments. Survey, soil investigation, third\-party inspection and measurement all go to specialist agencies. What stays inside is the judgement about whether their work is any good. Expect to be on site most weeks, and expect your written view to be read by the founder, the investment committee and, in time, by lenders.
 




 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 




 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive, route and report on it. The coordination, inside the platform and outside it with consultants, agencies, lenders and authorities, is done by you in person, on the phone and on site. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.
 




 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 Two requirements stand behind that and apply to every seat here. AI proficiency: every candidate takes the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, supervised, regardless of seniority. Partner command: consultants, contractors, auditors, valuers, law firms and system vendors do a great deal of Vantrock's work, and everyone here is expected to command that work rather than defer to it.
 




 COMPENSATION
 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity, with performance\-linked incentives and ESOPs. We discuss numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 




 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 An AI interview, reviewed before your CV. The AI Proficiency Test. A site round: a real site, or a real drawing set and soil report, and you tell us what you see. That round decides it. Two references. Five working days to hear back, and every conversation is confidential.
 




 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com, subject line "VR\-45 Senior Manager, Technical Diligence \- \[your name]". Four things: your CV, with the site half of your career set out as clearly as the advisory half; one artefact you personally wrote, redacted as you must, with three sentences on what you found that nobody else had; your current fixed compensation, expectation and notice; and one short paragraph naming the single site constraint you have seen change a deal most, and how you would have caught it earlier. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform.

title: Process Design - Manager Technology
description:
To lead and manage the team of Sr. Technologists and Technologists and drive the execution \& management of entire project life cycle starting from basic engineering design phase to commissioning/ start\-up of process or technology phase for in\-house and capital projects by RIL. Implement MOCs \& PIOs to improve profitability and achieve safe \& reliable operations at plants while adhering to RIL's process engineering standards, procedures, and guidelines.
   

  

 List of responsibilities attached to the role are documented below. These responsibilities are representative and the role holder is also responsible for any other job assigned by the superior authorities from time to time. This section in not intended to be an exhaustive listing of all activities done by the role holder. It should capture only the key responsibilities of the role
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Functional Planning and Strategy
* Provide inputs in creating Process Design's roadmap to ensure adherence to overall objectives, goals
* Manage a portfolio of Process Design projects as assigned by the Technology Officer, ensuring compliance. Provide solutions to the team and Senior team leadership on project status through regular MIS reporting and scheduled reviews
* Oversee end to end execution / implementation of roadmap as approved by Technology Officer
* Collaborate with leadership to identify new initiatives/ projects and set operational plans that meet these future demands
* Participate in Process Design's budgeting cycle \& process and provide inputs on budget allocation for own team
* Oversee deployment of own team budget and ensure efficient utilization and minimum variance in target v/s actual
* Process Design \& Implementation
* Design, integrate, and manage complex systems and ensure timely installations and maintenance of process systems
* Develop process flow diagrams, perform process simulations and conduct revamp and what if studies using software tools
* Develop and use advanced tools for engineering analysis, hydraulics calculations, utility networks, and flare system design and analysis
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams and partner/vendors for implementation \& embedding of the new process/system
* Perform troubleshoot and resolve issues related to production processes by analyzing root cause and suggesting solutions to address them
* Support technology teams with chronic problem solving to ensure solutions are integrated and aligned with the overall technology strategy
* Support in creation of training materials related to process design and operation including new processes and technologies
* Upgradation \& Capability Development
* Conduct need assessment, propose and invite vendor interactions for any kind of software/ equipment procurement or upgradation
* Identify need for interactions with institutes/agencies for specialized design models development and perform discussions with vendors on relevant tools
* Attend vendor meetings, review technical bid evaluation documents and prepare recommendations
* Assess system integrity and functionality of all process simulation \& modelling tools as per set standards. Translate usability and findings into design improvement
* Data Management
* Manage data of process maps, workflows, design \& development and simulation models of multiple projects and update the same on regular basis
* Manage database on standard software available for process improvement work
* Ensure all records are accurate and as per the IPR requirements
* Create standard report templates and prepare final internal technical and comparison reports
* Process Compliances
* Follow applicable HSEF procedures/practices with awareness about environmental statutory regulations and safety protocols, conduct risk assessment studies prior to implementation
* Understand MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet) of chemicals being handled in a particular project
* Participate in PSM activities / HAZOP / SIL studies / model review during progress of project
* Policies, Processes and Procedures
* Conduct day to day activities \& follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner
* Keep self abreast with leading automation technology advancements \& trends. Anticipate constraints in existing technology/product application range and provide necessary upgradation/modification plan to existing automation systems
* People Management
* Instill a culture of continuous development and high performance in the department by reviewing the competency matrix of team members
* Evaluate training and development requirements of the department
* Set and communicate clear performance expectations and coach and provide support and provide regular feedback to the team members
* Set performance objectives, evaluate team members, and provide feedback and guidance
* Lead recruitment activities and ensure retention and engagement of team members


 SUCCESS METRICS
   

  

* Project Timeline adherence
* Customer Satisfaction Score
* Lead time reduction in MOC process
* \# of reportable injuries (TRCFR)
* Successful implementation of schemes
* Ensure data management


 KNOWLEDGE AND COMPETENCIES
   

  

**Education Qualifications** 
 A Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Master's Degree in Chemical Engineering (preferred)
   

  

**Experience** 
 15\+ years of industrial experience, with experience in chemical/petrochemical/refinery industry (preferred)
   

  

**FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES**
* Understanding of chemical engineering principles
* Understanding of various technologies used in refinery and petrochemical plants
* Knowledge of value engineering, troubleshooting and optimization techniques
* Project Management
* Budget control
* Knowledge of Process Design and Process Engineering
* Knowledge of simulation and process calculation softwares like Aspen, Unisim, Flarenet, Pipenet
* Knowledge of quality control procedures

description:

 Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI\-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.
   

  

 Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms.
   

  

 Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19\.4 billion Mahindra Group.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status .

* Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System.
* Take part in information security training and act while handling information.
* Report all suspected security and policy breach to InfoSec team or appropriate authority (CISO).
* Understand and adhere to the additional information security responsibilities as part of the assigned job role.

title: Payment Lifecycle Manager - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
 Unlock your potential by joining our Payments Operations team, where you will play a pivotal role in transforming payment processing operations. This is your opportunity to drive innovation, enhance operational efficiency, and contribute to a dynamic and inclusive team culture. Be at the heart of our mission to deliver exceptional payment solutions and make a meaningful impact on the future of digital payments.
   

  

 As a Payment Lifecycle Manager III within Payments Operations, you will be a key player in the firm's payment processing operations, leveraging your deep knowledge of payment lifecycle principles and practices. You will be responsible for managing a diverse team, driving automation initiatives, and developing new technologies to streamline processes. Your role will involve interpreting customer needs, identifying trends, and generating innovative solutions to enhance our operational efficiency and resilience. You will also be instrumental in managing stakeholder relationships, ensuring cybersecurity, and implementing anti\-fraud strategies. Your advanced proficiency in strategic planning, project management, and change management will be crucial in leading the team towards achieving our long\-term goals.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Lead teams responsible for end\-to\-end operational processes within the payments lifecycle, overseeing daily operations, setting objectives, managing escalations, and ensuring quality, risk, control, and compliance standards are upheld.
* Utilize deep knowledge of products and payments to interpret customer needs, identify trends, and implement innovative solutions that enhance payment operations processes, leveraging AI and automation for efficiency and compliance.
* Lead or contribute to initiatives that enhance payment processing operations, focusing on client experience, process optimization, cybersecurity, and anti\-fraud strategies, while providing domain and technical expertise.

title: Principal Process Engineer (Pharma/Bio Pharma)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 This is a client facing leadership position within the Process Team, responsible for supporting multiple mid to large sized projects. The Lead Process Engineer will mentor less experienced Engineers; Piping Designers; and CAD Designers in the generation of design documents per the ARCADIS Design Deliverables Matrix.
   

  

 Typical design elements include Front End Engineering Design studies (Feasibility through the Basis of Design), P\&IDs, equipment specification, design coordination through all project phases, process modeling, and reports on specific technical topics required by the project team.
   

  

 The Lead Process Engineer is expected to demonstrate expertise in a variety of process engineering unit operations and biological manufacturing methods and semi\- conductor processes, supported by a wealth of design and/or operation experiences.
   

  

 Additional work activities include supporting other ARCADIS offices and Central Operations (i.e. Business Development) in ARCADIS Strategic Initiatives and presenting at relevant industry conferences and publications. The Lead Process Engineer will be mentored by the Discipline Manager and other Senior SME Design Staff within the greater ARCADIS Team.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Engage with all levels of ARCADIS and client organizations on technical discussions related to the fields of Chemical and Biological Process Engineering.
* Manage large project team and support the Discipline Manager in completion of performance reviews for these team members.
* Advise as SME in the development of engineering documents, leveraging experience, good engineering judgement, and external resources. Accountable for overall execution of the Process Design including technical quality, budget, and schedule.
* Coordinate construction activities for large projects; manage TBA, Submittals, RFI, and vendor activities, field evaluations, and commissioning support.
* Applies good engineering judgement to daily work, able to support design decisions with sound reasoning and published data when appropriate.
* Advanced understanding of unit operations encountered in the field of Chemical Engineering with a special emphasis on those present in the Life Sciences, semi\-conductor, and other highly technical fields. field. Able to explain theory surrounding these elements and teach the concepts to others.
* Provide mentorship and on the job training to less experienced engineers across the ARCADIS organization.
* Attend training seminars/events and conduct industry research to further expertise in key processing technologies.
* Publish and present technical work in support of professional development and ARCADIS strategic initiatives.
* Support other Arcadis Offices, Marketing, and Business Development as a Technical Resource and in the development of proposals and marketing material.


**Competencies:**
* Regularly assesses strengths and weaknesses and pursues continuous learning opportunities.
* Actively supports a culture of excellence, collaboration, and mentorship within the team.
* Demonstrates courtesy, sensitivity, and professionalism in all customer interactions.
* Manages challenging situations and responds promptly to customer needs, seeking feedback for improvement.
* Prioritizes and organizes work efficiently, sets clear goals, and adapts smoothly to changes.
* Balances individual and team responsibilities, contributing to a positive and supportive team environment.
* Demonstrates proficiency in technology, adapts to new tools, and uses them to enhance productivity.


**Qualifications:**
* Graduate or master’s degree (Chemical Engineering) with 15–20 years’ relevant design and engineering experience in the Pharmaceuticals/Bio Pharmaceuticals sector.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical documents.
* Skilled in responding effectively to sensitive inquiries and communicating persuasively in presentations and written materials.
* Proficient in applying advanced mathematical concepts (e.g., exponents, logarithms, quadratic equations, permutations) and statistical techniques.
* Strong logical reasoning skills for solving diverse intellectual and practical problems, including handling abstract and concrete variables.
* Proficient in MS Office Suite; intermediate knowledge of VISIO, Bluebeam Revu, hydraulic flow and process modeling software (e.g., SuperPro), Navisworks.
* Added advantage: Experience supervising project teams (up to 8 direct reports) and supporting process discipline managers with performance reviews.

title: Analyst, Global Markets Operations
description:

* Initially reporting to the Global Head, Macro Middle Ofice and Regional Head East, Markets Business \& Client Solutions, the successful candidate will be a key pillar of the India Middle Office.

Middle Office in Financial Markets at Standard Chartered was created in 2017 to provide dedicated Value\-Added support to Front Office and enable business growth, better Risk Management, and resolution of queries for Sales and Trading. Middle Office acts as the conduit between many different stakeholders and are a client facing function.
* Globally, Middle Office is split out across 13 Locations and covers Macro, Credit and Equity products. They are the main point of contact across Front Office and various Operations groups.
* Our Mission Statement entails "Our mission is to become trusted partners to the FM Business by delivering operational efficiency and superior risk management practices, providing critical trade support to Sales and Trading and generate data\-driven actionable insights to drive informed decision\-making".


**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Instil effective and robust operating models within BCS incorporating strong risk \& control frameworks, clear \& concise policies \& procedures, and optimal business\-as\-usual (BAU) processes to ensure alignment with the latest regulatory \& industry standards.
* Delivery of the BCS strategic roadmap, which incorporates principles from the Process \& Controls Simplification programme, Re\-platforming agenda and Fit for Growth (FFG) strategy
* Partner with business and COO to continuously provide value add service to drive efficiency and support business growth.
* New business enablement and solutions, partner to deliver strategic FM initiatives.
* Constantly seek opportunities to improve global consistency, work closely with the Hubs (GBS), Centre of Excellence and other regions to close gaps and standardise processes.

* Identify and close knowledge gaps within the Hubs through hands on training.
* Daily KPI monitoring vs SLA


**Business**

* Lead and represent Middle Office in strategic programmes to enable the Bank to meet regulatory objectives and simplification targets.
* Drive global consistency and transparency by defining and maintaining a catalogue of services and capability matrix.
* Establish efficient BAU day\-to\-day operations and serve as point of escalation for BCS stakeholders internally and externally.
* Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Markets businesses operates.
* Drive new business initiatives to aid revenue and growth priorities. Promote controlled growth through enabling efficient processes and effective controls


**Processes**
* Ownership and stewardship of the Middle Office catalogue of services and process universe including, but not limited to, Trade Capture, Lifecycle Processing, Exception Mgmt., Query Management, Client Liaison and Service Delivery, Project Mgmt.
* Document best practices and guidance for process execution – Integrate standardised, globally consistent approaches across Markets.
* Provide direction to processing and control functions within BCS to create high performing, effective teams.
* Optimise and automate processes to reduce exposure to manual and operational risk heavy processes.
* Manage query remediation, trade life\-cycling and other day\-to\-day processing, ensuring timely escalation to minimise risk exposure.
* New business enablement and solutions, partner to deliver strategic FM initiatives:
* Drive Operational readiness.
* Collaborate with global Middle Office and Centre of Excellence to achieve seamless follow the sun model and constantly seek opportunities to achieve process consistency.
* Face of Operations to Macro Trading and Sales Desks locally – primary point of contact:
* Insulate FM from post execution processing / queries, represent Operations functions.
* Build team profile with the Front Office
* Stakeholder engagement, 2\-way flow of information – “Trusted Advisor”
* Build strong relationship with Centre of Excellence and Trade Control to facilitate efficient communications and speedy resolutions of issues:
* Identify and close knowledge gaps within the Hubs through hands on training.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovate:
* Partner with Technology to deliver transformation.
* Work with FO to identify booking model improvements and drive efficiency.


**Risk Management**
* Define strategy for processes and technology needed to aid risk identification, assessment, remediation, and on\-going monitoring.
* Regular review of the control framework to progress towards a preventative, and automated control landscape.
* Own, drive, and / or participate in remediation programs to mitigate risk to the business.
* Develop and maintain documentation that will provide minimum standards and guidance for all processes in BCS.
* Ensure adherence to the Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk Frameworks


**Governance**
* Embed strong \& effective governance principles across the BCS organisation.
* Develop metrics to monitor business processes, and to supply indicators of risk and performance.
* Produce effective supervision guidelines and embed into BAU across all Markets business lines supported by BCS.
* Provide effective challenge on forum, above and beyond those owned by BCS. Live and breathe the \#NeverSettle value.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
* Provide leadership within the BCS organisation to comply with the highest standards of regulatory and business conduct and practices as defined by internal and external requirements.
* Takes a proactive approach to implementing Just Culture and emphasising the importance of the groups’ valued behaviours regularly through retrospective sessions with the team and Channels townhall sessions.
* Embed the Group’s Values and Group Code of Conduct to ensure adherence with the highest standards of ethics. Comply with relevant policies, processes, and regulations, as part of the culture.


**Key stakeholders**
* Markets Business Heads
* Markets Sales \& Trading
* COO
* T\&O
* Technology
* Market Risk
* Group Operational Risk
* Markets Operations
* Compliance
* Finance
* Legal


**Skills And Experience**
* In\-depth knowledge of financial markets, derivatives (flow and structured), financing products and understanding of products front to back operation process.
* Possesses an analytical mindset along with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to confidently communicate, adapting one's style to both Front Office and offshore colleagues.
* Provide independent challenge and drive management actions at senior level to deliver targeted outcomes.
* Demonstrate strong teamwork with internal and external groups. Introduce and implement new controls and process changes required to support the transformation initiative.
* Thrive on working in fast paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Proven problem solver using quantitative techniques, strong analytical skills with ability to develop proof of concept frameworks and business cases. Proficient in data analytics – PowerBI, Tablueu.

* Understanding of Risk and PnL

 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before.  Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

**What We Offer**

title: Data Conversion Project Manager (Pune)
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Historical Data Conversion Project Manager, you will serve as the essential link between our technical Data Solution Consultants (DSCs) and the client’s business stakeholders. While DSCs focus on the technical execution of data migration and complex analysis, your role is to translate that work into a clear narrative for the client while relaying client requirements back to the internal team. You will leverage a strong understanding of HDC processes, investment data, and technical frameworks to comfortably bridge the gap between technical execution and client expectations. By working side\-by\-side with the DSCs to identify data remediation strategies, you will translate technical requirements into actionable directives for the client and proactively secure necessary inputs. This role is for a subject matter expert who can navigate technical language and investment complexities to drive project progress and maintain high\-impact communication regarding status, gaps, and timelines.
   

  

 You’ll also be among the first members of the Data Solutions team based in India, helping establish our presence in the region while working closely with colleagues across the U.S., U.K., and other global offices. This is a collaborative role offering the opportunity to shape our operating model locally and strengthen how our global teams deliver together.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with Data Solutions: Serve as the dedicated partner to the internal Data Solutions Consultants, ensuring they have clear specifications and context while managing administrative workflows to allow them to focus on technical execution.
* Translate Technical Progress: Translate technical progress, data challenges, and migration results provided by the Data Solutions team into digestible business narratives for client stakeholders.
* Lead Client Status Calls: Lead regular status calls with clients to convey project health, presenting successful data loads and managing expectations around timelines or data discrepancies.
* Facilitate Information Flow: Facilitate the flow of information between parties, ensuring client requirements are accurately scoped for the technical team and technical constraints are clearly explained to the client.
* Oversee Portfolio of Projects: Prioritize and context\-switch effectively to oversee simultaneous projects, maintaining close alignment with the Data Solutions team on resource availability.
* Drive Process Improvement: Identify and drive opportunities to improve the communication workflow between the Project Management and Data Solutions functions.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: Minimum 2\+ years of experience in project management, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of managing client relationships and communicating complex project updates.
* Client\-Focused: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and manage "difficult conversations" regarding timelines or scope.
* Investment\-Savvy: Strong understanding of financial products and securities modeling (technical implementation skills not required, but conceptual understanding is key).
* Solutions\-Oriented: Creative problem\-solver who operates with ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments.
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact, specifically in bridging the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Process\-Minded: Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale.

title: Project Manager - Civil & Interior, PDS Projects
description:
**Job Profile: Project Manager \- Corporate Interior Fit\-Out Works**
**Profile Overview**
 The Project Manager for Corporate Interior Fitout Works at JLL serves as the central point of leadership for the successful delivery of interior construction projects for our corporate clients. This role is instrumental in translating client vision into practical, efficient, and high\-quality workspace environments while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and safety. The position represents a critical client\-facing function that directly impacts JLL's reputation for excellence in project management services.
   

  

 This position sits within JLL's Project \& Development Services (PDS) division, specializing in interior buildouts and workspace transformations for corporate clients across various industry sectors. The Project Manager reports directly to the Senior Project Manager or Regional Director of Project Management, while providing guidance and direction to Assistant Project Managers, Project Coordinators, and managing relationships with external consultants, contractors, and vendors engaged on assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Planning \& Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive project execution plans covering scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management for corporate interior fitout projects ranging from 10,000 to 100,000\+ square feet.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary day\-to\-day client contact, understanding business objectives, managing expectations, and ensuring continuous alignment between project execution and client goals throughout the project lifecycle.
* Financial Oversight: Develop, monitor and manage detailed project budgets, including cost estimation, tracking expenditures, approving payment applications, managing change orders, and forecasting costs to completion while identifying opportunities for value engineering.
* Schedule Management: Create, maintain and monitor detailed project schedules using industry\-standard tools, identifying critical path activities, mitigating potential delays, and implementing recovery strategies when necessary.
* Procurement \& Vendor Management: Manage the selection and performance of general contractors, specialty consultants, and vendors; negotiate contracts, review bids, and oversee the procurement process for furniture, fixtures, and equipment.
* Technical Oversight: Review and coordinate design documentation, provide constructability feedback, ensure code compliance, and oversee quality control processes throughout the construction phase.
* Risk Management: Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution to minimize impacts on schedule, budget, and client satisfaction.
* Project Closeout \& Transition: Oversee project closeout activities including punch list completion, systems commissioning, documentation handover, warranty management, and transition to facilities management teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7\-8 years of progressive experience in project management, with at least 5 years specifically managing commercial interior construction or corporate fitout projects
* Demonstrated experience managing projects with budgets exceeding $1 million
* Strong technical understanding of interior construction methodologies, building systems, and local building codes
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural and engineering drawings
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
* LEED Accredited Professional credential desirable
* Knowledge of workplace design trends and corporate real estate strategies


**Skills And Competencies**
**Technical Skills:**
* Proficiency with project management software (e.g., Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project)
* Strong capabilities with Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel for budget tracking and PowerPoint for client presentations
* Working knowledge of CAD/BIM concepts and ability to review technical drawings
* Familiarity with construction documentation systems and processes
* Understanding of sustainable design principles and WELL building standards
* Knowledge of local building codes, permitting requirements, and ADA compliance


**Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for effective client interaction
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Team leadership and ability to influence across organizational boundaries
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving orientation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Client\-centric mindset with strong service orientation
* Meticulous attention to detail while maintaining big\-picture perspective


**Performance Metrics**
 The Project Manager will be evaluated based on the following key performance indicators:
   

  

* Project Delivery Performance: On\-time and on\-budget delivery of projects against established baselines (target: 90% of projects delivered within 5% of approved budget and schedule)
* Client Satisfaction: Measured through post\-project client surveys and retention/repeat business metrics (target: minimum 85% client satisfaction rating)
* Financial Management: Accuracy of cost forecasting, change order management, and overall project profitability (target: maintain average project profit margins within 2% of targets)
* Safety Performance: Maintaining zero recordable incidents on project sites and ensuring contractor compliance with safety protocols
* Quality Management: Minimizing defects and rework as measured by punch list items and warranty claims
* Team Development: Mentoring junior staff and contributing to department knowledge sharing


 This role requires a versatile professional who can balance technical expertise with strong client relationship skills while embodying JLL's values of teamwork, ethics, excellence, and client focus in delivering exceptional project outcomes.

title: AI Project Manager, Loop Engineer
description:
**Role Description** 




 A NEW KIND OF PROJECT MANAGER
 



 BetaCraft builds software with a small human team and a fleet of AI coding agents. The agents write most of the code. What they cannot do is the thing this role is for: take a half\-formed sentence from a domain expert, turn it into something buildable, get it built, prove it works, and make sure the same mistake never needs fixing twice.
 



 We call that loop engineering. A loop is: a stakeholder says something → it becomes a plan in plain language → a human approves it → agents build it in isolation → a gate checks it against evidence → a pull request opens → the stakeholder sees it working → and whatever was learned becomes a rule the next loop inherits. Loop engineering is designing that so a human touches it only where judgment matters, and it keeps closing when you walk away.
 



 We are hiring two to three senior people to own loops end to end. You will not groom a board or write a weekly deck. You will sit in the middle of a domain expert, a client's engineering lead, a second developer, an internal control plane, and six to eight parallel AI build lanes — and you will be the reason all of it converges.
 



  





 THE BASICS
 



 In\-office role, based in Pune.
 



 Full\-time, Senior
 



 .
 



 STAKEHOLDER\-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT, AS WE PRACTISE IT
 



 — The stakeholder's words are the spec. Old documents are history, never authority. The hierarchy is: built code, then the client's primary sources, then our own specs.
 



 — Every request becomes a tracked story in our system. Every story gets a plan a non\-technical person can approve. Approval is the only merge signal.
 



 — Thinking is front\-loaded. We measure success by how often an approved story ships correctly with zero human touches after approval, and we always show that number beside its guard: how much came back within a week.
 



 — "Done" is a claim. Evidence is a real\-environment walk, a screenshot, a number traced to its source, green CI on the final commit. You reject the rest, politely, every time.
 



  





 HUMANS ARE THE BOTTLENECK. WE DESIGN AROUND IT.
 



 Agents build in minutes. Humans answer in hours, or the next morning, or after the weekend. Every loop we run is shaped by that one fact, and this role owns the shape.
 



 — Thinking is front\-loaded. The plan is argued before approval, so nothing waits on a human after it.
 



 — Park and continue. When a loop hits a question only a human can answer, it parks that item with a default and keeps moving. Nothing blocks on a ruling.
 



 — Decide the rest yourself. Only the genuine 50\-50 calls reach the expert. Everything else you decide, record, and stand behind.
 



 — Primaries before people. A question goes to the expert only after you have proven the answer is not already in a primary source, an earlier ruling, or an old email. Then you batch, ask once, and store once.
 



 — The nightly loop runs alone and reports only. A regression walk runs every night; humans read one morning report and rule on the few parked items. That report is your control surface.
 



 — Two pipeline tiers. Small changes take the fast path; money, schema and cross\-surface changes take the full path. You pick the tier, and a human sees it only when urgency and tier conflict.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO
 



 — Sit with the domain expert. Hear a rule, restate it as a testable build order, ask "does that make sense?", and write it down where the next loop will find it.
 



 — Decide what to ask and what to build. If a primary source answers the question, you do not ask the expert. If you must ask, you batch, you ask once, and you store the answer once. The expert is never the bottleneck.
 



 — Design loops. Intake, plan, approve, build, gate, verify, record. You pick the pipeline tier per change, you write the impact brief before dispatch (what else this touches, what could break, who must say go), and you decide when a human is needed and when they are not.
 



 — Build harnesses. When something slips, you do not just fix it. You build the guard: a deterministic check, a parity test, a regression walk that runs every night and reports only, a morning report that is your control surface. Sweeps discover; guards lock. Every rule carries the incident that paid for it.
 



 — Run the agent fleet. Know when a lane is stale, when to kill it, when context is the bottleneck, when to say "don't build, just answer". Escalate only the genuine 50\-50 calls; decide the rest yourself.
 



 — Hold the boundaries. The client's engineers own their code; you flag, you never touch. A second developer's work is gated before it merges. Merges are sequenced with an order and a parallel\-safety note, never a bare list.
 



 — Communicate like a colleague. Firm, factual, collaborative, no blame. Every number you send is backed by a ledger you keep.
 



  





 WHO DOES WELL HERE
 



 — Problem\-solving is your reflex, not a skill you list. You reduce a messy report to the actual failing mechanism before anyone touches it.
 



 — You read fast and completely. A long regulatory guide, a two\-hundred\-row issue log and a forty\-file diff in one morning, holding the contradictions between them in your head.
 



 — You can read a code diff. You do not need to write code. You do need to notice that a fix landed in the wrong layer and ask why.
 



 — You see every bug as a class, and you also know when a class\-wide sweep is too risky to run mid\-acceptance.
 



 — You have product taste. You know a random banner when you see one, and you think about context before you delete an info icon.
 



 — You are calm under a date that does not move, and you would rather build the guard tonight than explain the same miss tomorrow.
 



  





 STRONG SIGNAL
 



 — You have been the single point of contact between a domain expert and an engineering team, and things shipped.
 



 — You have run or supervised AI coding agents on real work and have opinions about where they fail.
 



 — You have written a process rule after an incident that a team still follows.
 



 — Delivery in a domain where a wrong number costs money: tax, payments, insurance, compliance, analytics.
 



  





 NOT REQUIRED
 



 — Writing production code.
 



 — Prior knowledge of any specific domain. You learn each one from its primary sources.
 



 You will struggle here if your instinct on a hard question is "I'll check with the team", if you count tickets moved rather than proofs produced, or if telling a senior engineer that a green build is not evidence makes you uncomfortable.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 Proven experience managing complex engineering or software implementation projects, in technology\-driven environments.
 



  





 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field.
 



  





 HOW WE HIRE
 



 Work samples only. No behavioural interviews. About five hours over two weeks.
 


1. Design the loop (take\-home, 90 min): a stakeholder scenario with an expert, a client engineer and an agent fleet. Draw the loop, name where a human must touch it, and name the first three guards you would build.
2. The "done" report (live, 45 min): an agent's confident pull request with passing tests. Say what evidence you would demand and what you would say to the agent.
3. The expert relay (live, 45 min): a call transcript. Sort every item into build now, ask first, already answered, out of scope. Draft the one message you send back.
4. Incident to guard (live, 30 min): a real post\-mortem. Write the rule, then the mechanical check that enforces it.
5. Conversation with Leadership Team (60 min): we show you our own process review, cons included, and ask where you think we are wrong.



  





 Apply with a short note and one thing you wrote that other people still use: a process rule, a post\-mortem, a decision log, a runbook.
 



  





 To be considered for this opportunity, please complete our short application form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3Kp0vjf\-8TpgC3SCctw1p4MMO2HZMEgVUcZTxYpwZnyNOvg/viewform

* Excellent stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and executive communication skills

description:
At
 **Citi** 
 , we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day. And we've been doing it for more than 200 years. We do this through our unparalleled global network. We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they be consumers, corporations, governments or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges.
   

  

 We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as
 **Vice President, AI Engineering \& Delivery.** 
 Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well\-being to help plan for your future. For instance:
   

  

* Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well\-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
* We empower our employees to manage their financial well\-being and help them plan for the future.
* Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.


**In this role, you’re expected to:**
 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **AI leader** 
 who combines deep technical expertise in AI development with the ability to lead enterprise\-scale AI delivery. The successful candidate will have experience designing, building, deploying, and governing AI solutions in production, while partnering with business, operations, and engineering teams to scale AI capabilities
   

  

 This role will play a critical leadership role in overseeing and delivering the Investor Operations AI book of work, ensuring effective coordination, governance, and scaling of AI initiatives across the organization. This role acts as the central authority across Investor Operations AI activity—aligning use cases, driving consistency in delivery, and enabling reuse of AI capabilities at scale. The individual will guide how AI solutions are designed and implemented, while ensuring alignment with enterprise platforms, standards, and regulatory expectations.
   

  

 A key expectation is strong
 **technical fluency in AI tools, models, and architectures** 
 , enabling credible challenge and effective partnership with engineering and data science teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**AI Book of Work Delivery**
* Own and manage the end\-to\-end Investor Operations AI book of work
* Drive prioritization, execution, and measurable value delivery
* Identify overlapping use cases and enforce consolidation and reuse
* Track delivery progress, outcomes, and adoption


**AI Solution Oversight**
* Provide direction and challenge on AI solution design, model selection, and implementation approaches
* Guide the use of AI techniques (ML, NLP, LLMs, IDP) against business problems
* Partner with engineering and data science teams to ensure practical, scalable solutions


**Cross\-Team Alignment \& Enablement**
* Act as central coordinator across Investor Operations AI initiatives
* Connect teams with similar use cases to maximize reuse of models and components
* Drive adoption of enterprise AI tools and platforms (IDP, AI, Enterprise capabilities)
* Promote standardized approaches and best practices


**Model Risk Management \& Governance**
* Lead MRM submissions and engagement at Investor Operations level
* Ensure all AI solutions meet governance, validation, and regulatory requirements
* Embed strong controls across model lifecycle (development to monitoring)


**Transformation \& Scaling**
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes through AI
* Support rollout across teams, functions, and regions


**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**
**AI \& Technical Expertise (Essential)**
- Strong practical understanding of:

* Machine learning (classification, regression, clustering)
* NLP and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)


- Solid knowledge of how AI solutions are built and deployed:

* Data pipelines, feature engineering, model training
* Model evaluation (accuracy, precision/recall, drift)
* Deployment patterns (APIs, batch vs real\-time)


- Experience with:

* Python\-based ecosystems
* LLM architectures (prompting, RAG)
* Enterprise or cloud AI platform
* Ability to credibly engage with and challenge engineers and data scientists
* Hands\-on experience designing, building, and deploying AI solutions in production environments, including Machine Learning, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Demonstrated experience developing AI applications end\-to\-end, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, prompt engineering, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Strong technical expertise in Python and modern AI frameworks, such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI platforms.
* Experience building enterprise\-grade AI solutions, including AI assistants, copilots, intelligent document processing, workflow automation, recommendation engines, predictive models, or conversational AI platforms.
* Ability to provide credible technical challenge and guidance to AI engineers, data scientists, and architects, with a deep understanding of AI architecture patterns, model governance, scalability, security, and production deployment practices.
* Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience.

title: Sr. Civil Engineer (Utilities) - Site
description:
Vacancy Intro
   

  

 Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
   

  

 What will you do
   

  

* Supervise and monitor execution of utility and civil infrastructure works undertaken by the EPC Contractor to ensure compliance with approved drawings and contract requirements for specifications, scope, quality, health and safety at site.
* Review construction methodologies, work procedures, resource deployment plans, and site execution strategies and provide technical comments and recommendations. Also, review and monitor implementation of approved Method Statements, Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Plans, and construction procedures. Identify constructability issues, interface conflicts, site constraints, and design discrepancies and coordinate their resolution with stakeholders.
* Review contractor submissions, including GFC drawings, shop drawings, technical proposals, testing records, and quality documentation.
* Verify setting out, alignment, levels, grades, dimensions, and interfaces between utility networks and adjacent infrastructure. Conduct regular site inspections and surveillance to verify workmanship, construction quality, progress, and compliance with approved standards.
* Monitor construction of Utilities like water distribution systems, sewerage networks, stormwater drainage systems, power distribution corridors, utility crossings, and underground utility infrastructure. Also, supervise construction of GLSRs, ESRs, pump houses, substations, utility buildings, and other associated civil structures.
* Critically review ongoing construction activities, identify deficiencies, deviations, and non\-conformities, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Review contractor resource deployment, construction planning, and work fronts to ensure efficient project execution.
* Witness inspections, testing, and commissioning activities for utility networks, reservoirs, structures, and associated infrastructure.
* Monitor project progress, identify delays and risks, and recommend corrective measures to support timely project delivery.
* Coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants, utility agencies, and Client representatives to ensure effective execution and compliance.
* Prepare site supervision reports, technical review comments, compliance assessments, and progress reports, and advise the PMC and Client on technical, quality, and construction\-related matters.


 Where you will work
   

  

 Roha, Raigad.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Qualification \& Skills Requirement**
* Bachelor's degree in civil engineering.
* Ability to review engineering drawings, utility layouts, technical specifications, construction methodologies, and contractor submissions.
* Sound understanding of QA/QC procedures, inspection requirements, construction standards, and applicable codes such as BIS, IRC, MoRTH, CPHEEO, and NBC
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi/Marathi.


**Experience Requirement**
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in construction, testing, and commissioning of utility infrastructure.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior role with a PMC, Owner's Engineer or EPC Contractor on large infrastructure or industrial development projects.
* Demonstrated experience in construction and supervision of water distribution systems, sewerage networks, stormwater drainage systems, power distribution infrastructure, and utility corridors. Also, in GLSRs, ESRs, pump houses, substations, utility buildings, and reinforced concrete structures.


 What we offer you
   

  

* Market competitive salary
* Experience in an employee friendly work culture
* Insurance cover for self and family
* Social Security
* Paid leaves
* Group Profit Sharing


 Are you our new colleague?
   

  

 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. The application process then consists of 1\-2 interviews and a possibly assessment. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 For more information, you can always contact Imran Khan, at imran.khan@haskoning.com.

title: Continuous Improvement (CI) Lead
description:
**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
 Supervises a team of quality technicians, inspectors, and/or engineers, ensuring effective in\-process controls and defect prevention.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuous Improvement \& Problem Solving
+ Lead and execute CI projects using Six Sigma, Shainin Red X methodologies.
+ Apply Shainin tools such as Red X Problem Solving, Component Search, Paired Comparison, BOB/WOW, and Multi\-Vari charts for variation reduction.
+ Facilitate RCA with structured techniques: 8D, DMAIC, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, FMEA.
+ Drive reduction in internal rejections, customer complaints, scrap, rework, and process variation.
+ Strengthen process control through robust PFMEA, Control Plans, Standardized Work, Error\-Proofing
+ Use data analytics, SPC, MSA, and Shainin diagnostic tools to improve process capability and predict failures.
+ Work closely with Engineering, Operations, Program Management, Maintenance, and Supplier Quality to drive improvement.
+ Lead structured CI project governance reviews and support decision\-making for plant leadership.


 Training, Capability Building \& Culture Development
   

  

 Train teams in Lean Principles, Six Sigma problem solving, and Shainin Red X tools and techniques.
   

  

* Mentor and develop CI practitioners (Yellow Belt, Green Belt).
* Promote a continuous improvement mindset across the organization through Kaizen engagement programs.


**Education and Knowledge**
* BE/ B.Tech (Electronic, Mechanical)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (Mandatory), Black Belt preferred.
* Shainin Red X Certification / Training preferred
* Certified Internal Auditor (IATF16949 / VDA 6\.3\) preferred.


**Critical Experience**
* 5–10 years of experience in CI, Quality, Lean Manufacturing, or Process Engineering.
* Proven success in leading high\-impact projects
* Experience in automotive, aerospace, electronics, or high\-volume manufacturing operations.
* Good technical knowledge.
* Strong command over Lean, Six Sigma, and Shainin Red X methodologies.
* Hands\-on knowledge with SPC, MSA, PFMEA, Control Plan, DOE
* Experience using analytical tools (Minitab, Power BI, Red X software preferred)
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to lead change, coach teams, and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Analytical thinking, structured problem\-solving, and project management capability
* Good teamwork and coordination skills.
* Strong Communication Skills Clear reporting and explaining findings.


**Competencies**
 SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)
   

  

**About Te Connectivity**
 TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.
   

  

 Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).
   

  

**What Te Connectivity Offers**
 We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations \- the well\-being of our employees is our top priority!
   

  

* Competitive Salary Package
* Performance\-Based Bonus Plans
* Health and Wellness Incentives
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events
* Employee Resource Group


**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity
 **never requests payment or fees** 
 from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come
 **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com** 
 . If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.
   

  

 Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

**Experience:** 5–10 Years in Environmental Consultancy / EC / EIA  
**Reporting To:** Director / Head – Environment / Senior Management

1\. JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced and technically competent **Environmental Clearance (EC) Project Manager** to manage end\-to\-end Environmental Clearance projects under the applicable environmental regulations and regulatory framework.

The candidate will be responsible for **project planning, EC documentation, EIA/EMP coordination, regulatory submissions, consultant coordination, client communication, government liaison, project tracking, quality control, and timely completion of EC projects**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **EIA Notification, 2006 and amendments, MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, PARIVESH portal, MPCB requirements, EC procedures, EIA/EMP preparation, public consultation, compliance requirements, and environmental regulatory processes**.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. EC Project Management

* Manage multiple Environmental Clearance projects from initiation to EC grant.
* Prepare project execution plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Monitor project progress against agreed timelines.
* Allocate work among project team members and coordinate with technical experts.
* Identify project risks, delays, and regulatory issues and take corrective action.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of all EC\-related documents.
* Maintain project trackers, status reports, and documentation.
* Conduct regular internal project review meetings.
* Coordinate with management regarding project status, challenges, and critical issues.

B. Environmental Clearance Process

* Handle the complete EC process from **project inception to Environmental Clearance**.
* Understand project applicability, category, schedule, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of:
* Form 1 / Form 1A, wherever applicable
* Pre\-feasibility / conceptual reports
* Terms of Reference (ToR) applications
* EIA Reports
* Environmental Management Plans (EMP)
* Executive Summaries
* Risk Assessment / Disaster Management Plans, wherever applicable
* Environmental Cost Benefit Analysis, wherever applicable
* Additional studies as required
* Coordinate submission and processing of EC proposals through the **PARIVESH portal**.
* Track proposal status and regulatory observations.
* Coordinate responses to queries, deficiencies, additional information requirements, and committee observations.
* Prepare and coordinate compliance to **ToR conditions and EC conditions**.

C. EIA/EMP Coordination

* Coordinate with EIA coordinators, functional area experts, laboratories, GIS teams, and other technical consultants.
* Review baseline environmental monitoring data.
* Coordinate studies related to:
* Air environment
* Water environment
* Noise environment
* Soil
* Ecology and biodiversity
* Traffic
* Socio\-economic environment
* Land use
* Hydrogeology
* Risk assessment
* Solid and hazardous waste
* Review EIA/EMP reports for technical consistency and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure recommendations and mitigation measures are practical and project\-specific.
* Coordinate preparation of environmental management budgets and implementation plans.

D. Regulatory Authority Coordination

* Coordinate with **MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, SPCB, local authorities, and other applicable government departments**.
* Monitor agenda items, meeting schedules, presentations, observations, and decisions.
* Coordinate preparation of presentations for SEAC/EAC/SEIAA meetings.
* Prepare briefing notes and responses for committee observations.
* Attend regulatory meetings along with the project team/client, wherever required.
* Maintain professional communication with regulatory authorities and stakeholders.

E. Client Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for EC\-related matters.
* Understand client requirements, project scope, and regulatory objectives.
* Conduct client meetings and project review discussions.
* Provide regular updates regarding project progress.
* Explain regulatory requirements and technical issues to clients in a clear manner.
* Communicate anticipated delays, additional requirements, and regulatory risks.
* Maintain good professional relationships with clients.
* Support business development by identifying additional environmental consultancy requirements from existing clients.

F. Team Management

* Lead and supervise EC project coordinators and junior environmental professionals.
* Assign responsibilities and monitor individual deliverables.
* Review work prepared by team members before submission.
* Train junior staff regarding EC procedures and documentation.
* Ensure proper coordination between technical, regulatory, documentation, and project teams.
* Maintain accountability for project deadlines and quality.

G. Documentation \& Quality Control

* Review all EC documents before submission.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and proper formatting of documents.
* Maintain project\-wise documentation and records.
* Ensure version control of reports and drawings.
* Maintain records of:
* EC applications
* ToR
* EIA/EMP reports
* EC letters
* Compliance reports
* Meeting minutes
* Presentations
* Regulatory communications
* Client communications
* Ensure that all submissions comply with applicable regulatory requirements.

H. EC Compliance \& Post\-EC Activities

* Coordinate preparation of **six\-monthly EC compliance reports**.
* Track EC conditions and implementation status.
* Coordinate with clients for compliance evidence and supporting documents.
* Review compliance reports before submission.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring requirements.
* Track EC validity, compliance schedules, and reporting requirements.
* Assist clients with amendments, transfers, extensions, validity\-related matters, and other post\-EC regulatory requirements.

I. Technical \& Regulatory Knowledge

The candidate should have working knowledge of:

* EIA Notification, 2006 and subsequent amendments
* Environmental Clearance procedures
* MoEF\&CC requirements
* SEIAA / SEAC procedures
* EAC procedures
* PARIVESH portal
* ToR process
* EC amendment procedures
* EC transfer procedures
* EC validity and compliance requirements
* Public consultation / public hearing process
* Environmental monitoring
* EIA/EMP preparation
* Environmental Management Plan
* Risk Assessment and Disaster Management Plan
* Solid Waste Management
* Hazardous and Other Wastes Management
* Plastic Waste Management
* Construction \& Demolition Waste Management
* Water and wastewater management
* Air pollution control
* Noise pollution management
* Greenbelt / plantation planning
* Rainwater harvesting
* STP/ETP/WTP systems
* Environmental monitoring and compliance

3\. REQUIRED SKILLSTechnical Skills

* Strong knowledge of Environmental Clearance procedures.
* Strong understanding of EIA/EMP preparation.
* Ability to interpret environmental regulations and notifications.
* Knowledge of PARIVESH portal and online EC submission.
* Ability to review technical environmental reports.
* Knowledge of environmental standards and applicable legislation.
* Understanding of pollution control technologies and environmental management systems.
* Ability to prepare/review presentations for SEAC/EAC/SEIAA meetings.

Project Management Skills

* Project planning and scheduling
* Team management
* Task allocation
* Deadline management
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Client coordination
* Multi\-project management
* Documentation control
* Quality assurance
* Follow\-up and escalation management

Communication Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong email drafting skills.
* Ability to communicate with clients and government authorities.
* Strong presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical and regulatory matters clearly.
* Negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.

Computer Skills

* MS Word – Advanced
* MS Excel – Advanced
* MS PowerPoint – Advanced
* PDF/document management
* PARIVESH portal
* Email and online communication tools
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD/GIS is an advantage.

4\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

**Essential:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in:
* Environmental Engineering
* Environmental Science
* Civil Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Environmental Management
* Ecology / related environmental field

**Preferred:**

* M.Tech / M.E. Environmental Engineering
* M.Sc. Environmental Science
* MBA / PG Diploma in Project Management or Environmental Management

5\. EXPERIENCE

**Preferred experience: 5–10 years**

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:

* Environmental Consultancy
* Environmental Clearance
* EIA/EMP preparation
* MoEF\&CC / SEIAA projects
* SEAC/EAC coordination
* PARIVESH portal
* MPCB coordination
* Regulatory compliance
* Infrastructure / construction projects
* Township and area development projects
* Mining projects
* Industrial projects
* Water resources / river valley projects

Experience in handling projects independently from **EC application through EC grant** will be highly preferred.

6\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The EC Project Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Timely completion of EC projects.
* Number of projects successfully processed/granted.
* Quality and accuracy of EC submissions.
* Effective handling of regulatory observations.
* Client satisfaction.
* Reduction in project delays.
* Effective team utilization.
* Timely submission of compliance reports.
* Quality of EIA/EMP documentation.
* Regulatory coordination and follow\-up.
* Successful handling of SEAC/EAC/SEIAA observations.
* Contribution to repeat business and new project opportunities.

7\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The candidate should be:

* Responsible and accountable.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented.
* Detail\-oriented.
* Strong in follow\-up.
* Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously.
* Comfortable interacting with senior management and clients.
* Professional in dealing with government authorities.
* Able to work under strict deadlines.
* Good at team coordination and leadership.
* Willing to travel for client meetings/site visits/regulatory meetings when required.

8\. PREFERRED PROFILE

An ideal candidate should be capable of independently handling the complete lifecycle of an EC project:

**Client Requirement → Project Understanding → EC Applicability → Documentation → ToR Application → ToR Compliance → Baseline Studies → EIA/EMP → Public Consultation → Final EIA/EMP → PARIVESH Submission → SEAC/EAC/SEIAA Coordination → Presentation → Compliance to Observations → EC Grant → Post\-EC Compliance**

9\. JOB RESPONSIBILITY – SHORT VERSION FOR JOB PORTALS

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end\-to\-end Environmental Clearance projects.
* Coordinate EC applications, ToR, EIA/EMP reports, and PARIVESH submissions.
* Coordinate with MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, and other regulatory authorities.
* Manage EIA consultants, functional area experts, laboratories, and technical teams.
* Prepare and review EC documentation, presentations, and regulatory responses.
* Track project timelines and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Handle client meetings, project updates, and regulatory discussions.
* Lead and supervise EC project coordinators and junior team members.
* Monitor EC compliance and six\-monthly compliance reporting.
* Identify regulatory risks and provide appropriate solutions.
* Maintain complete project documentation and quality control.
* Support business development and client relationship management.

**Required Skills:** Environmental Clearance, EIA/EMP, PARIVESH, MoEF\&CC, SEIAA, SEAC, EAC, MPCB, Regulatory Compliance, Project Management, Team Management, Client Coordination, Technical Report Review, Presentation Skills and Excellent Communication Skills.
